## Write the model stg_acq__conditions
Domain: conditions. Acquired data format: claims export (CARIN consumer-directed payer data, one row per claim line). Raw schema: raw_claims.
## Staging contract (columns and types your model must return)
condition_start_date DATE
condition_stop_date DATE
patient_id VARCHAR
encounter_id VARCHAR
condition_code VARCHAR
condition_description VARCHAR
## The acquirer's staging model stg_synthea__conditions (it reads the acquirer's own CSV source; shown for its conventions)
```sql
{% set column_names = 
    dbt_utils.get_filtered_columns_in_relation( source('synthea', 'conditions') ) 
%}


WITH cte_conditions_lower AS (

    SELECT
        {{ lowercase_columns(column_names) }}
    FROM {{ source('synthea','conditions') }}
)

, cte_conditions_rename AS (

    SELECT
        {{ adapter.quote("start") }} AS condition_start_date
        , {{ adapter.quote("stop") }} AS condition_stop_date
        , patient AS patient_id
        , encounter AS encounter_id
        , code AS condition_code
        , description AS condition_description
    FROM cte_conditions_lower

)

SELECT *
FROM cte_conditions_rename
```

```sql
WITH parsed AS (
    SELECT
        strptime(
            trim(start_date) || ' ' || trim(start_time),
            '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S'
        ) AS procedure_start_datetime,
        strptime(
            trim(stop_date) || ' ' || trim(stop_time),
            '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S'
        ) AS procedure_stop_datetime,
        CAST(patient AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
        CAST(encounter AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
        nullif(trim(split_part(code_display, '|', 1)), '') AS procedure_code,
        nullif(
            trim(substr(code_display, strpos(code_display, '|') + 1)),
            ''
        ) AS procedure_description,
        CAST(base_cost AS FLOAT) AS procedure_base_cost,
        nullif(trim(split_part(reason, '|', 1)), '') AS procedure_reason_code,
        nullif(
            trim(substr(reason, strpos(reason, '|') + 1)),
            ''
        ) AS procedure_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'procedures') }}
)

SELECT
    procedure_start_datetime,
    CAST(procedure_start_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_start_date,
    procedure_stop_datetime,
    CAST(procedure_stop_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    encounter_id,
    procedure_code,
    procedure_description,
    procedure_base_cost,
    procedure_reason_code,
    procedure_reason_description
FROM parsed
```

```sql
WITH parsed AS (
    SELECT
        strptime(
            trim(date_date) || ' ' || trim(date_time),
            '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S'
        )::TIMESTAMP AS observation_datetime,
        nullif(trim(patient), '')::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
        nullif(trim(encounter), '')::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
        nullif(trim(category), '')::VARCHAR AS observation_category,
        nullif(trim(split_part(code_display, '|', 1)), '')::VARCHAR AS observation_code,
        CASE
            WHEN strpos(code_display, '|') > 0
                THEN nullif(trim(substr(code_display, strpos(code_display, '|') + 1)), '')
            ELSE NULL
        END::VARCHAR AS observation_description,
        "value"::VARCHAR AS observation_value,
        nullif(trim(units), '')::VARCHAR AS observation_units,
        nullif(trim("type"), '')::VARCHAR AS observation_value_type
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'observations') }}
)

SELECT
    observation_datetime,
    observation_datetime::DATE AS observation_date,
    patient_id,
    encounter_id,
    observation_category,
    observation_code,
    observation_description,
    observation_value,
    observation_units,
    observation_value_type
FROM parsed
```

```sql
with extracted as (
    select
        resource,
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            try_cast(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.effectiveDateTime')
                as timestamptz
            )
        ) as observation_datetime,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') as patient_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference') as encounter_reference,
        (
            select coding.value
            from json_each(resource, '$.code.coding') as coding
            order by
                case
                    when json_extract_string(coding.value, '$.system')
                        = 'http://loinc.org' then 0
                    else 1
                end,
                try_cast(coding.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as observation_coding
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'observation') }}
),

normalized as (
    select
        observation_datetime,
        coalesce(
            nullif(
                regexp_extract(
                    patient_reference,
                    '(?:^|/)Patient/([^/?#]+)',
                    1
                ),
                ''
            ),
            regexp_replace(patient_reference, '^urn:uuid:', '')
        ) as patient_id,
        coalesce(
            nullif(
                regexp_extract(
                    encounter_reference,
                    '(?:^|/)Encounter/([^/?#]+)',
                    1
                ),
                ''
            ),
            regexp_replace(encounter_reference, '^urn:uuid:', '')
        ) as encounter_id,
        json_extract_string(
            resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code'
        ) as observation_category,
        json_extract_string(observation_coding, '$.code') as observation_code,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text'),
            json_extract_string(observation_coding, '$.display')
        ) as observation_description,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.value'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text'),
            json_extract_string(
                resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display'
            ),
            json_extract_string(
                resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].code'
            ),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueString'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueBoolean'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueInteger')
        ) as observation_value,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.unit'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.code')
        ) as observation_units,
        case
            when json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.value') is not null
                or json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueInteger') is not null
                then 'numeric'
            when json_extract(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept') is not null
                or json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueString') is not null
                or json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueBoolean') is not null
                then 'text'
            else null
        end as observation_value_type
    from extracted
)

select
    cast(observation_datetime as timestamp) as observation_datetime,
    cast(observation_datetime as date) as observation_date,
    cast(patient_id as varchar) as patient_id,
    cast(encounter_id as varchar) as encounter_id,
    cast(observation_category as varchar) as observation_category,
    cast(observation_code as varchar) as observation_code,
    cast(observation_description as varchar) as observation_description,
    cast(observation_value as varchar) as observation_value,
    cast(observation_units as varchar) as observation_units,
    cast(observation_value_type as varchar) as observation_value_type
from normalized
```

```sql
WITH extracted AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'),
            id
        )::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
        ) AS start_datetime,
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end') AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
        ) AS stop_datetime,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference') AS organization_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') AS class_code,
        encounter_type.code AS encounter_code,
        COALESCE(
            encounter_type.display,
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].text')
        ) AS encounter_description,
        reason.code AS encounter_reason_code,
        COALESCE(
            reason.display,
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].text')
        ) AS encounter_reason_description,
        participant.reference AS provider_reference,
        participant.display AS provider_display
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }} AS e
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') AS code,
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.display') AS display
        FROM json_each(e.resource, '$.type') AS t,
             json_each(t.value, '$.coding') AS c
        ORDER BY
            CASE
                WHEN json_extract_string(c.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
                    THEN 0
                ELSE 1
            END,
            TRY_CAST(t.key AS INTEGER),
            TRY_CAST(c.key AS INTEGER)
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS encounter_type ON TRUE
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') AS code,
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.display') AS display
        FROM json_each(e.resource, '$.reasonCode') AS r,
             json_each(r.value, '$.coding') AS c
        WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
        ORDER BY TRY_CAST(r.key AS INTEGER), TRY_CAST(c.key AS INTEGER)
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS reason ON TRUE
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            json_extract_string(p.value, '$.individual.reference') AS reference,
            json_extract_string(p.value, '$.individual.display') AS display
        FROM json_each(e.resource, '$.participant') AS p
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM json_each(p.value, '$.type') AS t,
                     json_each(t.value, '$.coding') AS c
                WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') = 'PPRF'
            ) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
            TRY_CAST(p.key AS INTEGER)
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS participant ON TRUE
),
normalized AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        NULLIF(
            regexp_replace(
                regexp_replace(
                    split_part(patient_reference, '/_history/', 1),
                    '^urn:uuid:', ''
                ),
                '^.*[|/]', ''
            ),
            ''
        ) AS patient_id,
        NULLIF(
            regexp_replace(
                regexp_replace(
                    split_part(organization_reference, '/_history/', 1),
                    '^urn:uuid:', ''
                ),
                '^.*[|/]', ''
            ),
            ''
        ) AS organization_id,
        CASE
            -- An NPI search reference is not a Synthea provider UUID.
            WHEN contains(provider_reference, '?')
                 AND NOT contains(
                     provider_reference,
                     '?identifier=https://github.com/synthetichealth/synthea|'
                 )
                THEN NULL
            ELSE NULLIF(
                regexp_replace(
                    regexp_replace(
                        split_part(provider_reference, '/_history/', 1),
                        '^urn:uuid:', ''
                    ),
                    '^.*[|/]', ''
                ),
                ''
            )
        END AS referenced_provider_id,
        lower(trim(regexp_replace(provider_display, '^Dr[.]?[[:space:]]+', ''))) AS provider_name
    FROM extracted
),
provider_lookup AS (
    -- Resolve NPI-only references by name and organization only when unambiguous.
    SELECT
        "ORGANIZATION" AS organization_id,
        lower(trim(regexp_replace("NAME", '^Dr[.]?[[:space:]]+', ''))) AS provider_name,
        min("Id") AS provider_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'providers') }}
    GROUP BY 1, 2
    HAVING count(DISTINCT "Id") = 1
)
SELECT
    n.encounter_id::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
    n.start_datetime::TIMESTAMP AS encounter_start_datetime,
    n.start_datetime::DATE AS encounter_start_date,
    COALESCE(n.stop_datetime, n.start_datetime)::TIMESTAMP AS encounter_stop_datetime,
    -- Preserve the acquirer's start-date-first stop-date convention.
    COALESCE(n.start_datetime::DATE, n.stop_datetime::DATE) AS encounter_stop_date,
    n.patient_id::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
    n.organization_id::VARCHAR AS organization_id,
    COALESCE(n.referenced_provider_id, p.provider_id)::VARCHAR AS provider_id,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id,
    CAST(
        CASE upper(n.class_code)
            WHEN 'AMB' THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN n.encounter_code IN ('162673000', '185349003', '410620009')
                        THEN 'wellness'
                    ELSE 'ambulatory'
                END
            WHEN 'EMER' THEN 'emergency'
            WHEN 'IMP' THEN 'inpatient'
            WHEN 'ACUTE' THEN 'inpatient'
            WHEN 'NONAC' THEN 'inpatient'
            WHEN 'OBSENC' THEN 'observation'
            WHEN 'HH' THEN 'home'
            WHEN 'VR' THEN 'virtual'
            WHEN 'SS' THEN 'short stay'
            ELSE lower(n.class_code)
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS encounter_class,
    n.encounter_code::VARCHAR AS encounter_code,
    n.encounter_description::VARCHAR AS encounter_description,
    -- Encounter resources do not supply claim or coverage amounts.
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS base_encounter_cost,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS total_encounter_cost,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS encounter_payer_coverage,
    n.encounter_reason_code::VARCHAR AS encounter_reason_code,
    n.encounter_reason_description::VARCHAR AS encounter_reason_description
FROM normalized AS n
LEFT JOIN provider_lookup AS p
    ON n.organization_id = p.organization_id
   AND n.provider_name = p.provider_name
```

```sql
WITH allergies AS (
    SELECT
        resource,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.patient.reference') AS patient_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference') AS encounter_reference,
        coalesce(
            try_cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetDateTime') AS TIMESTAMPTZ),
            try_cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetPeriod.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ),
            try_cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.recordedDate') AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
        ) AS start_timestamp,
        try_cast(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.recordedDate') AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS recorded_timestamp,
        json_extract(resource, '$.code.coding[0]') AS allergy_coding,
        json_extract(resource, '$.reaction[0]') AS reaction_1,
        json_extract(resource, '$.reaction[1]') AS reaction_2
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'allergyintolerance') }}
),

normalized_allergies AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        nullif(
            regexp_replace(
                regexp_replace(
                    regexp_replace(patient_reference, '^urn:uuid:', ''),
                    '/_history/.*$', ''
                ),
                '^.*/', ''
            ),
            ''
        ) AS patient_id,
        nullif(
            regexp_replace(
                regexp_replace(
                    regexp_replace(encounter_reference, '^urn:uuid:', ''),
                    '/_history/.*$', ''
                ),
                '^.*/', ''
            ),
            ''
        ) AS explicit_encounter_id
    FROM allergies
),

encounters AS (
    SELECT
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'),
            id
        )::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
        nullif(
            regexp_replace(
                regexp_replace(
                    regexp_replace(
                        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
                        '^urn:uuid:', ''
                    ),
                    '/_history/.*$', ''
                ),
                '^.*/', ''
            ),
            ''
        ) AS patient_id,
        try_cast(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS start_timestamp
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}
)

SELECT
    cast(timezone('UTC', a.start_timestamp) AS DATE) AS allergy_start_date,
    -- FHIR AllergyIntolerance does not supply an allergy cessation date.
    cast(NULL AS DATE) AS allergy_stop_date,
    a.patient_id::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
    coalesce(a.explicit_encounter_id, e.encounter_id)::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
    json_extract_string(a.allergy_coding, '$.code')::VARCHAR AS allergy_code,
    cast(
        CASE json_extract_string(a.allergy_coding, '$.system')
            WHEN 'http://snomed.info/sct' THEN 'SNOMED-CT'
            WHEN 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm' THEN 'RxNorm'
            WHEN 'http://loinc.org' THEN 'LOINC'
            ELSE json_extract_string(a.allergy_coding, '$.system')
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS allergy_code_system,
    coalesce(
        json_extract_string(a.allergy_coding, '$.display'),
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.text')
    )::VARCHAR AS allergy_description,
    lower(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.type'))::VARCHAR AS allergy_type,
    lower(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.category[0]'))::VARCHAR AS allergy_category,
    json_extract_string(
        a.reaction_1, '$.manifestation[0].coding[0].code'
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_1_code,
    coalesce(
        json_extract_string(a.reaction_1, '$.manifestation[0].coding[0].display'),
        json_extract_string(a.reaction_1, '$.manifestation[0].text')
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_1_description,
    upper(json_extract_string(a.reaction_1, '$.severity'))::VARCHAR AS reaction_1_severity,
    json_extract_string(
        a.reaction_2, '$.manifestation[0].coding[0].code'
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_2_code,
    coalesce(
        json_extract_string(a.reaction_2, '$.manifestation[0].coding[0].display'),
        json_extract_string(a.reaction_2, '$.manifestation[0].text')
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_2_description,
    upper(json_extract_string(a.reaction_2, '$.severity'))::VARCHAR AS reaction_2_severity
FROM normalized_allergies AS a
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    -- Recover the recording encounter only on an exact patient/time match.
    -- Do not multiply allergy rows or guess a nearby encounter.
    SELECT
        candidate.encounter_id
    FROM encounters AS candidate
    WHERE a.explicit_encounter_id IS NULL
      AND candidate.patient_id = a.patient_id
      AND candidate.start_timestamp = a.recorded_timestamp
    ORDER BY candidate.encounter_id
    LIMIT 1
) AS e ON TRUE
```

```sql
    SELECT
        local_code,
        standard_value
    FROM {{ source('raw_d3', 'code_map') }}
    WHERE list_name = 'encounter_class'
),
encounters AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(e."Id" AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
        CAST(e."START" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_start_datetime,
        COALESCE(
            CAST(e."STOP" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP),
            CAST(e."START" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP)
        ) AS encounter_stop_datetime,
        CAST(e."PATIENT" AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
        CAST(e."ORGANIZATION" AS VARCHAR) AS organization_id,
        CAST(e."PROVIDER" AS VARCHAR) AS provider_id,
        CAST(e."PAYER" AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id,
        CAST(m.standard_value AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_class,
        CAST(regexp_replace(e."CODE", '^SCT:', '') AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_code,
        CAST(e."DESCRIPTION" AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_description,
        CAST(e."BASE_ENCOUNTER_COST" AS FLOAT) AS base_encounter_cost,
        CAST(e."TOTAL_CLAIM_COST" AS FLOAT) AS total_encounter_cost,
        CAST(e."PAYER_COVERAGE" AS FLOAT) AS encounter_payer_coverage,
        CAST(regexp_replace(e."REASONCODE", '^SCT:', '') AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_reason_code,
        CAST(e."REASONDESCRIPTION" AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_d3', 'encounters') }} AS e
    LEFT JOIN encounter_class_map AS m
        ON e."ENCOUNTERCLASS" = m.local_code
)
SELECT
    encounter_id,
    encounter_start_datetime,
    CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date,
    encounter_stop_datetime,

    ) AS encounter_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    organization_id,
    provider_id,
    payer_id,
    encounter_class,
    encounter_code,
    encounter_description,
    base_encounter_cost,
    total_encounter_cost,
    encounter_payer_coverage,
    encounter_reason_code,
    encounter_reason_description
FROM encounters
```

## Mapping hints
- Timestamps are split into <column>_date (MM/DD/YYYY) and <column>_time (HH:MM:SS), both in UTC.
- Date columns are text written DD-Mon-YYYY (03-Sep-1942).
- code_display is the code, ' | ', then the description: split at the first ' | '.
- reason is the reason code, ' | ', then the reason description (NULL when there is no reason).
- All other columns keep the acquirer's source column names in lower case.

```sql
WITH parsed AS (
    SELECT
        try_strptime(
            nullif(trim(start_date), '') || ' ' || nullif(trim(start_time), ''),
            ['%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S', '%d-%b-%Y %H:%M:%S']
        ) AS medication_start_datetime,
        try_strptime(
            nullif(trim(stop_date), '') || ' ' || nullif(trim(stop_time), ''),
            ['%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S', '%d-%b-%Y %H:%M:%S']
        ) AS medication_stop_datetime,
        lower(nullif(trim(patient), '')) AS patient_id,
        lower(nullif(trim(payer), '')) AS payer_id,
        lower(nullif(trim(encounter), '')) AS encounter_id,
        nullif(trim(code_display), '') AS code_display,
        CAST(base_cost AS FLOAT) AS medication_base_cost,
        CAST(payer_coverage AS FLOAT) AS medication_payer_coverage,
        CAST(dispenses AS FLOAT) AS dispenses,
        CAST(totalcost AS FLOAT) AS medication_total_cost,
        nullif(trim(reason), '') AS reason
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'medications') }}
),
delimiters AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        strpos(code_display, ' | ') AS code_separator,
        strpos(reason, ' | ') AS reason_separator
    FROM parsed
)
SELECT
    CAST(medication_start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_start_datetime,
    CAST(medication_start_datetime AS DATE) AS medication_start_date,
    CAST(medication_stop_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_stop_datetime,
    CAST(medication_stop_datetime AS DATE) AS medication_stop_date,
    CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
    CAST(payer_id AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id,
    CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN code_separator > 0
                THEN nullif(trim(substr(code_display, 1, code_separator - 1)), '')
            ELSE code_display
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS medication_code,
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN code_separator > 0
                THEN nullif(trim(substr(code_display, code_separator + 3)), '')
            ELSE NULL
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS medication_description,
    medication_base_cost,
    medication_payer_coverage,
    dispenses,
    medication_total_cost,
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN reason_separator > 0
                THEN nullif(trim(substr(reason, 1, reason_separator - 1)), '')
            ELSE reason
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS medication_reason_code,
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN reason_separator > 0
                THEN nullif(trim(substr(reason, reason_separator + 3)), '')
            ELSE NULL
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS medication_reason_description
FROM delimiters
```

```sql
WITH extracted AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id)::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS start_value,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end') AS stop_value,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference') AS organization_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.reference') AS provider_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.display') AS provider_display,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') AS class_code,
        encounter_type.code AS encounter_code,
        COALESCE(
            encounter_type.display,
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].text')
        ) AS encounter_description,
        encounter_reason.code AS encounter_reason_code,
        COALESCE(
            encounter_reason.display,
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].text')
        ) AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }} AS e
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') AS code,
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.display') AS display
        FROM json_each(e.resource, '$.type') AS t
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL json_each(t.value, '$.coding') AS c
        ORDER BY
            CASE
                WHEN json_extract_string(c.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
                    THEN 0
                ELSE 1
            END,
            TRY_CAST(t.key AS INTEGER),
            TRY_CAST(c.key AS INTEGER)
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS encounter_type ON TRUE
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') AS code,
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.display') AS display
        FROM json_each(e.resource, '$.reason') AS r
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL json_each(r.value, '$.coding') AS c
        WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
        ORDER BY TRY_CAST(r.key AS INTEGER), TRY_CAST(c.key AS INTEGER)
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS encounter_reason ON TRUE
),
normalized AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        timezone('UTC', TRY_CAST(start_value AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AS start_datetime,
        timezone('UTC', TRY_CAST(stop_value AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AS stop_datetime,
        CASE
            WHEN patient_reference LIKE 'urn:uuid:%'
                THEN substr(patient_reference, 10)
            WHEN patient_reference NOT LIKE '%?%'
                THEN regexp_extract(
                    patient_reference,
                    '(?:^|/)Patient/([^/]+)(?:/_history/[^/]+)?$',
                    1
                )
        END AS patient_id,
        CASE
            WHEN organization_reference LIKE 'urn:uuid:%'
                THEN substr(organization_reference, 10)
            WHEN organization_reference LIKE '%?identifier=%|%'
                THEN regexp_extract(organization_reference, '\|([^&]+)', 1)
            WHEN organization_reference NOT LIKE '%?%'
                THEN regexp_extract(
                    organization_reference,
                    '(?:^|/)Organization/([^/]+)(?:/_history/[^/]+)?$',
                    1
                )
        END AS organization_id,
        CASE
            WHEN provider_reference LIKE 'urn:uuid:%'
                THEN substr(provider_reference, 10)
            WHEN provider_reference NOT LIKE '%?%'
                THEN regexp_extract(
                    provider_reference,
                    '(?:^|/)Practitioner/([^/]+)(?:/_history/[^/]+)?$',
                    1
                )
        END AS direct_provider_id,
        lower(trim(regexp_replace(
            provider_display, '(?i)^dr\.?\s+', ''
        ))) AS provider_name
    FROM extracted
),
provider_lookup AS (
    -- The CSV has no NPI. Resolve only unambiguous name/organization pairs.
    SELECT
        "ORGANIZATION" AS organization_id,
        lower(trim(regexp_replace("NAME", '(?i)^dr\.?\s+', ''))) AS provider_name,
        min("Id") AS provider_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'providers') }}
    GROUP BY 1, 2
    HAVING count(DISTINCT "Id") = 1
),
resolved AS (
    SELECT
        n.*,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(n.direct_provider_id, ''), p.provider_id) AS provider_id,
        COALESCE(n.stop_datetime, n.start_datetime) AS effective_stop_datetime
    FROM normalized AS n
    LEFT JOIN provider_lookup AS p
        ON NULLIF(n.organization_id, '') = p.organization_id
        AND n.provider_name = p.provider_name
)
SELECT
    encounter_id::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
    start_datetime::TIMESTAMP AS encounter_start_datetime,
    start_datetime::DATE AS encounter_start_date,
    effective_stop_datetime::TIMESTAMP AS encounter_stop_datetime,
    -- Preserve the existing staging model's start-date-first convention.
    COALESCE(start_datetime::DATE, effective_stop_datetime::DATE) AS encounter_stop_date,
    NULLIF(patient_id, '')::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
    NULLIF(organization_id, '')::VARCHAR AS organization_id,
    provider_id::VARCHAR AS provider_id,
    NULL::VARCHAR AS payer_id,
    (
        CASE
            WHEN upper(class_code) = 'AMB' AND encounter_code = '162673000'
                THEN 'wellness'
            WHEN upper(class_code) = 'AMB' AND encounter_code = '308335008'
                THEN 'outpatient'
            WHEN upper(class_code) = 'AMB' THEN 'ambulatory'
            WHEN upper(class_code) = 'EMER' THEN 'emergency'
            WHEN upper(class_code) IN ('IMP', 'ACUTE', 'NONAC') THEN 'inpatient'
            WHEN upper(class_code) = 'OBSENC' THEN 'observation'
            WHEN upper(class_code) = 'VR' THEN 'virtual'
            WHEN upper(class_code) = 'HH' THEN 'home'
            ELSE lower(class_code)
```

## Mapping hints
- start date is the first 10 characters of recordedDate (R4) or assertedDate (STU3); there is no stop date.
- patient is patient.reference without the urn:uuid: prefix. The resource has no encounter reference: use the patient's Encounter whose period.start equals that timestamp.
- code and description are code.coding[0]; system is SNOMED-CT or RxNorm according to the coding system URL; type is type; category is category[0].
- reaction 1 and 2 are reaction[0] and reaction[1]: manifestation[0].coding[0].code and .display, severity in upper case. Commas in text become spaces.
text:
```sql
WITH allergies AS (
    SELECT
        resource,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.recordedDate'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.assertedDate')
        ) AS recorded_at,
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.patient.reference'),
            '^urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) AS patient_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'allergyintolerance') }}
),

encounter_records AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id) AS encounter_id,
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
            '^urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) AS patient_id,
        TRY_CAST(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS start_timestamp
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}
),

encounters AS (
    -- Resolve timestamp ties deterministically without multiplying allergy rows.
    SELECT
        patient_id,
        start_timestamp,
        MIN(encounter_id) AS encounter_id
    FROM encounter_records
    GROUP BY patient_id, start_timestamp
)

SELECT
    CAST(
        timezone('UTC', TRY_CAST(a.recorded_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ))
        AS DATE
    ) AS allergy_start_date,
    CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS allergy_stop_date,
    a.patient_id AS patient_id,
    e.encounter_id AS encounter_id,
    json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS allergy_code,
    CASE json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].system')
        WHEN 'http://snomed.info/sct' THEN 'SNOMED-CT'
        WHEN 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm' THEN 'RxNorm'
        ELSE json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].system')
    END AS allergy_code_system,
    replace(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
        ',',
        ' '
    ) AS allergy_description,
    json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.type') AS allergy_type,
    json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.category[0]') AS allergy_category,
    json_extract_string(
        a.resource,
        '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].code'
    ) AS reaction_1_code,
    replace(
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource,
            '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'
        ),
        ',',
        ' '
    ) AS reaction_1_description,
    upper(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[0].severity')
    ) AS reaction_1_severity,
    json_extract_string(
        a.resource,
        '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].code'
    ) AS reaction_2_code,
    replace(
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource,
            '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'
        ),
        ',',
        ' '
    ) AS reaction_2_description,
    upper(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[1].severity')
    ) AS reaction_2_severity
FROM allergies AS a
LEFT JOIN encounters AS e
    ON a.patient_id = e.patient_id
    AND TRY_CAST(a.recorded_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ) = e.start_timestamp
```

- One row per value: an Observation with component[] gives one row per component (code and value from the component, date, patient, encounter and category from the parent); an Observation without components gives one row.
- date is effectiveDateTime (UTC); patient is subject.reference, the encounter is encounter.reference (R4) or context.reference (STU3), without the urn:uuid: prefix; category is category[0].coding[0].code.
- A valueQuantity gives type numeric, units = valueQuantity.unit and the value as text with exactly one decimal digit (163.34 is written 163.3, 71 is written 71.0). Other values give type text: the display of valueCodeableConcept.coding[0], or valueString.
- In DuckDB write (x->'$.path') IS NULL with the parentheses. Commas in text become spaces.

```sql
with extracted as (
    select
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            try_cast(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.effectiveDateTime')
                as timestamptz
            )
        ) as observation_datetime,
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
            '^urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) as patient_id,
        regexp_replace(
            coalesce(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference')
            ),
            '^urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) as encounter_id,
        json_extract_string(
            resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code'
        ) as observation_category,
        json_extract_string(
            resource, '$.code.coding[0].code'
        ) as observation_code,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
        ) as observation_description,
        json_extract_string(
            resource, '$.valueQuantity.value'
        ) as quantity_value,
        json_extract_string(
            resource, '$.valueQuantity.unit'
        ) as quantity_unit,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(
                resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display'
            ),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueString')
        ) as text_value,
        (resource -> '$.valueQuantity') is not null as is_quantity
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'observation') }}
)

select
    cast(observation_datetime as timestamp) as observation_datetime,
    cast(observation_datetime as date) as observation_date,
    cast(patient_id as varchar) as patient_id,
    cast(encounter_id as varchar) as encounter_id,
    cast(observation_category as varchar) as observation_category,
    cast(observation_code as varchar) as observation_code,
    replace(observation_description, ',', ' ')::varchar
        as observation_description,
    cast(
        case
            when is_quantity then
                printf('%.1f', try_cast(quantity_value as double))
            else replace(text_value, ',', ' ')
        end as varchar
    ) as observation_value,
    cast(
        case when is_quantity then quantity_unit end as varchar
    ) as observation_units,
    cast(
        case when is_quantity then 'numeric' else 'text' end as varchar
    ) as observation_value_type
from extracted
```

```sql
WITH parsed AS (
    SELECT
        strptime(
            trim(start_date) || ' ' || trim(start_time),
            '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S'
        )::TIMESTAMP AS procedure_start_datetime,
        strptime(
            trim(stop_date) || ' ' || trim(stop_time),
            '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S'
        )::TIMESTAMP AS procedure_stop_datetime,
        lower(trim(patient))::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
        lower(trim(encounter))::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
        nullif(trim(code_display), '') AS code_display,
        base_cost::FLOAT AS procedure_base_cost,
        nullif(trim(reason), '') AS reason
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'procedures') }}
)

SELECT
    procedure_start_datetime,
    procedure_start_datetime::DATE AS procedure_start_date,
    procedure_stop_datetime,
    procedure_stop_datetime::DATE AS procedure_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    encounter_id,
    nullif(trim(split_part(code_display, '|', 1)), '')::VARCHAR AS procedure_code,
    CASE
        WHEN strpos(code_display, '|') > 0
        THEN nullif(trim(substr(code_display, strpos(code_display, '|') + 1)), '')
        ELSE NULL
    END::VARCHAR AS procedure_description,
    procedure_base_cost,
    nullif(trim(split_part(reason, '|', 1)), '')::VARCHAR AS procedure_reason_code,
    CASE
        WHEN strpos(reason, '|') > 0
        THEN nullif(trim(substr(reason, strpos(reason, '|') + 1)), '')
        ELSE NULL
    END::VARCHAR AS procedure_reason_description
FROM parsed
```

```sql
WITH extracted AS (
    SELECT
        resource,
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            try_cast(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.effectiveDateTime')
                AS TIMESTAMPTZ
            )
        ) AS observation_datetime,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference') AS encounter_reference,
        (
            SELECT coding.value
            FROM json_each(resource, '$.code.coding') AS coding
            ORDER BY
                CASE
                    WHEN json_extract_string(coding.value, '$.system')
                        = 'http://loinc.org' THEN 0
                    ELSE 1
                END,
                try_cast(coding.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS observation_coding,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code')
            AS observation_category,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.value') AS quantity_value,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].code')
        ) AS concept_value,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueString') AS string_value,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueBoolean') AS boolean_value,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueInteger') AS integer_value
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'observation') }}
)

SELECT
    observation_datetime::TIMESTAMP AS observation_datetime,
    observation_datetime::DATE AS observation_date,
    regexp_replace(
        regexp_replace(patient_reference, '/_history/[^/]+$', ''),
        '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)',
        ''
    )::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
    regexp_replace(
        regexp_replace(encounter_reference, '/_history/[^/]+$', ''),
        '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)',
        ''
    )::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
    observation_category::VARCHAR AS observation_category,
    json_extract_string(observation_coding, '$.code')::VARCHAR
        AS observation_code,
    coalesce(
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text'),
        json_extract_string(observation_coding, '$.display')
    )::VARCHAR AS observation_description,
    coalesce(
        quantity_value,
        concept_value,
        string_value,
        boolean_value,
        integer_value
    )::VARCHAR AS observation_value,
    coalesce(
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.unit'),
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.code')
    )::VARCHAR AS observation_units,
    CASE
        WHEN quantity_value IS NOT NULL THEN 'numeric'
        WHEN concept_value IS NOT NULL
            OR string_value IS NOT NULL
            OR boolean_value IS NOT NULL THEN 'text'
        WHEN integer_value IS NOT NULL THEN 'numeric'
        ELSE NULL
    END::VARCHAR AS observation_value_type
FROM extracted
```

```sql
        CAST(
            strptime(
                trim(date_date) || ' ' || trim(date_time),

                CASE
                    WHEN strpos(code_display, '|') > 0
                        THEN substr(code_display, 1, strpos(code_display, '|') - 1)

                END
```

```sql
WITH extracted AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id)::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
        ) AS start_datetime,
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end') AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
        ) AS stop_datetime,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference') AS organization_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') AS class_code,
        (
            SELECT p.value
            FROM json_each(resource, '$.participant') AS p
            ORDER BY
                CASE WHEN EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM json_each(p.value, '$.type') AS t,
                         LATERAL json_each(t.value, '$.coding') AS c
                    WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') = 'PPRF'
                ) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                TRY_CAST(p.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS participant,
        (
            SELECT c.value
            FROM json_each(resource, '$.type') AS t,
                 LATERAL json_each(t.value, '$.coding') AS c
            WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
            ORDER BY TRY_CAST(t.key AS INTEGER), TRY_CAST(c.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS encounter_coding,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].text') AS encounter_text,
        (
            SELECT c.value
            FROM json_each(resource, '$.reasonCode') AS r,
                 LATERAL json_each(r.value, '$.coding') AS c
            WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
            ORDER BY TRY_CAST(r.key AS INTEGER), TRY_CAST(c.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS reason_coding,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].text') AS reason_text
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}
),

normalized AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN starts_with(patient_reference, 'urn:uuid:')
                THEN substr(patient_reference, 10)
            WHEN contains(patient_reference, '?identifier=https://github.com/synthetichealth/synthea|')
                THEN split_part(patient_reference, '|', 2)
            WHEN NOT contains(patient_reference, '?')
                THEN NULLIF(
                    regexp_extract(patient_reference, '(?:^|/)Patient/([^/]+)', 1),
                    ''
                )
        END::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
        CASE
            WHEN starts_with(organization_reference, 'urn:uuid:')
                THEN substr(organization_reference, 10)
            WHEN contains(organization_reference, '?identifier=https://github.com/synthetichealth/synthea|')
                THEN split_part(organization_reference, '|', 2)
            WHEN NOT contains(organization_reference, '?')
                THEN NULLIF(
                    regexp_extract(organization_reference, '(?:^|/)Organization/([^/]+)', 1),
                    ''
                )
        END::VARCHAR AS organization_id,
        json_extract_string(participant, '$.individual.reference') AS provider_reference,
        lower(trim(regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(participant, '$.individual.display'),
            '^Dr[.]?\s+',
            '',
            'i'
        ))) AS provider_name,
        json_extract_string(encounter_coding, '$.code') AS encounter_code,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(encounter_coding, '$.display'),
            encounter_text
        ) AS encounter_description,
        json_extract_string(reason_coding, '$.code') AS reason_code,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(reason_coding, '$.display'),
            reason_text
        ) AS reason_description
    FROM extracted
),

provider_lookup AS (
    -- NPI search references cannot be converted to provider UUIDs directly.
    -- Use the displayed name within the organization only when unambiguous.
    SELECT
        "ORGANIZATION" AS organization_id,
        lower(trim("NAME")) AS provider_name,
        min("Id") AS provider_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'providers') }}
    GROUP BY "ORGANIZATION", lower(trim("NAME"))
    HAVING count(DISTINCT "Id") = 1
),

resolved AS (
    SELECT
        n.*,
        COALESCE(
            CASE
                WHEN starts_with(n.provider_reference, 'urn:uuid:')
                    THEN substr(n.provider_reference, 10)
                WHEN contains(n.provider_reference, '?identifier=https://github.com/synthetichealth/synthea|')
                    THEN split_part(n.provider_reference, '|', 2)
                WHEN NOT contains(n.provider_reference, '?')
                    THEN NULLIF(
                        regexp_extract(n.provider_reference, '(?:^|/)Practitioner/([^/]+)', 1),
                        ''
                    )
            END,
            p.provider_id
        )::VARCHAR AS provider_id
    FROM normalized AS n
    LEFT JOIN provider_lookup AS p
        ON n.organization_id = p.organization_id
       AND n.provider_name = p.provider_name
)

SELECT
    encounter_id::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
    start_datetime::TIMESTAMP AS encounter_start_datetime,
    start_datetime::DATE AS encounter_start_date,
    COALESCE(stop_datetime, start_datetime)::TIMESTAMP AS encounter_stop_datetime,
    -- Preserve the acquirer's start-date-first stop-date convention.
    COALESCE(start_datetime::DATE, stop_datetime::DATE) AS encounter_stop_date,
    patient_id::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
    organization_id::VARCHAR AS organization_id,
    provider_id::VARCHAR AS provider_id,
    NULL::VARCHAR AS payer_id,
    CASE
        WHEN class_code = 'AMB'
             AND encounter_code IN ('162673000', '185349003')
            THEN 'wellness'
        WHEN class_code = 'AMB' THEN 'ambulatory'
        WHEN class_code = 'IMP' THEN 'inpatient'
        WHEN class_code = 'EMER' THEN 'emergency'
        WHEN class_code = 'HH' THEN 'home'
        WHEN class_code = 'VR' THEN 'virtual'
        WHEN class_code = 'OBSENC' THEN 'observation'
        WHEN class_code = 'SS' THEN 'shortstay'
        ELSE lower(class_code)
    END::VARCHAR AS encounter_class,
    encounter_code::VARCHAR AS encounter_code,
    encounter_description::VARCHAR AS encounter_description,
    -- Encounter resources do not supply claim amounts or payer coverage.
    NULL::FLOAT AS base_encounter_cost,
    NULL::FLOAT AS total_encounter_cost,
    NULL::FLOAT AS encounter_payer_coverage,
    reason_code::VARCHAR AS encounter_reason_code,
    reason_description::VARCHAR AS encounter_reason_description
FROM resolved
```

```sql
WITH encounter_class_map AS (
    SELECT
        local_code,
        standard_value
    FROM {{ source('raw_d3', 'code_map') }}
    WHERE list_name = 'encounter_class'
),
normalized AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(e."Id" AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
        e."START" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS encounter_start_datetime,
        COALESCE(
            e."STOP" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC',
            e."START" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
        ) AS encounter_stop_datetime,
        CAST(e."PATIENT" AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
        CAST(e."ORGANIZATION" AS VARCHAR) AS organization_id,
        CAST(e."PROVIDER" AS VARCHAR) AS provider_id,
        CAST(e."PAYER" AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id,
        CAST(m.standard_value AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_class,
        CAST(regexp_replace(e."CODE", '^SCT:', '') AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_code,
        CAST(e."DESCRIPTION" AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_description,
        CAST(e."BASE_ENCOUNTER_COST" AS FLOAT) AS base_encounter_cost,
        CAST(e."TOTAL_CLAIM_COST" AS FLOAT) AS total_encounter_cost,
        CAST(e."PAYER_COVERAGE" AS FLOAT) AS encounter_payer_coverage,
        CAST(regexp_replace(e."REASONCODE", '^SCT:', '') AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_reason_code,
        CAST(e."REASONDESCRIPTION" AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_reason_description

)

    encounter_id,
    encounter_start_datetime,
    CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date,
    encounter_stop_datetime,

        CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE),
        CAST(encounter_stop_datetime AS DATE)
    ) AS encounter_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    organization_id,
    provider_id,
    payer_id,
    encounter_class,
    encounter_code,
    encounter_description,
    base_encounter_cost,
    total_encounter_cost,
    encounter_payer_coverage,
    encounter_reason_code,
    encounter_reason_description
FROM normalized
```

- Timestamps are split into <column>_date (MM/DD/YYYY) and <column>_time (HH:MM:SS), both in UTC.
- Date columns are text written DD-Mon-YYYY (03-Sep-1942).
- code_display is the code, ' | ', then the description: split at the first ' | '.
- reason is the reason code, ' | ', then the reason description (NULL when there is no reason).
- All other columns keep the acquirer's source column names in lower case.
text:
```sql
WITH parsed AS (
    SELECT
        try_strptime(
            nullif(trim(start_date), '') || ' ' || nullif(trim(start_time), ''),
            ['%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S', '%d-%b-%Y %H:%M:%S']
        ) AS medication_start_datetime,
        try_strptime(
            nullif(trim(stop_date), '') || ' ' || nullif(trim(stop_time), ''),
            ['%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S', '%d-%b-%Y %H:%M:%S']
        ) AS medication_stop_datetime,
        lower(nullif(trim(patient), ''))::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
        lower(nullif(trim(payer), ''))::VARCHAR AS payer_id,
        lower(nullif(trim(encounter), ''))::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
        nullif(trim(code_display), '') AS code_display,
        base_cost::FLOAT AS medication_base_cost,
        payer_coverage::FLOAT AS medication_payer_coverage,
        dispenses::FLOAT AS dispenses,
        totalcost::FLOAT AS medication_total_cost,
        nullif(trim(reason), '') AS reason
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'medications') }}
)

SELECT
    medication_start_datetime,
    medication_start_datetime::DATE AS medication_start_date,
    medication_stop_datetime,
    medication_stop_datetime::DATE AS medication_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    payer_id,
    encounter_id,
    nullif(trim(split_part(code_display, ' | ', 1)), '')::VARCHAR
        AS medication_code,
    CASE
        WHEN strpos(code_display, ' | ') > 0
        THEN nullif(trim(substr(code_display, strpos(code_display, ' | ') + 3)), '')
    END::VARCHAR AS medication_description,
    medication_base_cost,
    medication_payer_coverage,
    dispenses,
    medication_total_cost,
    nullif(trim(split_part(reason, ' | ', 1)), '')::VARCHAR
        AS medication_reason_code,
    CASE
        WHEN strpos(reason, ' | ') > 0
        THEN nullif(trim(substr(reason, strpos(reason, ' | ') + 3)), '')
    END::VARCHAR AS medication_reason_description
FROM parsed
```

```sql
WITH allergies AS (
    SELECT
        resource,
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.patient.reference'),
                '^(urn:uuid:|.*/Patient/|Patient/)',
                ''
            ),
            '/_history/.*$',
            ''
        )::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference'),
                '^(urn:uuid:|.*/Encounter/|Encounter/)',
                ''
            ),
            '/_history/.*$',
            ''
        )::VARCHAR AS explicit_encounter_id,
        try_cast(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.recordedDate')
            AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS recorded_at,
        coalesce(
            try_cast(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetDateTime')
                AS TIMESTAMPTZ
            ),
            try_cast(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetPeriod.start')
                AS TIMESTAMPTZ
            ),
            try_cast(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.recordedDate')
                AS TIMESTAMPTZ
            )
        ) AS allergy_started_at
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'allergyintolerance') }}
),

encounters AS (
    SELECT
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'),
            id
        )::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
                '^(urn:uuid:|.*/Patient/|Patient/)',
                ''
            ),
            '/_history/.*$',
            ''
        )::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
        try_cast(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start')
            AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS encounter_start,
        try_cast(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end')
            AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS encounter_end
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}
)

SELECT
    cast(timezone('UTC', a.allergy_started_at) AS DATE) AS allergy_start_date,
    -- AllergyIntolerance has no allergy-resolution date in these resources.
    cast(NULL AS DATE) AS allergy_stop_date,
    a.patient_id,
    coalesce(a.explicit_encounter_id, matched.encounter_id)::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
    json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')::VARCHAR AS allergy_code,
    cast(
        CASE json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].system')
            WHEN 'http://snomed.info/sct' THEN 'SNOMED-CT'
            WHEN 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm' THEN 'RxNorm'
            WHEN 'http://loinc.org' THEN 'LOINC'
            ELSE json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].system')
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS allergy_code_system,
    coalesce(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.text')
    )::VARCHAR AS allergy_description,
    lower(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.type'))::VARCHAR AS allergy_type,
    lower(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.category[0]'))::VARCHAR AS allergy_category,
    json_extract_string(
        a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].code'
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_1_code,
    coalesce(
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'
        ),
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].text')
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_1_description,
    upper(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[0].severity')
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_1_severity,
    json_extract_string(
        a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].code'
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_2_code,
    coalesce(
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'
        ),
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].text')
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_2_description,
    upper(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[1].severity')
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_2_severity
FROM allergies AS a
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    -- Recover the recording encounter only when its timing supports the link.
    -- LIMIT keeps overlapping encounters from multiplying source records.
    SELECT e.encounter_id
    FROM encounters AS e
    WHERE a.explicit_encounter_id IS NULL
      AND e.patient_id = a.patient_id
      AND (
          a.recorded_at = e.encounter_start
          OR (
              a.recorded_at >= e.encounter_start
              AND a.recorded_at < e.encounter_end
          )
      )
    ORDER BY
        CASE WHEN a.recorded_at = e.encounter_start THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
        e.encounter_start DESC,
        e.encounter_id
    LIMIT 1
) AS matched ON TRUE
```

```sql
WITH extracted AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id)::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS start_text,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end') AS stop_text,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference') AS organization_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.reference') AS provider_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.display') AS provider_name,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') AS class_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code') AS encounter_code,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].text')
        ) AS encounter_description,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].code') AS encounter_reason_code,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].text')
        ) AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }}
),

normalized AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        TRY_CAST(start_text AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
            AS encounter_start_datetime,
        COALESCE(
            TRY_CAST(stop_text AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC',
            TRY_CAST(start_text AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
        ) AS encounter_stop_datetime,
        CASE
            WHEN patient_reference LIKE 'urn:uuid:%'
                THEN substr(patient_reference, 10)
            WHEN patient_reference NOT LIKE '%?%'
                THEN NULLIF(
                    regexp_extract(
                        patient_reference,
                        '(?:^|/)Patient/([^/?#]+)',
                        1
                    ),
                    ''
                )
        END AS patient_id,
        CASE
            WHEN organization_reference LIKE '%?identifier=https://github.com/synthetichealth/synthea|%'
                THEN split_part(organization_reference, '|', 2)
            WHEN organization_reference LIKE 'urn:uuid:%'
                THEN substr(organization_reference, 10)
            WHEN organization_reference NOT LIKE '%?%'
                THEN NULLIF(
                    regexp_extract(
                        organization_reference,
                        '(?:^|/)Organization/([^/?#]+)',
                        1
                    ),
                    ''
                )
        END AS organization_id,
        CASE
            WHEN provider_reference LIKE 'urn:uuid:%'
                THEN substr(provider_reference, 10)
            WHEN provider_reference LIKE '%?identifier=https://github.com/synthetichealth/synthea|%'
                THEN split_part(provider_reference, '|', 2)
            WHEN provider_reference NOT LIKE '%?%'
                THEN NULLIF(
                    regexp_extract(
                        provider_reference,
                        '(?:^|/)Practitioner/([^/?#]+)',
                        1
                    ),
                    ''
                )
        END AS direct_provider_id,
        lower(trim(regexp_replace(
            provider_name,
            '^Dr[.]?[[:space:]]+',
            '',
            'i'
        ))) AS provider_name_key
    FROM extracted
),

-- NPI references cannot be used as the staging provider UUID.
-- Resolve by name within the organization only when the match is unique.
provider_lookup AS (
    SELECT
        "ORGANIZATION" AS organization_id,
        lower(trim(regexp_replace(
            "NAME",
            '^Dr[.]?[[:space:]]+',
            '',
            'i'
        ))) AS provider_name_key,
        CASE
            WHEN count(DISTINCT "Id") = 1 THEN min("Id")
        END AS provider_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'providers') }}
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)

SELECT
    n.encounter_id::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
    n.encounter_start_datetime::TIMESTAMP AS encounter_start_datetime,
    n.encounter_start_datetime::DATE AS encounter_start_date,
    n.encounter_stop_datetime::TIMESTAMP AS encounter_stop_datetime,
    -- Preserve the acquirer's start-date-first stop-date convention.
    COALESCE(
        n.encounter_start_datetime::DATE,
        n.encounter_stop_datetime::DATE
    ) AS encounter_stop_date,
    n.patient_id::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
    n.organization_id::VARCHAR AS organization_id,
    COALESCE(n.direct_provider_id, p.provider_id)::VARCHAR AS provider_id,
    NULL::VARCHAR AS payer_id,
    (
        CASE
            WHEN n.encounter_code IN ('162673000', '185349003', '410620009')
                THEN 'wellness'
            WHEN n.encounter_code = '702927004'
                THEN 'urgentcare'
            WHEN n.encounter_code = '308335008'
                THEN 'outpatient'
            WHEN upper(n.class_code) = 'AMB' THEN 'ambulatory'
            WHEN upper(n.class_code) = 'EMER' THEN 'emergency'
            WHEN upper(n.class_code) IN ('IMP', 'ACUTE', 'NONAC') THEN 'inpatient'
            WHEN upper(n.class_code) = 'OBSENC' THEN 'observation'
            WHEN upper(n.class_code) = 'HH' THEN 'home'
            WHEN upper(n.class_code) = 'VR' THEN 'virtual'
            ELSE lower(n.class_code)
        END
    )::VARCHAR AS encounter_class,
    n.encounter_code::VARCHAR AS encounter_code,
    n.encounter_description::VARCHAR AS encounter_description,
    -- Neither encounter resources nor the provider table supplies financials.
    NULL::FLOAT AS base_encounter_cost,
    NULL::FLOAT AS total_encounter_cost,
    NULL::FLOAT AS encounter_payer_coverage,
    n.encounter_reason_code::VARCHAR AS encounter_reason_code,
    n.encounter_reason_description::VARCHAR AS encounter_reason_description
FROM normalized AS n
LEFT JOIN provider_lookup AS p
    ON n.organization_id = p.organization_id
    AND n.provider_name_key = p.provider_name_key
```

## Mapping hints
- start date is the first 10 characters of recordedDate (R4) or assertedDate (STU3); there is no stop date.
- patient is patient.reference without the urn:uuid: prefix. The resource has no encounter reference: use the patient's Encounter whose period.start equals that timestamp.
- code and description are code.coding[0]; system is SNOMED-CT or RxNorm according to the coding system URL; type is type; category is category[0].
- reaction 1 and 2 are reaction[0] and reaction[1]: manifestation[0].coding[0].code and .display, severity in upper case. Commas in text become spaces.
text:
```sql
WITH allergies AS (
    SELECT
        resource,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.recordedDate') AS recorded_at,
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.patient.reference'),
            '^urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) AS patient_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'allergyintolerance') }}
),
encounters AS (
    SELECT
        coalesce(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id)::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
            '^urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) AS patient_id,
        try_cast(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS start_at
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}
)
SELECT
    try_cast(substr(a.recorded_at, 1, 10) AS DATE) AS allergy_start_date,
    cast(NULL AS DATE) AS allergy_stop_date,
    a.patient_id::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
    e.encounter_id::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
    json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS allergy_code,
    CASE json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].system')
        WHEN 'http://snomed.info/sct' THEN 'SNOMED-CT'
        WHEN 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm' THEN 'RxNorm'
        ELSE json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].system')
    END::VARCHAR AS allergy_code_system,
    replace(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
        ',', ' '
    ) AS allergy_description,
    json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.type') AS allergy_type,
    json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.category[0]') AS allergy_category,
    json_extract_string(
        a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].code'
    ) AS reaction_1_code,
    replace(
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'
        ),
        ',', ' '
    ) AS reaction_1_description,
    upper(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[0].severity')
    ) AS reaction_1_severity,
    json_extract_string(
        a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].code'
    ) AS reaction_2_code,
    replace(
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'
        ),
        ',', ' '
    ) AS reaction_2_description,
    upper(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[1].severity')
    ) AS reaction_2_severity
FROM allergies AS a
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    -- Resolve timestamp ties deterministically without multiplying source rows.
    SELECT encounter_id
    FROM encounters AS candidate
    WHERE candidate.patient_id = a.patient_id
      AND candidate.start_at = try_cast(a.recorded_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
    ORDER BY encounter_id
    LIMIT 1
) AS e ON TRUE
```

## Mapping hints
- One row per value: an Observation with component[] gives one row per component (code and value from the component, date, patient, encounter and category from the parent); an Observation without components gives one row.
- date is effectiveDateTime (UTC); patient is subject.reference, the encounter is encounter.reference (R4) or context.reference (STU3), without the urn:uuid: prefix; category is category[0].coding[0].code.
- A valueQuantity gives type numeric, units = valueQuantity.unit and the value as text with exactly one decimal digit (163.34 is written 163.3, 71 is written 71.0). Other values give type text: the display of valueCodeableConcept.coding[0], or valueString.
- In DuckDB write (x->'$.path') IS NULL with the parentheses. Commas in text become spaces.
text:
```sql
WITH expanded AS (
    SELECT
        o.resource AS parent_resource,
        COALESCE(c.value, o.resource) AS value_resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'observation') }} AS o
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL json_each(o.resource, '$.component') AS c
        ON TRUE
),

extracted AS (
    SELECT
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            TRY_CAST(
                json_extract_string(parent_resource, '$.effectiveDateTime')
                AS TIMESTAMPTZ
            )
        ) AS observation_datetime,
        json_extract_string(parent_resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_reference,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(parent_resource, '$.encounter.reference'),
            json_extract_string(parent_resource, '$.context.reference')
        ) AS encounter_reference,
        json_extract_string(
            parent_resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code'
        ) AS observation_category,
        json_extract_string(
            value_resource, '$.code.coding[0].code'
        ) AS observation_code,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(value_resource, '$.code.text'),
            json_extract_string(value_resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
        ) AS observation_description,
        CASE
            WHEN (value_resource->'$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL
                THEN printf(
                    '%.1f',
                    TRY_CAST(
                        json_extract_string(value_resource, '$.valueQuantity.value')
                        AS DOUBLE
                    )
                )
            ELSE COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(
                    value_resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display'
                ),
                json_extract_string(value_resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text'),
                json_extract_string(value_resource, '$.valueString')
            )
        END AS observation_value,
        json_extract_string(
            value_resource, '$.valueQuantity.unit'
        ) AS observation_units,
        CASE
            WHEN (value_resource->'$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL THEN 'numeric'
            ELSE 'text'
        END AS observation_value_type
    FROM expanded
)

SELECT
    observation_datetime,
    CAST(observation_datetime AS DATE) AS observation_date,
    regexp_replace(
        regexp_replace(patient_reference, '^urn:uuid:', ''),
        '^(.*/)?Patient/',
        ''
    ) AS patient_id,
    regexp_replace(
        regexp_replace(encounter_reference, '^urn:uuid:', ''),
        '^(.*/)?Encounter/',
        ''
    ) AS encounter_id,
    observation_category,
    observation_code,
    replace(observation_description, ',', ' ') AS observation_description,
    replace(observation_value, ',', ' ') AS observation_value,
    replace(observation_units, ',', ' ') AS observation_units,
    observation_value_type
FROM extracted
```

```sql
with resources as (
    select id, resource
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'patient') }}
),

selected as (
    select
        r.*,
        (
            select i.value
            from json_each(r.resource, '$.identifier') as i
            where json_extract_string(i.value, '$.system')
                = 'https://github.com/synthetichealth/synthea'
            order by try_cast(i.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as synthea_identifier,
        (
            select n.value
            from json_each(r.resource, '$.name') as n
            where coalesce(json_extract_string(n.value, '$.use'), '') <> 'maiden'
            order by
                case json_extract_string(n.value, '$.use')
                    when 'official' then 0
                    when 'usual' then 1
                    else 2
                end,
                try_cast(n.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as official_name,
        (
            select json_extract_string(n.value, '$.family')
            from json_each(r.resource, '$.name') as n
            where json_extract_string(n.value, '$.use') = 'maiden'
            order by try_cast(n.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as maiden_family,
        (
            select a.value
            from json_each(r.resource, '$.address') as a
            order by
                case json_extract_string(a.value, '$.use')
                    when 'home' then 0
                    when 'old' then 2
                    else 1
                end,
                try_cast(a.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as patient_address_json,
        (
            select e.value
            from json_each(r.resource, '$.extension') as e
            where json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race'
            order by try_cast(e.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as race_extension,
        (
            select e.value
            from json_each(r.resource, '$.extension') as e
            where json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity'
            order by try_cast(e.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as ethnicity_extension,
        (
            select json_extract(e.value, '$.valueAddress')
            from json_each(r.resource, '$.extension') as e
            where json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/patient-birthPlace'
            order by try_cast(e.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as birthplace_address,
        (
            select json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value')
            from json_each(r.resource, '$.identifier') as i
            where json_extract_string(i.value, '$.system') = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/us-ssn'
                or exists (
                    select 1
                    from json_each(i.value, '$.type.coding') as c
                    where json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') = 'SS'
                )
            order by try_cast(i.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as ssn_value,
        (
            select json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value')
            from json_each(r.resource, '$.identifier') as i
            where exists (
                select 1
                from json_each(i.value, '$.type.coding') as c
                where json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') = 'DL'
            )
            order by try_cast(i.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as drivers_value,
        (
            select json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value')
            from json_each(r.resource, '$.identifier') as i
            where json_extract_string(i.value, '$.system')
                    = 'http://standardhealthrecord.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/passportNumber'
                or exists (
                    select 1
                    from json_each(i.value, '$.type.coding') as c
                    where json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') = 'PPN'
                )
            order by try_cast(i.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as passport_value,
        (
            select json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code')
            from json_each(r.resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding') as c
            where json_extract_string(c.value, '$.system')
                = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-MaritalStatus'
            order by try_cast(c.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as marital_code
    from resources as r

            select json_extract_string(e.value, '$.valueCoding.code')
            from json_each(s.race_extension, '$.extension') as e
            where json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
            order by try_cast(e.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as race_code,
        (
            select json_extract_string(e.value, '$.valueCoding.code')
            from json_each(s.ethnicity_extension, '$.extension') as e
            where json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
            order by try_cast(e.key as integer)
            limit 1

        (

            where json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')

        id
    ) as varchar) as patient_id,
    try_cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.birthDate') as date) as birth_date,
    cast(
        try_cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime') as timestamptz)
            at time zone 'UTC'
        as date
    ) as death_date,
    cast(ssn_value as varchar) as ssn,
    cast(drivers_value as varchar) as drivers_license_number,
    cast(passport_value as varchar) as passport_number,
    cast(json_extract_string(official_name, '$.prefix[0]') as varchar) as patient_prefix,
    cast(json_extract_string(official_name, '$.given[0]') as varchar) as patient_first_name,
    cast(json_extract_string(official_name, '$.family') as varchar) as patient_last_name,
    cast(json_extract_string(official_name, '$.suffix[0]') as varchar) as patient_suffix,
    cast(maiden_family as varchar) as maiden_name,
    cast(
        case coalesce(marital_code, json_extract_string(resource, '$.maritalStatus.text'))
            when 'M' then 'M'
            when 'S' then 'S'
            when 'N' then 'S'
        end
        as varchar
    ) as marital_status,
    cast(
        case race_code
            when '1002-5' then 'native'
            when '2028-9' then 'asian'
            when '2054-5' then 'black'
            when '2076-8' then 'hawaiian'
            when '2106-3' then 'white'
            when '2131-1' then 'other'
        end
        as varchar
    ) as race,
    cast(
        case ethnicity_code
            when '2135-2' then 'hispanic'
            when '2186-5' then 'nonhispanic'
        end
        as varchar
    ) as ethnicity,
    cast(
        case json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender')
            when 'male' then 'M'
            when 'female' then 'F'
        end
        as varchar
    ) as patient_gender,
    cast(
        nullif(
            concat_ws(
                '  ',
                nullif(json_extract_string(birthplace_address, '$.city'), ''),
                coalesce(
                    (
                        select m.state_name
                        from {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} as m
                        where lower(m.state_abbreviation) = lower(d.birth_state)
                            or lower(m.state_name) = lower(d.birth_state)
                        order by m.state_name
                        limit 1
                    ),
                    nullif(birth_state, '')
                ),
                nullif(json_extract_string(birthplace_address, '$.country'), '')
            ),
            ''
        ) as varchar
    ) as birthplace,
    cast(
        (
            select string_agg(json_extract_string(l.value, '$'), ' ' order by try_cast(l.key as integer))
            from json_each(d.patient_address_json, '$.line') as l
        ) as varchar
    ) as patient_address,
    cast(json_extract_string(patient_address_json, '$.city') as varchar) as patient_city,
    cast(
        coalesce(
            (
                select m.state_name
                from {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} as m
                where lower(m.state_abbreviation) = lower(d.address_state)
                    or lower(m.state_name) = lower(d.address_state)
                order by m.state_name
                limit 1
            ),
            address_state
        ) as varchar
    ) as patient_state,
    cast(json_extract_string(patient_address_json, '$.district') as varchar) as patient_county,
    cast(json_extract_string(patient_address_json, '$.postalCode') as varchar) as patient_zip,
    (
        select try_cast(json_extract_string(e.value, '$.valueDecimal') as float)
        from json_each(d.geolocation, '$.extension') as e
        where json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url') = 'latitude'
        order by try_cast(e.key as integer)
        limit 1
    ) as patient_latitude,
    (
        select try_cast(json_extract_string(e.value, '$.valueDecimal') as float)
        from json_each(d.geolocation, '$.extension') as e
        where json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url') = 'longitude'
        order by try_cast(e.key as integer)
        limit 1
    ) as patient_longitude,
    cast(null as float) as healthcare_expenses,
    cast(null as float) as healthcare_coverage
```
