## Mapping hints
- patient_id is the resource id. birth_date is birthDate. death_date is the first 10 characters of deceasedDateTime (the local date).
- ssn, drivers licence and passport are identifier[] entries whose type.coding[0].code is SS, DL and PPN.
- Names come from the name[] entry with use = official (prefix[0], given[0], family, suffix[0]); the maiden name is the family of the entry with use = maiden.
- marital status is maritalStatus.coding[0].code. gender: male becomes M, female becomes F.
- race is the ombCategory display of the us-core-race extension, written as the acquirer writes it: White = white, Black or African American = black, Asian = asian, American Indian or Alaska Native = native, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander = hawaiian, anything else = other. ethnicity: Hispanic or Latino = hispanic, otherwise nonhispanic.
- birthplace is city, state and country of the birthPlace extension joined by two spaces.
- address is address[0].line[0]; city and postalCode as given; the state is an abbreviation and the acquirer stores the full name (stg_map__states); latitude and longitude are in the geolocation extension of address[0].
- The county and the two healthcare amounts are not in the resource: return NULL.

```sql
            select json_extract(e.value, '$.valueAddress')
            from json_each(resource, '$.extension') as e
            where json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/patient-birthPlace'
            order by cast(e.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as birth_address,
        json_extract(resource, '$.address[0]') as home_address
    from resources
),

extracted as (
    select
        *,
        (
            select json_extract_string(e.value, '$.valueCoding.display')
            from json_each(race_extension, '$.extension') as e
            where json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
            order by cast(e.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as race_display,
        (
            select json_extract_string(e.value, '$.valueCoding.display')
            from json_each(ethnicity_extension, '$.extension') as e
            where json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
            order by cast(e.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as ethnicity_display,
        (
            select e.value
            from json_each(home_address, '$.extension') as e
            where json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation'
            order by cast(e.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as geolocation
    from selected_elements
)

select
    json_extract_string(resource, '$.id') as patient_id,
    try_cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.birthDate') as date) as birth_date,
    cast(
        try_cast(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime')
            as timestamp with time zone
        ) at time zone 'UTC'
        as date
    ) as death_date,
    cast(ssn as varchar) as ssn,
    cast(drivers_license_number as varchar) as drivers_license_number,
    cast(passport_number as varchar) as passport_number,
    json_extract_string(official_name, '$.prefix[0]') as patient_prefix,
    json_extract_string(official_name, '$.given[0]') as patient_first_name,
    json_extract_string(official_name, '$.family') as patient_last_name,
    json_extract_string(official_name, '$.suffix[0]') as patient_suffix,
    cast(maiden_name as varchar) as maiden_name,
    json_extract_string(resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code') as marital_status,
    case race_display
        when 'White' then 'white'
        when 'Black or African American' then 'black'
        when 'Asian' then 'asian'
        when 'American Indian or Alaska Native' then 'native'
        when 'Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander' then 'hawaiian'
        else 'other'
    end as race,
    case ethnicity_display
        when 'Hispanic or Latino' then 'hispanic'
        else 'nonhispanic'
    end as ethnicity,
    case json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender')
        when 'male' then 'M'
        when 'female' then 'F'
        else cast(null as varchar)
    end as patient_gender,
    nullif(
        concat_ws(
            '  ',
            json_extract_string(birth_address, '$.city'),
            json_extract_string(birth_address, '$.state'),
            json_extract_string(birth_address, '$.country')
        ),
        ''
    ) as birthplace,
    json_extract_string(home_address, '$.line[0]') as patient_address,
    json_extract_string(home_address, '$.city') as patient_city,
    coalesce(
        (
            select cast(s.state_name as varchar)
            from {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} as s
            where upper(s.state_abbreviation)
                = upper(json_extract_string(home_address, '$.state'))
            order by s.state_name
            limit 1
        ),
        json_extract_string(home_address, '$.state')
    ) as patient_state,
    cast(null as varchar) as patient_county,
    json_extract_string(home_address, '$.postalCode') as patient_zip,
    try_cast(
        (
            select json_extract_string(e.value, '$.valueDecimal')
            from json_each(geolocation, '$.extension') as e
            where json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url') = 'latitude'
            order by cast(e.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as float
    ) as patient_latitude,
    try_cast(
        (
            select json_extract_string(e.value, '$.valueDecimal')
            from json_each(geolocation, '$.extension') as e
            where json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url') = 'longitude'
            order by cast(e.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as float
    ) as patient_longitude,
    cast(null as float) as healthcare_expenses,
    cast(null as float) as healthcare_coverage
from extracted
```

```sql
WITH extracted AS (
    SELECT
        p.id AS raw_id,
        p.resource,
        (
            SELECT i.value ->> 'value'
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.identifier') AS i
            WHERE i.value ->> 'system' = 'https://github.com/synthetichealth/synthea'
            ORDER BY CAST(i.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS synthea_id,
        (
            SELECT i.value ->> 'value'
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.identifier') AS i
            WHERE i.value ->> 'system' = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/us-ssn'
               OR EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM json_each(i.value, '$.type.coding') AS c
                    WHERE c.value ->> 'code' = 'SS'
               )
            ORDER BY CAST(i.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS ssn,
        (
            SELECT i.value ->> 'value'
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.identifier') AS i
            WHERE EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM json_each(i.value, '$.type.coding') AS c
                WHERE c.value ->> 'code' = 'DL'
            )
            ORDER BY CAST(i.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS drivers_license_number,
        (
            SELECT i.value ->> 'value'
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.identifier') AS i
            WHERE i.value ->> 'system'
                    = 'http://standardhealthrecord.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/passportNumber'
               OR EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM json_each(i.value, '$.type.coding') AS c
                    WHERE c.value ->> 'code' = 'PPN'
               )
            ORDER BY CAST(i.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS passport_number,
        (
            SELECT n.value
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.name') AS n
            WHERE COALESCE(n.value ->> 'use', '') NOT IN ('maiden', 'old')
            ORDER BY
                CASE WHEN n.value ->> 'use' = 'official' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                CAST(n.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS patient_name,
        (
            SELECT n.value ->> 'family'
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.name') AS n
            WHERE n.value ->> 'use' = 'maiden'
            ORDER BY CAST(n.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS maiden_name,
        (
            SELECT a.value
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.address') AS a
            ORDER BY
                CASE
                    WHEN a.value ->> 'use' = 'home' THEN 0
                    WHEN a.value ->> 'use' = 'old' THEN 2
                    ELSE 1
                END,
                CAST(a.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS patient_address_json,
        (
            SELECT e.value
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE e.value ->> 'url'
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS race_extension,
        (
            SELECT e.value
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE e.value ->> 'url'
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS ethnicity_extension,
        (
            SELECT json_extract(e.value, '$.valueAddress')
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE e.value ->> 'url'
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/patient-birthPlace'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS birthplace_address,
        (
            SELECT c.value ->> 'code'
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding') AS c
            ORDER BY
                CASE
                    WHEN c.value ->> 'system'
                        = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-MaritalStatus'
                    THEN 0 ELSE 1
                END,
                CAST(c.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS marital_code
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'patient') }} AS p
),
coded AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        (
            SELECT e.value ->> '$.valueCoding.code'
            FROM json_each(race_extension, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE e.value ->> 'url' = 'ombCategory'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS race_code,
        (
            SELECT e.value ->> '$.valueCoding.code'
            FROM json_each(ethnicity_extension, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE e.value ->> 'url' = 'ombCategory'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS ethnicity_code,
        (
            SELECT e.value
            FROM json_each(patient_address_json, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE e.value ->> 'url'
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS geolocation
    FROM extracted
)
SELECT
    CAST(
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(synthea_id, ''),
            NULLIF(resource ->> 'id', ''),
            raw_id
        ) AS VARCHAR
    ) AS patient_id,
    TRY_CAST(resource ->> 'birthDate' AS DATE) AS birth_date,
    CAST(
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            TRY_CAST(resource ->> 'deceasedDateTime' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
        ) AS DATE
    ) AS death_date,
    CAST(ssn AS VARCHAR) AS ssn,
    CAST(drivers_license_number AS VARCHAR) AS drivers_license_number,
    CAST(passport_number AS VARCHAR) AS passport_number,
    CAST(patient_name ->> '$.prefix[0]' AS VARCHAR) AS patient_prefix,
    CAST(patient_name ->> '$.given[0]' AS VARCHAR) AS patient_first_name,
    CAST(patient_name ->> 'family' AS VARCHAR) AS patient_last_name,
    CAST(patient_name ->> '$.suffix[0]' AS VARCHAR) AS patient_suffix,
    CAST(maiden_name AS VARCHAR) AS maiden_name,
    CAST(
        CASE COALESCE(marital_code, resource ->> '$.maritalStatus.text')
            WHEN 'M' THEN 'M'
            WHEN 'S' THEN 'S'
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS marital_status,
    CAST(
        CASE race_code
            WHEN '1002-5' THEN 'native'
            WHEN '2028-9' THEN 'asian'
            WHEN '2054-5' THEN 'black'
            WHEN '2076-8' THEN 'hawaiian'
            WHEN '2106-3' THEN 'white'
            WHEN '2131-1' THEN 'other'
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS race,
    CAST(
        CASE ethnicity_code
            WHEN '2135-2' THEN 'hispanic'
            WHEN '2186-5' THEN 'nonhispanic'
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS ethnicity,
    CAST(
        CASE resource ->> 'gender'
            WHEN 'male' THEN 'M'
            WHEN 'female' THEN 'F'
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS patient_gender,
    CAST(
        NULLIF(
            concat_ws(
                '  ',
                NULLIF(birthplace_address ->> 'city', ''),
                NULLIF(birthplace_address ->> 'state', ''),
                NULLIF(birthplace_address ->> 'country', '')
            ),
            ''
        ) AS VARCHAR
    ) AS birthplace,
    CAST(
        (
            SELECT string_agg(
                json_extract_string(l.value, '$'),
                ' ' ORDER BY CAST(l.key AS INTEGER)
            )
            FROM json_each(patient_address_json, '$.line') AS l
        ) AS VARCHAR
    ) AS patient_address,
    CAST(patient_address_json ->> 'city' AS VARCHAR) AS patient_city,
    CAST(
        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT s.state_name
                FROM {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} AS s
                WHERE lower(s.state_abbreviation)
                        = lower(patient_address_json ->> 'state')
                   OR lower(s.state_name)
                        = lower(patient_address_json ->> 'state')
                ORDER BY s.state_name
                LIMIT 1
            ),
            patient_address_json ->> 'state'
        ) AS VARCHAR
    ) AS patient_state,
    CAST(patient_address_json ->> 'district' AS VARCHAR) AS patient_county,
    CAST(patient_address_json ->> 'postalCode' AS VARCHAR) AS patient_zip,
    TRY_CAST(
        (
            SELECT e.value ->> 'valueDecimal'
            FROM json_each(geolocation, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE e.value ->> 'url' = 'latitude'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS FLOAT
    ) AS patient_latitude,
    TRY_CAST(
        (
            SELECT e.value ->> 'valueDecimal'
            FROM json_each(geolocation, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE e.value ->> 'url' = 'longitude'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS FLOAT
    ) AS patient_longitude,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_expenses,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_coverage
FROM coded
```

```sql
                OR EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM json_each(i.value, '$.type.coding') AS c
                    WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') = 'PPN'
                )
            ORDER BY CAST(i.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS passport_number,
        (
            SELECT n.value
            FROM json_each(resource, '$.name') AS n
            WHERE COALESCE(json_extract_string(n.value, '$.use'), '')
                NOT IN ('maiden', 'old')
            ORDER BY
                CASE json_extract_string(n.value, '$.use')
                    WHEN 'official' THEN 0
                    WHEN 'usual' THEN 1
                    ELSE 2
                END,
                CAST(n.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS patient_name,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(n.value, '$.family')
            FROM json_each(resource, '$.name') AS n
            WHERE json_extract_string(n.value, '$.use') = 'maiden'
            ORDER BY CAST(n.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS maiden_name,
        (
            SELECT a.value
            FROM json_each(resource, '$.address') AS a
            ORDER BY
                CASE json_extract_string(a.value, '$.use')
                    WHEN 'home' THEN 0
                    WHEN 'old' THEN 2
                    ELSE 1
                END,
                CAST(a.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS patient_address_json,
        (
            SELECT e.value
            FROM json_each(resource, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS race_extension,
        (
            SELECT e.value
            FROM json_each(resource, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS ethnicity_extension,
        (
            SELECT json_extract(e.value, '$.valueAddress')
            FROM json_each(resource, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/patient-birthPlace'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS birthplace_address,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code')
            FROM json_each(resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding') AS c
            WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.system')
                = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-MaritalStatus'
            ORDER BY CAST(c.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS marital_code
    FROM resources
),

decoded AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(e.value, '$.valueCoding.code')
            FROM json_each(race_extension, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS race_code,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(e.value, '$.valueCoding.code')
            FROM json_each(ethnicity_extension, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS ethnicity_code,
        (
            SELECT e.value
            FROM json_each(patient_address_json, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS geolocation,
        json_extract_string(patient_address_json, '$.state') AS address_state
    FROM selected
)

SELECT
    CAST(
        COALESCE(
            synthea_id,
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'),
            id
        ) AS VARCHAR
    ) AS patient_id,
    TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.birthDate') AS DATE) AS birth_date,
    CAST(
        TRY_CAST(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime') AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS DATE
    ) AS death_date,
    CAST(ssn AS VARCHAR) AS ssn,
    CAST(drivers_license_number AS VARCHAR) AS drivers_license_number,
    CAST(passport_number AS VARCHAR) AS passport_number,
    json_extract_string(patient_name, '$.prefix[0]') AS patient_prefix,
    json_extract_string(patient_name, '$.given[0]') AS patient_first_name,
    json_extract_string(patient_name, '$.family') AS patient_last_name,
    json_extract_string(patient_name, '$.suffix[0]') AS patient_suffix,
    CAST(maiden_name AS VARCHAR) AS maiden_name,
    CAST(
        CASE COALESCE(
            marital_code,
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.maritalStatus.text')
        )
            WHEN 'M' THEN 'M'
            WHEN 'S' THEN 'S'
            WHEN 'Never Married' THEN 'S'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS marital_status,
    CAST(
        CASE race_code
            WHEN '1002-5' THEN 'native'
            WHEN '2028-9' THEN 'asian'
            WHEN '2054-5' THEN 'black'
            WHEN '2076-8' THEN 'hawaiian'
            WHEN '2106-3' THEN 'white'
            WHEN '2131-1' THEN 'other'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS race,
    CAST(
        CASE ethnicity_code
            WHEN '2135-2' THEN 'hispanic'
            WHEN '2186-5' THEN 'nonhispanic'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS ethnicity,
    CAST(
        CASE json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender')
            WHEN 'male' THEN 'M'
            WHEN 'female' THEN 'F'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS patient_gender,
    NULLIF(
        CONCAT_WS(
            '  ',
            NULLIF(json_extract_string(birthplace_address, '$.city'), ''),
            NULLIF(json_extract_string(birthplace_address, '$.state'), ''),
            NULLIF(json_extract_string(birthplace_address, '$.country'), '')
        ),
        ''
    ) AS birthplace,
    (
        SELECT STRING_AGG(
            json_extract_string(l.value, '$'),
            ' ' ORDER BY CAST(l.key AS INTEGER)
        )
        FROM json_each(patient_address_json, '$.line') AS l
    ) AS patient_address,
    json_extract_string(patient_address_json, '$.city') AS patient_city,
    CAST(
        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT s.state_name
                FROM {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} AS s
                WHERE LOWER(TRIM(s.state_abbreviation)) = LOWER(TRIM(address_state))
                    OR LOWER(TRIM(s.state_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(address_state))
                ORDER BY s.state_name
                LIMIT 1
            ),
            address_state
        ) AS VARCHAR
    ) AS patient_state,
    json_extract_string(patient_address_json, '$.district') AS patient_county,
    json_extract_string(patient_address_json, '$.postalCode') AS patient_zip,
    TRY_CAST(
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(e.value, '$.valueDecimal')
            FROM json_each(geolocation, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url') = 'latitude'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS FLOAT
    ) AS patient_latitude,
    TRY_CAST(
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(e.value, '$.valueDecimal')
            FROM json_each(geolocation, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url') = 'longitude'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS FLOAT
    ) AS patient_longitude,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_expenses,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_coverage
FROM decoded
```

```sql
            when '2076-8' then 'hawaiian'
            when '2106-3' then 'white'
            when '2131-1' then 'other'

    ) as ethnicity,

            ),
            json_extract_string(birthplace_address, '$.country')
```

## Mapping hints
- patient_id is the resource id. birth_date is birthDate. death_date is the first 10 characters of deceasedDateTime (the local date).
- ssn, drivers licence and passport are identifier[] entries whose type.coding[0].code is SS, DL and PPN.
- Names come from the name[] entry with use = official (prefix[0], given[0], family, suffix[0]); the maiden name is the family of the entry with use = maiden.
- marital status is maritalStatus.coding[0].code. gender: male becomes M, female becomes F.
- race is the ombCategory display of the us-core-race extension, written as the acquirer writes it: White = white, Black or African American = black, Asian = asian, American Indian or Alaska Native = native, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander = hawaiian, anything else = other. ethnicity: Hispanic or Latino = hispanic, otherwise nonhispanic.
- birthplace is city, state and country of the birthPlace extension joined by two spaces.
- address is address[0].line[0]; city and postalCode as given; the state is an abbreviation and the acquirer stores the full name (stg_map__states); latitude and longitude are in the geolocation extension of address[0].
- The county and the two healthcare amounts are not in the resource: return NULL.

```sql
WITH resources AS (
    SELECT resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'patient') }}
),

selected AS (
    SELECT
        resource,
        (
            SELECT n.value
            FROM json_each(resource, '$.name') AS n
            WHERE json_extract_string(n.value, '$.use') = 'official'
            ORDER BY CAST(n.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS official_name,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(n.value, '$.family')
            FROM json_each(resource, '$.name') AS n
            WHERE json_extract_string(n.value, '$.use') = 'maiden'
            ORDER BY CAST(n.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS maiden_name,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value')
            FROM json_each(resource, '$.identifier') AS i
            WHERE json_extract_string(i.value, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'SS'
            ORDER BY CAST(i.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS ssn,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value')
            FROM json_each(resource, '$.identifier') AS i
            WHERE json_extract_string(i.value, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'DL'
            ORDER BY CAST(i.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS drivers_license_number,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value')
            FROM json_each(resource, '$.identifier') AS i
            WHERE json_extract_string(i.value, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'PPN'
            ORDER BY CAST(i.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS passport_number,
        (
            SELECT e.value
            FROM json_each(resource, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS race_extension,
        (
            SELECT e.value
            FROM json_each(resource, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS ethnicity_extension,
        (
            SELECT json_extract(e.value, '$.valueAddress')
            FROM json_each(resource, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/patient-birthPlace'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS birth_address,
        json_extract(resource, '$.address[0]') AS patient_address_json
    FROM resources
),

details AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(e.value, '$.valueCoding.display')
            FROM json_each(race_extension, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS race_display,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(e.value, '$.valueCoding.display')
            FROM json_each(ethnicity_extension, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS ethnicity_display,
        (
            SELECT e.value
            FROM json_each(patient_address_json, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS geolocation
    FROM selected
)

SELECT
    json_extract_string(resource, '$.id') AS patient_id,
    TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.birthDate') AS DATE) AS birth_date,
    CAST(
        TRY_CAST(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime') AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
        AS DATE
    ) AS death_date,
    CAST(ssn AS VARCHAR) AS ssn,
    CAST(drivers_license_number AS VARCHAR) AS drivers_license_number,
    CAST(passport_number AS VARCHAR) AS passport_number,
    json_extract_string(official_name, '$.prefix[0]') AS patient_prefix,
    json_extract_string(official_name, '$.given[0]') AS patient_first_name,
    json_extract_string(official_name, '$.family') AS patient_last_name,
    json_extract_string(official_name, '$.suffix[0]') AS patient_suffix,
    CAST(maiden_name AS VARCHAR) AS maiden_name,
    json_extract_string(resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code') AS marital_status,
    CAST(
        CASE race_display
            WHEN 'White' THEN 'white'
            WHEN 'Black or African American' THEN 'black'
            WHEN 'Asian' THEN 'asian'
            WHEN 'American Indian or Alaska Native' THEN 'native'
            WHEN 'Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander' THEN 'hawaiian'
            ELSE 'other'
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS race,
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN ethnicity_display = 'Hispanic or Latino' THEN 'hispanic'
            ELSE 'nonhispanic'
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS ethnicity,
    CAST(
        CASE json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender')
            WHEN 'male' THEN 'M'
            WHEN 'female' THEN 'F'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS patient_gender,
    NULLIF(
        concat_ws(
            '  ',
            json_extract_string(birth_address, '$.city'),
            json_extract_string(birth_address, '$.state'),
            json_extract_string(birth_address, '$.country')
        ),
        ''
    ) AS birthplace,
    json_extract_string(patient_address_json, '$.line[0]') AS patient_address,
    json_extract_string(patient_address_json, '$.city') AS patient_city,
    CAST(
        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT s.state_name
                FROM {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} AS s
                WHERE upper(s.state_abbreviation)
                    = upper(json_extract_string(patient_address_json, '$.state'))
                    OR lower(s.state_name)
                    = lower(json_extract_string(patient_address_json, '$.state'))
                ORDER BY s.state_name
                LIMIT 1
            ),
            json_extract_string(patient_address_json, '$.state')
        ) AS VARCHAR
    ) AS patient_state,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_county,
    json_extract_string(patient_address_json, '$.postalCode') AS patient_zip,
    TRY_CAST(
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(e.value, '$.valueDecimal')
            FROM json_each(geolocation, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url') = 'latitude'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS FLOAT
    ) AS patient_latitude,
    TRY_CAST(
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(e.value, '$.valueDecimal')
            FROM json_each(geolocation, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url') = 'longitude'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS FLOAT
    ) AS patient_longitude,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_expenses,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_coverage
FROM details
```

```sql
WITH extracted AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id)::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
        ) AS start_datetime,
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end') AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
        ) AS stop_datetime,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference') AS organization_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') AS class_code,
        participant.provider_reference,
        participant.provider_display,
        encounter_type.code AS encounter_code,
        COALESCE(
            encounter_type.display,
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].text')
        ) AS encounter_description,
        reason.code AS encounter_reason_code,
        COALESCE(
            reason.display,
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].text')
        ) AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }} AS e
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            json_extract_string(p.value, '$.individual.reference') AS provider_reference,
            json_extract_string(p.value, '$.individual.display') AS provider_display
        FROM json_each(e.resource, '$.participant') AS p
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM json_each(p.value, '$.type') AS t,
                     json_each(t.value, '$.coding') AS c
                WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') = 'PPRF'
            ) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
            TRY_CAST(p.key AS INTEGER)
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS participant ON TRUE
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') AS code,
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.display') AS display
        FROM json_each(e.resource, '$.type') AS t,
             json_each(t.value, '$.coding') AS c
        WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
        ORDER BY TRY_CAST(t.key AS INTEGER), TRY_CAST(c.key AS INTEGER)
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS encounter_type ON TRUE
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') AS code,
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.display') AS display
        FROM json_each(e.resource, '$.reasonCode') AS r,
             json_each(r.value, '$.coding') AS c
        WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
        ORDER BY TRY_CAST(r.key AS INTEGER), TRY_CAST(c.key AS INTEGER)
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS reason ON TRUE
),
normalized AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN patient_reference LIKE 'urn:uuid:%'
                THEN substr(patient_reference, 10)
            WHEN contains(patient_reference, '?identifier=')
                THEN NULLIF(regexp_extract(patient_reference, '\|([^&]+)', 1), '')
            ELSE NULLIF(
                regexp_extract(patient_reference, '(?:^|/)Patient/([^/?#]+)', 1),
                ''
            )
        END::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
        CASE
            WHEN organization_reference LIKE 'urn:uuid:%'
                THEN substr(organization_reference, 10)
            WHEN contains(organization_reference, '?identifier=')
                THEN NULLIF(regexp_extract(organization_reference, '\|([^&]+)', 1), '')
            ELSE NULLIF(
                regexp_extract(organization_reference, '(?:^|/)Organization/([^/?#]+)', 1),
                ''
            )
        END::VARCHAR AS organization_id,
        CASE
            WHEN provider_reference LIKE 'urn:uuid:%'
                THEN substr(provider_reference, 10)
            WHEN contains(
                provider_reference,
                '?identifier=https://github.com/synthetichealth/synthea|'
            )
                THEN NULLIF(regexp_extract(provider_reference, '\|([^&]+)', 1), '')
            WHEN NOT contains(provider_reference, '?')
                THEN NULLIF(
                    regexp_extract(provider_reference, '(?:^|/)Practitioner/([^/?#]+)', 1),
                    ''
                )
        END::VARCHAR AS direct_provider_id,
        lower(trim(regexp_replace(
            provider_display,
            '^Dr\.?\s+',
            '',
            'i'
        ))) AS provider_name
    FROM extracted
),
provider_lookup AS (
    -- NPI references cannot be converted to staging UUIDs from these tables.
    -- Resolve by name and organization only when that combination is unique.
    SELECT
        "ORGANIZATION" AS organization_id,
        lower(trim("NAME")) AS provider_name,
        CASE
            WHEN count(DISTINCT "Id") = 1 THEN min("Id")
        END::VARCHAR AS provider_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'providers') }}
    GROUP BY "ORGANIZATION", lower(trim("NAME"))
)
SELECT
    n.encounter_id::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
    n.start_datetime::TIMESTAMP AS encounter_start_datetime,
    n.start_datetime::DATE AS encounter_start_date,
    COALESCE(n.stop_datetime, n.start_datetime)::TIMESTAMP AS encounter_stop_datetime,
    -- Preserve the existing staging model's start-date-first convention.
    COALESCE(n.start_datetime::DATE, n.stop_datetime::DATE) AS encounter_stop_date,
    n.patient_id::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
    n.organization_id::VARCHAR AS organization_id,
    COALESCE(n.direct_provider_id, p.provider_id)::VARCHAR AS provider_id,
    NULL::VARCHAR AS payer_id,
    CASE upper(n.class_code)
        WHEN 'AMB' THEN 'ambulatory'
        WHEN 'IMP' THEN 'inpatient'
        WHEN 'ACUTE' THEN 'inpatient'
        WHEN 'NONAC' THEN 'inpatient'
        WHEN 'EMER' THEN 'emergency'
        WHEN 'OBSENC' THEN 'observation'
        WHEN 'PRENC' THEN 'pre-admission'
        WHEN 'SS' THEN 'short stay'
        WHEN 'HH' THEN 'home'
        WHEN 'VR' THEN 'virtual'
        ELSE lower(n.class_code)
    END::VARCHAR AS encounter_class,
    n.encounter_code::VARCHAR AS encounter_code,
    n.encounter_description::VARCHAR AS encounter_description,
    NULL::FLOAT AS base_encounter_cost,
    NULL::FLOAT AS total_encounter_cost,
    NULL::FLOAT AS encounter_payer_coverage,
    n.encounter_reason_code::VARCHAR AS encounter_reason_code,
    n.encounter_reason_description::VARCHAR AS encounter_reason_description
FROM normalized AS n
LEFT JOIN provider_lookup AS p
    ON n.organization_id = p.organization_id
   AND n.provider_name = p.provider_name
```

```sql
WITH extracted AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value')
                FROM json_each(e.resource, '$.identifier') AS i
                WHERE json_extract_string(i.value, '$.system')
                    = 'https://github.com/synthetichealth/synthea'
                ORDER BY
                    CASE WHEN json_extract_string(i.value, '$.use') = 'official'
                        THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                    TRY_CAST(i.key AS INTEGER)
                LIMIT 1
            ),
            json_extract_string(e.resource, '$.id'),
            e.id
        )::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(e.resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
        ) AS start_datetime,
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(e.resource, '$.period.end') AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
        ) AS stop_datetime,
        json_extract_string(e.resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_reference,
        json_extract_string(e.resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference') AS organization_reference,
        json_extract_string(e.resource, '$.class.code') AS class_code,
        (
            SELECT t.value
            FROM json_each(e.resource, '$.type') AS t
            ORDER BY
                CASE WHEN EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM json_each(t.value, '$.coding') AS c
                    WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
                ) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                TRY_CAST(t.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS encounter_type,
        (
            SELECT r.value
            FROM json_each(e.resource, '$.reasonCode') AS r
            WHERE EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM json_each(r.value, '$.coding') AS c
                WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
            )
            ORDER BY TRY_CAST(r.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS encounter_reason,
        (
            SELECT p.value
            FROM json_each(e.resource, '$.participant') AS p
            WHERE json_extract_string(p.value, '$.individual.reference') IS NOT NULL
            ORDER BY
                CASE WHEN EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM json_each(p.value, '$.type') AS t,
                         json_each(t.value, '$.coding') AS c
                    WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') = 'PPRF'
                ) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                TRY_CAST(p.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS participant
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }} AS e
),

decoded AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        (
            SELECT c.value
            FROM json_each(encounter_type, '$.coding') AS c
            WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
            ORDER BY TRY_CAST(c.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS type_coding,
        (
            SELECT c.value
            FROM json_each(encounter_reason, '$.coding') AS c
            WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
            ORDER BY TRY_CAST(c.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS reason_coding,
        json_extract_string(participant, '$.individual.reference') AS provider_reference,
        trim(regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(participant, '$.individual.display'),
            '^Dr[.]?[[:space:]]+',
            ''
        )) AS provider_name
    FROM extracted
),

normalized AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN patient_reference LIKE 'urn:uuid:%'
                THEN substr(patient_reference, 10)
            WHEN contains(patient_reference, '|')
                THEN split_part(patient_reference, '|', -1)
            ELSE NULLIF(regexp_extract(
                patient_reference, '(?:^|/)Patient/([^/?#]+)', 1
            ), '')
        END::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
        CASE
            WHEN organization_reference LIKE 'urn:uuid:%'
                THEN substr(organization_reference, 10)
            WHEN contains(organization_reference, '|')
                THEN split_part(organization_reference, '|', -1)
            ELSE NULLIF(regexp_extract(
                organization_reference, '(?:^|/)Organization/([^/?#]+)', 1
            ), '')
        END::VARCHAR AS organization_id,
        CASE
            WHEN provider_reference LIKE 'urn:uuid:%'
                THEN substr(provider_reference, 10)
            ELSE NULLIF(regexp_extract(
                provider_reference, '(?:^|/)Practitioner/([^/?#]+)', 1
            ), '')
        END::VARCHAR AS direct_provider_id
    FROM decoded
),

-- NPI search references cannot be used as the staging provider UUID.
-- Resolve them only when name and organization identify one raw provider.
provider_lookup AS (
    SELECT
        "ORGANIZATION" AS organization_id,
        lower(trim("NAME")) AS provider_name,
        min("Id")::VARCHAR AS provider_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'providers') }}
    GROUP BY "ORGANIZATION", lower(trim("NAME"))
    HAVING count(DISTINCT "Id") = 1
)

SELECT
    n.encounter_id,
    n.start_datetime::TIMESTAMP AS encounter_start_datetime,
    n.start_datetime::DATE AS encounter_start_date,
    COALESCE(n.stop_datetime, n.start_datetime)::TIMESTAMP AS encounter_stop_datetime,
    -- Preserve the acquirer's start-date-first stop-date convention.
    COALESCE(n.start_datetime::DATE, n.stop_datetime::DATE) AS encounter_stop_date,
    n.patient_id,
    n.organization_id,
    COALESCE(n.direct_provider_id, p.provider_id)::VARCHAR AS provider_id,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id,
    CASE
        WHEN upper(n.class_code) = 'AMB'
            AND json_extract_string(n.type_coding, '$.code')
                IN ('162673000', '185349003', '410620009')
            THEN 'wellness'
        WHEN upper(n.class_code) = 'AMB' THEN 'ambulatory'
        WHEN upper(n.class_code) = 'IMP' THEN 'inpatient'
        WHEN upper(n.class_code) = 'EMER' THEN 'emergency'
        WHEN upper(n.class_code) = 'ACUTE' THEN 'inpatient'
        WHEN upper(n.class_code) = 'NONAC' THEN 'inpatient'
        WHEN upper(n.class_code) = 'OBSENC' THEN 'outpatient'
        ELSE lower(n.class_code)
    END::VARCHAR AS encounter_class,
    json_extract_string(n.type_coding, '$.code')::VARCHAR AS encounter_code,
    COALESCE(
        json_extract_string(n.type_coding, '$.display'),
        json_extract_string(n.encounter_type, '$.text')
    )::VARCHAR AS encounter_description,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS base_encounter_cost,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS total_encounter_cost,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS encounter_payer_coverage,
    json_extract_string(n.reason_coding, '$.code')::VARCHAR AS encounter_reason_code,
    COALESCE(
        json_extract_string(n.reason_coding, '$.display'),
        json_extract_string(n.encounter_reason, '$.text')
    )::VARCHAR AS encounter_reason_description
FROM normalized AS n
LEFT JOIN provider_lookup AS p
    ON n.organization_id = p.organization_id
    AND lower(n.provider_name) = p.provider_name
```

```sql
WITH extracted AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id)::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
        (
            TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
            AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
        ) AS start_datetime,
        (
            TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end') AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
            AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
        ) AS stop_datetime,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference') AS organization_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') AS class_code,
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}
),

selected AS (
    SELECT
        e.*,
        participant.reference AS provider_reference,
        participant.display AS provider_display,
        encounter_type.code AS encounter_code,
        encounter_type.description AS encounter_description,
        reason.code AS encounter_reason_code,
        reason.description AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM extracted AS e
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            json_extract_string(p.value, '$.individual.reference') AS reference,
            json_extract_string(p.value, '$.individual.display') AS display
        FROM json_each(e.resource, '$.participant') AS p
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM json_each(p.value, '$.type') AS t,
                     LATERAL json_each(t.value, '$.coding') AS c
                WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') = 'PPRF'
            ) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
            TRY_CAST(p.key AS INTEGER)
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS participant ON TRUE
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') AS code,
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(c.value, '$.display'),
                json_extract_string(t.value, '$.text')
            ) AS description
        FROM json_each(e.resource, '$.type') AS t,
             LATERAL json_each(t.value, '$.coding') AS c
        ORDER BY
            CASE
                WHEN json_extract_string(c.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
                THEN 0 ELSE 1
            END,
            TRY_CAST(t.key AS INTEGER),
            TRY_CAST(c.key AS INTEGER)
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS encounter_type ON TRUE
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') AS code,
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(c.value, '$.display'),
                json_extract_string(r.value, '$.text')
            ) AS description
        FROM json_each(e.resource, '$.reasonCode') AS r,
             LATERAL json_each(r.value, '$.coding') AS c
        WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
        ORDER BY TRY_CAST(r.key AS INTEGER), TRY_CAST(c.key AS INTEGER)
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS reason ON TRUE
),

normalized AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        NULLIF(
            regexp_extract(
                patient_reference,
                '(?i)[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}'
            ),
            ''
        ) AS patient_id,
        NULLIF(
            regexp_extract(
                organization_reference,
                '(?i)[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}'
            ),
            ''
        ) AS organization_id,
        NULLIF(
            regexp_extract(
                provider_reference,
                '(?i)[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}'
            ),
            ''
        ) AS referenced_provider_id,
        lower(trim(regexp_replace(provider_display, '^Dr[.]?\s+', ''))) AS provider_name
    FROM selected
),

-- The provider extract has no NPI. Resolve identifier-search references
-- by organization and display name only when that combination is unambiguous.
provider_lookup AS (
    SELECT
        "ORGANIZATION" AS organization_id,
        lower(trim("NAME")) AS provider_name,
        min("Id") AS provider_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'providers') }}
    GROUP BY "ORGANIZATION", lower(trim("NAME"))
    HAVING count(DISTINCT "Id") = 1
)

SELECT
    n.encounter_id::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
    n.start_datetime::TIMESTAMP AS encounter_start_datetime,
    n.start_datetime::DATE AS encounter_start_date,
    COALESCE(n.stop_datetime, n.start_datetime)::TIMESTAMP AS encounter_stop_datetime,
    -- Preserve the acquirer's start-date-first stop-date convention.
    COALESCE(n.start_datetime::DATE, n.stop_datetime::DATE) AS encounter_stop_date,
    n.patient_id::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
    n.organization_id::VARCHAR AS organization_id,
    COALESCE(n.referenced_provider_id, p.provider_id)::VARCHAR AS provider_id,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id,
    (
        CASE
            WHEN upper(n.class_code) = 'AMB'
                 AND n.encounter_code IN ('162673000', '185349003')
                THEN 'wellness'
            WHEN upper(n.class_code) = 'AMB' THEN 'ambulatory'
            WHEN upper(n.class_code) = 'EMER' THEN 'emergency'
            WHEN upper(n.class_code) = 'IMP' THEN 'inpatient'
            WHEN upper(n.class_code) = 'OBSENC' THEN 'observation'
            WHEN upper(n.class_code) = 'SS' THEN 'shortstay'
            WHEN upper(n.class_code) = 'HH' THEN 'home'
            WHEN upper(n.class_code) = 'VR' THEN 'virtual'
            ELSE lower(n.class_code)
        END
    )::VARCHAR AS encounter_class,
    n.encounter_code::VARCHAR AS encounter_code,
    n.encounter_description::VARCHAR AS encounter_description,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS base_encounter_cost,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS total_encounter_cost,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS encounter_payer_coverage,
    n.encounter_reason_code::VARCHAR AS encounter_reason_code,
    n.encounter_reason_description::VARCHAR AS encounter_reason_description
FROM normalized AS n
LEFT JOIN provider_lookup AS p
    ON n.organization_id = p.organization_id
   AND n.provider_name = p.provider_name
```

- encounter_id is the resource id; the patient is subject.reference without the urn:uuid: prefix; start and stop are period.start and period.end (they carry a UTC offset; the contract wants UTC).

- encounter class: class.code EMER = emergency, IMP = inpatient; for AMB look at type[0].coding[0].code: 702927004 = urgentcare, 162673000 / 410620009 / 308646001 = wellness, otherwise ambulatory.
- code and description are type[0].coding[0].code and .display; the reason is reasonCode[0].coding[0] in R4 and reason[0].coding[0] in STU3.
- The acquirer's text has every comma replaced by a space. Payer and the three cost columns are not in the resource: return NULL.

```sql
WITH extracted AS (
    SELECT
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.id') AS encounter_id,
        CAST(
            TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
            AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP
        ) AS start_datetime,
        CAST(
            TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end') AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
            AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP
        ) AS stop_datetime,
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
            '^urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) AS patient_id,
        NULLIF(
            split_part(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference'),
                '|',
                2
            ),
            ''
        ) AS organization_id,
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.display'),
            '^Dr\. ',
            ''
        ) AS provider_name,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') AS class_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code') AS encounter_code,
        replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display'),
            ',',
            ' '
        ) AS encounter_description,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].code')
            AS encounter_reason_code,
        replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].display'),
            ',',
            ' '
        ) AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}
),
provider_lookup AS (
    -- Only resolve unambiguous name/organization matches, preserving source grain.
    SELECT
        "NAME" AS provider_name,
        "ORGANIZATION" AS organization_id,
        CASE
            WHEN count(DISTINCT "Id") = 1 THEN min("Id")
            ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)
        END AS provider_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'providers') }}
    GROUP BY "NAME", "ORGANIZATION"
)
SELECT
    e.encounter_id::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
    e.start_datetime::TIMESTAMP AS encounter_start_datetime,
    e.start_datetime::DATE AS encounter_start_date,
    coalesce(e.stop_datetime, e.start_datetime)::TIMESTAMP AS encounter_stop_datetime,
    coalesce(e.start_datetime::DATE, e.stop_datetime::DATE) AS encounter_stop_date,
    e.patient_id::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
    e.organization_id::VARCHAR AS organization_id,
    p.provider_id::VARCHAR AS provider_id,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id,
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN e.class_code = 'EMER' THEN 'emergency'
            WHEN e.class_code = 'IMP' THEN 'inpatient'
            WHEN e.class_code = 'AMB' THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN e.encounter_code = '702927004' THEN 'urgentcare'
                    WHEN e.encounter_code IN ('162673000', '410620009', '308646001')
                        THEN 'wellness'
                    ELSE 'ambulatory'
                END
            ELSE lower(e.class_code)
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS encounter_class,
    e.encounter_code::VARCHAR AS encounter_code,
    e.encounter_description::VARCHAR AS encounter_description,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS base_encounter_cost,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS total_encounter_cost,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS encounter_payer_coverage,
    e.encounter_reason_code::VARCHAR AS encounter_reason_code,
    e.encounter_reason_description::VARCHAR AS encounter_reason_description
FROM extracted AS e
LEFT JOIN provider_lookup AS p
    ON e.provider_name = p.provider_name
    AND e.organization_id = p.organization_id
```

```sql
WITH extracted AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value')
                FROM json_each(e.resource, '$.identifier') AS i
                WHERE json_extract_string(i.value, '$.system')
                    = 'https://github.com/synthetichealth/synthea'
                ORDER BY CAST(i.key AS INTEGER)
                LIMIT 1
            ),
            json_extract_string(e.resource, '$.id'),
            e.id
        )::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
        TRY_CAST(
            json_extract_string(e.resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS start_datetime,
        TRY_CAST(
            json_extract_string(e.resource, '$.period.end') AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS end_datetime,
        json_extract_string(e.resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_reference,
        json_extract_string(e.resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference') AS organization_reference,
        json_extract_string(e.resource, '$.class.code') AS class_code,
        encounter_type.code AS encounter_code,
        encounter_type.description AS encounter_description,
        reason.code AS encounter_reason_code,
        reason.description AS encounter_reason_description,
        participant.provider_reference,
        participant.provider_display
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }} AS e
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') AS code,
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(c.value, '$.display'),
                json_extract_string(t.value, '$.text')
            ) AS description
        FROM json_each(e.resource, '$.type') AS t,
             json_each(t.value, '$.coding') AS c
        WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
        ORDER BY CAST(t.key AS INTEGER), CAST(c.key AS INTEGER)
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS encounter_type ON TRUE
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') AS code,
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(c.value, '$.display'),
                json_extract_string(r.value, '$.text')
            ) AS description
        FROM json_each(e.resource, '$.reasonCode') AS r,
             json_each(r.value, '$.coding') AS c
        WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
        ORDER BY CAST(r.key AS INTEGER), CAST(c.key AS INTEGER)
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS reason ON TRUE
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            json_extract_string(p.value, '$.individual.reference') AS provider_reference,
            json_extract_string(p.value, '$.individual.display') AS provider_display
        FROM json_each(e.resource, '$.participant') AS p
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM json_each(p.value, '$.type') AS t,
                     json_each(t.value, '$.coding') AS c
                WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') = 'PPRF'
            ) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
            CAST(p.key AS INTEGER)
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS participant ON TRUE
),
normalized AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN patient_reference LIKE 'urn:uuid:%'
                THEN substr(patient_reference, 10)
            WHEN contains(patient_reference, '?identifier=')
                THEN NULLIF(regexp_extract(patient_reference, '\|([^&]+)', 1), '')
            ELSE NULLIF(
                regexp_extract(patient_reference, '(?:^|/)Patient/([^/?#]+)', 1), ''
            )
        END AS patient_id,
        CASE
            WHEN organization_reference LIKE 'urn:uuid:%'
                THEN substr(organization_reference, 10)
            WHEN contains(organization_reference, '?identifier=')
                THEN NULLIF(regexp_extract(organization_reference, '\|([^&]+)', 1), '')
            ELSE NULLIF(
                regexp_extract(
                    organization_reference, '(?:^|/)Organization/([^/?#]+)', 1
                ), ''
            )
        END AS organization_id,
        CASE
            WHEN provider_reference LIKE 'urn:uuid:%'
                THEN substr(provider_reference, 10)
            WHEN NOT contains(provider_reference, '?')
                THEN NULLIF(
                    regexp_extract(
                        provider_reference, '(?:^|/)Practitioner/([^/?#]+)', 1
                    ), ''
                )
        END AS direct_provider_id,
        trim(regexp_replace(provider_display, '^Dr\.?\s+', '')) AS provider_name,
        COALESCE(end_datetime, start_datetime) AS stop_datetime
    FROM extracted
),
provider_names AS (
    -- NPI search references cannot be resolved directly from this provider table.
    -- Use organization and name only when they identify one provider unambiguously.
    SELECT
        "ORGANIZATION" AS organization_id,
        trim("NAME") AS provider_name,
        min("Id") AS provider_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'providers') }}
    GROUP BY "ORGANIZATION", trim("NAME")
    HAVING count(DISTINCT "Id") = 1
)
SELECT
    n.encounter_id::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
    n.start_datetime::TIMESTAMP AS encounter_start_datetime,
    n.start_datetime::DATE AS encounter_start_date,
    n.stop_datetime::TIMESTAMP AS encounter_stop_datetime,
    -- Preserve the acquirer's start-date-first stop-date convention.
    COALESCE(n.start_datetime::DATE, n.stop_datetime::DATE) AS encounter_stop_date,
    n.patient_id::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
    n.organization_id::VARCHAR AS organization_id,
    COALESCE(n.direct_provider_id, p.provider_id)::VARCHAR AS provider_id,
    NULL::VARCHAR AS payer_id,
    CASE upper(n.class_code)
        WHEN 'AMB' THEN 'ambulatory'
        WHEN 'EMER' THEN 'emergency'
        WHEN 'IMP' THEN 'inpatient'
        WHEN 'ACUTE' THEN 'inpatient'
        WHEN 'NONAC' THEN 'inpatient'
        WHEN 'OBSENC' THEN 'observation'
        WHEN 'HH' THEN 'home'
        WHEN 'VR' THEN 'virtual'
        ELSE lower(n.class_code)
    END::VARCHAR AS encounter_class,
    n.encounter_code::VARCHAR AS encounter_code,
    n.encounter_description::VARCHAR AS encounter_description,
    NULL::FLOAT AS base_encounter_cost,
    NULL::FLOAT AS total_encounter_cost,
    NULL::FLOAT AS encounter_payer_coverage,
    n.encounter_reason_code::VARCHAR AS encounter_reason_code,
    n.encounter_reason_description::VARCHAR AS encounter_reason_description
FROM normalized AS n
LEFT JOIN provider_names AS p
    ON n.organization_id = p.organization_id
    AND n.provider_name = p.provider_name
```

```sql
WITH extracted AS (
    SELECT
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetDateTime') AS onset_datetime,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.abatementDateTime') AS abatement_datetime,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference') AS encounter_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text') AS code_text,
        json_extract(resource, '$.code.coding') AS codings
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'condition') }}
),
mapped AS (
    SELECT
        e.*,
        coding.condition_code,
        coding.condition_display
    FROM extracted AS e
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') AS condition_code,
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.display') AS condition_display
        FROM json_each(e.codings) AS c
        WHERE NULLIF(json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code'), '') IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY
            CASE
                WHEN json_extract_string(c.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
                    THEN 0
                ELSE 1
            END,
            TRY_CAST(c.key AS INTEGER)
        LIMIT 1

)

                regexp_replace(encounter_reference, '/_history/[^/]+/?$', ''),
                '^.*/',
                ''
            )
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS encounter_id,
    CAST(condition_code AS VARCHAR) AS condition_code,
    CAST(

        AS VARCHAR
    ) AS condition_description
FROM mapped
```

```sql
WITH extracted AS (
    SELECT
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetDateTime') AS onset_datetime,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.abatementDateTime') AS abatement_datetime,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_reference,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference')
        ) AS encounter_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS condition_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display') AS condition_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'condition') }}
)

SELECT
    CAST(
        timezone('UTC', try_cast(onset_datetime AS TIMESTAMPTZ))
        AS DATE
    ) AS condition_start_date,
    CAST(
        timezone('UTC', try_cast(abatement_datetime AS TIMESTAMPTZ))
        AS DATE
    ) AS condition_stop_date,
    CAST(
        regexp_replace(patient_reference, '^urn:uuid:', '')
        AS VARCHAR
    ) AS patient_id,
    CAST(
        regexp_replace(encounter_reference, '^urn:uuid:', '')
        AS VARCHAR
    ) AS encounter_id,
    CAST(condition_code AS VARCHAR) AS condition_code,
    CAST(replace(condition_description, ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS condition_description
FROM extracted
```

```sql
with conditions as (
    select
        coalesce(json_extract_string(c.resource, '$.id'), c.id) as condition_id,
        coding.code as reason_code,
        coalesce(
            coding.display,
            json_extract_string(c.resource, '$.code.text')
        ) as reason_description
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'condition') }} as c
    left join lateral (
        select
            json_extract_string(j.value, '$.code') as code,
            json_extract_string(j.value, '$.display') as display
        from json_each(c.resource, '$.code.coding') as j
        where json_extract_string(j.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
        order by try_cast(j.key as integer)
        limit 1
    ) as coding on true
),
procedures as (
    select
        resource,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.start'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedDateTime')
        ) as start_value,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.end') as stop_value,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') as patient_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference') as encounter_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].reference') as reason_reference
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'procedure') }}
),
normalized as (
    select
        resource,
        cast(
            try_cast(start_value as timestamptz) at time zone 'UTC'
            as timestamp
        ) as procedure_start_datetime,
        cast(
            try_cast(stop_value as timestamptz) at time zone 'UTC'
            as timestamp
        ) as procedure_stop_datetime,
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                split_part(patient_reference, '/_history/', 1),
                '[?#].*$', ''
            ),
            '^urn:uuid:|^.*/', ''
        ) as patient_id,
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                split_part(encounter_reference, '/_history/', 1),
                '[?#].*$', ''
            ),
            '^urn:uuid:|^.*/', ''
        ) as encounter_id,
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                split_part(reason_reference, '/_history/', 1),
                '[?#].*$', ''
            ),
            '^urn:uuid:|^.*/', ''
        ) as reason_condition_id
    from procedures
)
select
    p.procedure_start_datetime,
    cast(p.procedure_start_datetime as date) as procedure_start_date,
    p.procedure_stop_datetime,
    cast(p.procedure_stop_datetime as date) as procedure_stop_date,
    cast(p.patient_id as varchar) as patient_id,
    cast(p.encounter_id as varchar) as encounter_id,
    cast(pc.code as varchar) as procedure_code,
    cast(coalesce(
        pc.display,
        json_extract_string(p.resource, '$.code.text')
    ) as varchar) as procedure_description,
    cast(null as float) as procedure_base_cost,
    cast(coalesce(rc.code, c.reason_code) as varchar) as procedure_reason_code,
    cast(
        case
            when rc.code is not null then coalesce(
                rc.display,
                json_extract_string(p.resource, '$.reasonCode[0].text')
            )
            else coalesce(
                c.reason_description,
                json_extract_string(p.resource, '$.reasonReference[0].display')
            )
        end as varchar
    ) as procedure_reason_description
from normalized as p
left join lateral (
    select
        json_extract_string(j.value, '$.code') as code,
        json_extract_string(j.value, '$.display') as display
    from json_each(p.resource, '$.code.coding') as j
    order by
        case
            when json_extract_string(j.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
                then 0
            else 1
        end,
        try_cast(j.key as integer)
    limit 1
) as pc on true
left join lateral (
    select
        json_extract_string(j.value, '$.code') as code,
        json_extract_string(j.value, '$.display') as display
    from json_each(p.resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding') as j
    where json_extract_string(j.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
    order by try_cast(j.key as integer)
    limit 1
) as rc on true
left join lateral (
    select
        c.reason_code,
        c.reason_description
    from conditions as c
    where c.condition_id = p.reason_condition_id
    order by c.reason_code nulls last, c.reason_description nulls last
    limit 1
) as c on true
```

```sql
with procedure_resources as (
    select
        resource,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.start'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedDateTime')
        ) as start_value,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.end') as stop_value,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') as patient_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference') as encounter_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].reference') as reason_reference
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'procedure') }}
),

normalized as (
    select
        *,
        timezone('UTC', try_cast(start_value as timestamptz))
            as procedure_start_datetime,
        timezone('UTC', try_cast(stop_value as timestamptz))
            as procedure_stop_datetime,
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                regexp_replace(patient_reference, '[?#].*$', ''),
                '/_history/.*$', ''
            ),
            '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)', ''
        ) as patient_id,
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                regexp_replace(encounter_reference, '[?#].*$', ''),
                '/_history/.*$', ''
            ),
            '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)', ''
        ) as encounter_id,
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                regexp_replace(reason_reference, '[?#].*$', ''),
                '/_history/.*$', ''
            ),
            '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)', ''
        ) as reason_condition_id
    from procedure_resources
),

condition_resources as (
    select
        coalesce(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id) as condition_id,
        resource
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'condition') }}
),

mapped as (
    select
        p.procedure_start_datetime,
        p.procedure_stop_datetime,
        p.patient_id,
        p.encounter_id,
        json_extract_string(procedure_coding.value, '$.code') as procedure_code,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(procedure_coding.value, '$.display'),
            json_extract_string(p.resource, '$.code.text')
        ) as procedure_description,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(direct_reason.value, '$.code'),
            json_extract_string(condition_reason.value, '$.code')
        ) as procedure_reason_code,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(direct_reason.value, '$.display'),
            json_extract_string(p.resource, '$.reasonCode[0].text'),
            json_extract_string(condition_reason.value, '$.display'),
            json_extract_string(c.resource, '$.code.text'),
            json_extract_string(p.resource, '$.reasonReference[0].display')
        ) as procedure_reason_description
    from normalized p
    left join lateral (
        select coding.value
        from json_each(p.resource, '$.code.coding') coding
        order by
            case
                when json_extract_string(coding.value, '$.system')
                    = 'http://snomed.info/sct' then 0
                else 1
            end,
            try_cast(coding.key as integer)
        limit 1
    ) procedure_coding on true
    left join lateral (
        select cr.resource
        from condition_resources cr
        where cr.condition_id = p.reason_condition_id
        order by cast(cr.resource as varchar)
        limit 1
    ) c on true
    left join lateral (
        select coding.value
        from json_each(p.resource, '$.reasonCode') reason,
             json_each(reason.value, '$.coding') coding
        where json_extract_string(coding.value, '$.system')
            = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
        order by
            try_cast(reason.key as integer),
            try_cast(coding.key as integer)
        limit 1
    ) direct_reason on true
    left join lateral (
        select coding.value
        from json_each(c.resource, '$.code.coding') coding
        where json_extract_string(coding.value, '$.system')
            = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
        order by try_cast(coding.key as integer)
        limit 1
    ) condition_reason on true
)

select
    cast(procedure_start_datetime as timestamp) as procedure_start_datetime,
    cast(procedure_start_datetime as date) as procedure_start_date,
    cast(procedure_stop_datetime as timestamp) as procedure_stop_datetime,
    cast(procedure_stop_datetime as date) as procedure_stop_date,
    cast(patient_id as varchar) as patient_id,
    cast(encounter_id as varchar) as encounter_id,
    cast(procedure_code as varchar) as procedure_code,
    cast(procedure_description as varchar) as procedure_description,
    cast(null as float) as procedure_base_cost,
    cast(procedure_reason_code as varchar) as procedure_reason_code,
    cast(procedure_reason_description as varchar) as procedure_reason_description
from mapped
```

```sql
with procedure_resources as (
    select
        resource,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') as patient_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference') as encounter_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].reference') as reason_reference
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'procedure') }}
),

condition_resources as (
    select
        id,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.id') as resource_id,
        resource
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'condition') }}
),

normalized as (
    select
        resource,
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            try_cast(
                coalesce(
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.start'),
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedDateTime')
                ) as timestamptz
            )
        ) as procedure_start_datetime,
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            try_cast(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.end')
                as timestamptz
            )
        ) as procedure_stop_datetime,
        coalesce(
            nullif(
                regexp_extract(
                    patient_reference,
                    '(?:urn:uuid:|(?:^|/)Patient/)([^/?#]+)',
                    1
                ),
                ''
            ),
            patient_reference
        ) as patient_id,
        coalesce(
            nullif(
                regexp_extract(
                    encounter_reference,
                    '(?:urn:uuid:|(?:^|/)Encounter/)([^/?#]+)',
                    1
                ),
                ''
            ),
            encounter_reference
        ) as encounter_id,
        coalesce(
            nullif(
                regexp_extract(
                    reason_reference,
                    '(?:urn:uuid:|(?:^|/)Condition/)([^/?#]+)',
                    1
                ),
                ''
            ),
            reason_reference
        ) as reason_condition_id
    from procedure_resources
),

enriched as (
    select
        p.procedure_start_datetime,
        p.procedure_stop_datetime,
        p.patient_id,
        p.encounter_id,
        json_extract_string(pc.value, '$.code') as procedure_code,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(pc.value, '$.display'),
            json_extract_string(p.resource, '$.code.text')
        ) as procedure_description,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(rc.value, '$.code'),
            json_extract_string(cc.value, '$.code')
        ) as procedure_reason_code,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(rc.value, '$.display'),
            json_extract_string(p.resource, '$.reasonCode[0].text'),
            json_extract_string(cc.value, '$.display'),
            json_extract_string(c.resource, '$.code.text'),
            json_extract_string(p.resource, '$.reasonReference[0].display')
        ) as procedure_reason_description
    from normalized p
    left join lateral (
        select coding.value
        from json_each(p.resource, '$.code.coding') as coding
        order by
            case
                when json_extract_string(coding.value, '$.system')
                    = 'http://snomed.info/sct' then 0
                else 1
            end,
            cast(coding.key as integer)
        limit 1
    ) pc on true
    left join lateral (
        select coding.value
        from json_each(p.resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding') as coding
        where json_extract_string(coding.value, '$.system')
            = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
        order by cast(coding.key as integer)
        limit 1
    ) rc on true
    left join lateral (
        select cr.resource
        from condition_resources cr
        where cr.resource_id = p.reason_condition_id
            or cr.id = p.reason_condition_id
        order by
            case when cr.resource_id = p.reason_condition_id then 0 else 1 end,
            cr.id,
            cast(cr.resource as varchar)
        limit 1
    ) c on true
    left join lateral (
        select coding.value
        from json_each(c.resource, '$.code.coding') as coding
        where json_extract_string(coding.value, '$.system')
            = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
        order by cast(coding.key as integer)
        limit 1
    ) cc on true
)

select
    cast(procedure_start_datetime as timestamp) as procedure_start_datetime,
    cast(procedure_start_datetime as date) as procedure_start_date,
    cast(procedure_stop_datetime as timestamp) as procedure_stop_datetime,
    cast(procedure_stop_datetime as date) as procedure_stop_date,
    cast(patient_id as varchar) as patient_id,
    cast(encounter_id as varchar) as encounter_id,
    cast(procedure_code as varchar) as procedure_code,
    cast(procedure_description as varchar) as procedure_description,
    cast(null as float) as procedure_base_cost,
    cast(procedure_reason_code as varchar) as procedure_reason_code,
    cast(procedure_reason_description as varchar) as procedure_reason_description
from enriched
```
