```sql
        where json_extract_string(coding.value, '$.system')
            = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
        order by cast(coding.key as integer)
        limit 1
    ) rc on true
    left join lateral (
        select
            json_extract_string(coding.value, '$.code') as reason_code,
            coalesce(
                json_extract_string(coding.value, '$.display'),
                json_extract_string(c.resource, '$.code.text')
            ) as reason_description
        from condition_resources c
        left join lateral (
            select item.value
            from json_each(c.resource, '$.code.coding') item
            where json_extract_string(item.value, '$.system')
                = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
            order by cast(item.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) coding on true
        where c.condition_id = p.reason_condition_id
        order by cast(c.resource as varchar)
        limit 1
    ) reason_condition on true
)

select
    procedure_start_datetime,
    cast(procedure_start_datetime as date) as procedure_start_date,
    procedure_stop_datetime,
    cast(procedure_stop_datetime as date) as procedure_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    encounter_id,
    procedure_code,
    procedure_description,
    procedure_base_cost,
    procedure_reason_code,
    procedure_reason_description
from mapped
```

## Mapping hints
- start and stop are performedPeriod.start and .end (or performedDateTime for both); they carry a UTC offset and the contract wants UTC.
- patient is subject.reference, the encounter is encounter.reference (R4) or context.reference (STU3), without the urn:uuid: prefix.
- code and description are code.coding[0]; commas in text become spaces. The reason is the code of the Condition that reasonReference[0].reference points to. The cost is not in the resource: NULL.
text:
```sql
WITH conditions AS (
    SELECT
        coalesce(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id) AS condition_id,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS reason_code,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
        ) AS reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'condition') }}
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (
        PARTITION BY coalesce(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id)
        ORDER BY id, cast(resource AS VARCHAR)
    ) = 1
),
procedures AS (
    SELECT
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            try_cast(
                coalesce(
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.start'),
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedDateTime')
                ) AS TIMESTAMPTZ
            )
        ) AS procedure_start_datetime,
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            try_cast(
                coalesce(
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.end'),
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedDateTime')
                ) AS TIMESTAMPTZ
            )
        ) AS procedure_stop_datetime,
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
            '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)',
            ''
        ) AS patient_id,
        regexp_replace(
            coalesce(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference')
            ),
            '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)',
            ''
        ) AS encounter_id,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS procedure_code,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
        ) AS procedure_description,
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].reference'),
            '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)',
            ''
        ) AS reason_condition_id,
        json_extract_string(
            resource, '$.reasonReference[0].display'
        ) AS reason_reference_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'procedure') }}
)
SELECT
    p.procedure_start_datetime,
    cast(p.procedure_start_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_start_date,
    p.procedure_stop_datetime,
    cast(p.procedure_stop_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_stop_date,
    p.patient_id,
    p.encounter_id,
    p.procedure_code,
    replace(p.procedure_description, ',', ' ') AS procedure_description,
    cast(NULL AS FLOAT) AS procedure_base_cost,
    c.reason_code AS procedure_reason_code,
    replace(
        coalesce(c.reason_description, p.reason_reference_description),
        ',',
        ' '
    ) AS procedure_reason_description
FROM procedures AS p
LEFT JOIN conditions AS c
    ON p.reason_condition_id = c.condition_id
```

## Mapping hints
- start and stop are performedPeriod.start and .end (or performedDateTime for both); they carry a UTC offset and the contract wants UTC.
- patient is subject.reference, the encounter is encounter.reference (R4) or context.reference (STU3), without the urn:uuid: prefix.
- code and description are code.coding[0]; commas in text become spaces. The reason is the code of the Condition that reasonReference[0].reference points to. The cost is not in the resource: NULL.

```sql
with extracted as (
    select
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.start'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedDateTime')
        ) as start_value,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.end'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedDateTime')
        ) as stop_value,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') as patient_reference,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference')
        ) as encounter_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') as procedure_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display') as procedure_description,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].reference') as reason_reference
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'procedure') }}
),

normalized as (
    select
        timezone('UTC', try_cast(start_value as timestamptz))
            as procedure_start_datetime,
        timezone('UTC', try_cast(stop_value as timestamptz))
            as procedure_stop_datetime,
        regexp_replace(patient_reference, '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)', '') as patient_id,
        regexp_replace(encounter_reference, '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)', '') as encounter_id,
        procedure_code,
        replace(procedure_description, ',', ' ') as procedure_description,
        regexp_replace(reason_reference, '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)', '') as reason_id
    from extracted
),

conditions as (
    select
        coalesce(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id) as condition_id,
        resource
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'condition') }}
)

select
    p.procedure_start_datetime,
    cast(p.procedure_start_datetime as date) as procedure_start_date,
    p.procedure_stop_datetime,
    cast(p.procedure_stop_datetime as date) as procedure_stop_date,
    p.patient_id,
    p.encounter_id,
    p.procedure_code,
    p.procedure_description,
    cast(null as float) as procedure_base_cost,
    json_extract_string(c.resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')
        as procedure_reason_code,
    replace(
        json_extract_string(c.resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
        ',',
        ' '
    ) as procedure_reason_description
from normalized as p
left join lateral (
    select resource
    from conditions
    where condition_id = p.reason_id
    order by cast(resource as varchar)
    limit 1
) as c on true
```

```sql
WITH extracted AS (
    SELECT
        resource,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.effectiveDateTime'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.effectiveInstant'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.effectivePeriod.start'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.issued')
        ) AS datetime_text,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference') AS encounter_reference,
        (
            SELECT coding.value
            FROM json_each(json_extract(resource, '$.code.coding')) AS coding
            ORDER BY
                CASE
                    WHEN json_extract_string(coding.value, '$.system') = 'http://loinc.org'
                        THEN 0
                    ELSE 1
                END,
                TRY_CAST(coding.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS observation_coding,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(coding.value, '$.code')
            FROM json_each(json_extract(resource, '$.category')) AS category,
                 json_each(json_extract(category.value, '$.coding')) AS coding
            ORDER BY
                CASE
                    WHEN json_extract_string(coding.value, '$.system')
                        = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/observation-category'
                        THEN 0
                    ELSE 1
                END,
                TRY_CAST(category.key AS INTEGER),
                TRY_CAST(coding.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS category_code
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'observation') }}
),

normalized AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(
            timezone('UTC', TRY_CAST(datetime_text AS TIMESTAMPTZ))
            AS TIMESTAMP
        ) AS observation_datetime,
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN patient_reference LIKE 'urn:uuid:%'
                    THEN substr(patient_reference, 10)
                ELSE NULLIF(
                    regexp_extract(
                        patient_reference,
                        '(?:^|/)Patient/([^/?#]+)',
                        1
                    ),
                    ''
                )
            END AS VARCHAR
        ) AS patient_id,
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN encounter_reference LIKE 'urn:uuid:%'
                    THEN substr(encounter_reference, 10)
                ELSE NULLIF(
                    regexp_extract(
                        encounter_reference,
                        '(?:^|/)Encounter/([^/?#]+)',
                        1
                    ),
                    ''
                )
            END AS VARCHAR
        ) AS encounter_id,
        CAST(category_code AS VARCHAR) AS observation_category,
        json_extract_string(observation_coding, '$.code') AS observation_code,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text'),
            json_extract_string(observation_coding, '$.display')
        ) AS observation_description,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.value'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueInteger'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].code'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueString'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueBoolean'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueDateTime'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueTime')
        ) AS observation_value,
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.value') IS NOT NULL
                THEN COALESCE(
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.unit'),
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.code')
                )
        END AS observation_units,
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.value') IS NOT NULL
                OR json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueInteger') IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'numeric'
            WHEN COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].code'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueString'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueBoolean'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueDateTime'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueTime')
            ) IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'text'
        END AS observation_value_type
    -- Keep component-only observations as one row, without inventing a scalar value.
    FROM extracted
)

SELECT
    observation_datetime,
    CAST(observation_datetime AS DATE) AS observation_date,
    patient_id,
    encounter_id,
    CAST(observation_category AS VARCHAR) AS observation_category,
    CAST(observation_code AS VARCHAR) AS observation_code,
    CAST(observation_description AS VARCHAR) AS observation_description,
    CAST(observation_value AS VARCHAR) AS observation_value,
    CAST(observation_units AS VARCHAR) AS observation_units,
    CAST(observation_value_type AS VARCHAR) AS observation_value_type
FROM normalized
```

```sql
WITH resources AS (
    SELECT resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'observation') }}
),

selected_codings AS (
    SELECT
        resource,
        (
            SELECT coding.value
            FROM json_each(resource, '$.code.coding') AS coding
            ORDER BY
                CASE
                    WHEN json_extract_string(coding.value, '$.system') = 'http://loinc.org'
                        THEN 0
                    ELSE 1
                END,
                TRY_CAST(coding.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS observation_coding,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(coding.value, '$.code')
            FROM json_each(resource, '$.category') AS category,
                 LATERAL json_each(category.value, '$.coding') AS coding
            ORDER BY
                CASE
                    WHEN json_extract_string(coding.value, '$.system')
                        = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/observation-category'
                        THEN 0
                    ELSE 1
                END,
                TRY_CAST(category.key AS INTEGER),
                TRY_CAST(coding.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS category_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference') AS encounter_reference
    FROM resources
),

normalized AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(
            timezone(
                'UTC',
                TRY_CAST(
                    COALESCE(
                        json_extract_string(resource, '$.effectiveDateTime'),
                        json_extract_string(resource, '$.effectivePeriod.start'),
                        json_extract_string(resource, '$.issued')
                    ) AS TIMESTAMPTZ
                )
            ) AS TIMESTAMP
        ) AS observation_datetime,
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN starts_with(patient_reference, 'urn:uuid:')
                    THEN substr(patient_reference, 10)
                ELSE COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(
                        regexp_extract(
                            patient_reference,
                            '(?:^|/)Patient/([^/?#]+)',
                            1
                        ),
                        ''
                    ),
                    patient_reference
                )
            END AS VARCHAR
        ) AS patient_id,
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN starts_with(encounter_reference, 'urn:uuid:')
                    THEN substr(encounter_reference, 10)
                ELSE COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(
                        regexp_extract(
                            encounter_reference,
                            '(?:^|/)Encounter/([^/?#]+)',
                            1
                        ),
                        ''
                    ),
                    encounter_reference
                )
            END AS VARCHAR
        ) AS encounter_id,
        CAST(category_code AS VARCHAR) AS observation_category,
        CAST(
            json_extract_string(observation_coding, '$.code') AS VARCHAR
        ) AS observation_code,
        CAST(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text'),
                json_extract_string(observation_coding, '$.display')
            ) AS VARCHAR
        ) AS observation_description,

        -- Components remain nested: each raw resource produces exactly one row.
        CAST(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.value'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueInteger'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueString'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].code'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueBoolean'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueDateTime'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueTime')
            ) AS VARCHAR
        ) AS observation_value,
        CAST(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.unit'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.code')
            ) AS VARCHAR
        ) AS observation_units,
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.value') IS NOT NULL
                    OR json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueInteger') IS NOT NULL
                    THEN 'numeric'
                WHEN json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueString') IS NOT NULL
                    OR json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept') IS NOT NULL
                    OR json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueBoolean') IS NOT NULL
                    OR json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueDateTime') IS NOT NULL
                    OR json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueTime') IS NOT NULL
                    THEN 'text'
                ELSE NULL
            END AS VARCHAR
        ) AS observation_value_type
    FROM selected_codings
)

SELECT
    observation_datetime,
    CAST(observation_datetime AS DATE) AS observation_date,
    patient_id,
    encounter_id,
    observation_category,
    observation_code,
    observation_description,
    observation_value,
    observation_units,
    observation_value_type
FROM normalized
```

```sql
WITH extracted AS (
    SELECT
        resource,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference') AS encounter_reference,
        (
            SELECT coding.value
            FROM json_each(resource, '$.code.coding') AS coding
            ORDER BY
                CASE
                    WHEN json_extract_string(coding.value, '$.system') = 'http://loinc.org'
                        THEN 0
                    ELSE 1
                END,
                try_cast(coding.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS observation_coding,
        (
            SELECT coding.value
            FROM json_each(resource, '$.category') AS category,
                 json_each(category.value, '$.coding') AS coding
            ORDER BY
                CASE
                    WHEN json_extract_string(coding.value, '$.system')
                        = 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/observation-category'
                        THEN 0
                    ELSE 1
                END,
                try_cast(category.key AS INTEGER),
                try_cast(coding.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS category_coding
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'observation') }}
),

normalized AS (
    SELECT
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            try_cast(
                coalesce(
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.effectiveDateTime'),
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.effectivePeriod.start'),
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.effectiveInstant')
                ) AS TIMESTAMPTZ
            )
        ) AS observation_datetime,
        CASE
            WHEN starts_with(patient_reference, 'urn:uuid:')
                THEN substr(patient_reference, 10)
            ELSE coalesce(
                nullif(
                    regexp_extract(patient_reference, '(?:^|/)Patient/([^/?#]+)', 1),
                    ''
                ),
                patient_reference
            )
        END AS patient_id,
        CASE
            WHEN starts_with(encounter_reference, 'urn:uuid:')
                THEN substr(encounter_reference, 10)
            ELSE coalesce(
                nullif(
                    regexp_extract(encounter_reference, '(?:^|/)Encounter/([^/?#]+)', 1),
                    ''
                ),
                encounter_reference
            )
        END AS encounter_id,
        json_extract_string(category_coding, '$.code') AS observation_category,
        json_extract_string(observation_coding, '$.code') AS observation_code,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(observation_coding, '$.display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
        ) AS observation_description,
        -- Preserve one row per resource; components are not separate source records.
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.value'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueInteger'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueDecimal'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].code'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueString'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueBoolean'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueDateTime'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueTime')
        ) AS observation_value,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.unit'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.code')
        ) AS observation_units,
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.value') IS NOT NULL
                OR json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueInteger') IS NOT NULL
                OR json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueDecimal') IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'numeric'
            WHEN json_extract(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept') IS NOT NULL
                OR json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueString') IS NOT NULL
                OR json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueBoolean') IS NOT NULL
                OR json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueDateTime') IS NOT NULL
                OR json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueTime') IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'text'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS observation_value_type
    FROM extracted
)

SELECT
    cast(observation_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS observation_datetime,
    cast(observation_datetime AS DATE) AS observation_date,
    cast(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
    cast(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
    cast(observation_category AS VARCHAR) AS observation_category,
    cast(observation_code AS VARCHAR) AS observation_code,
    cast(observation_description AS VARCHAR) AS observation_description,
    cast(observation_value AS VARCHAR) AS observation_value,
    cast(observation_units AS VARCHAR) AS observation_units,
    cast(observation_value_type AS VARCHAR) AS observation_value_type
FROM normalized
```

## Mapping hints
- One row per value: an Observation with component[] gives one row per component (code and value from the component, date, patient, encounter and category from the parent); an Observation without components gives one row.
- date is effectiveDateTime (UTC); patient is subject.reference, the encounter is encounter.reference (R4) or context.reference (STU3), without the urn:uuid: prefix; category is category[0].coding[0].code.
- A valueQuantity gives type numeric, units = valueQuantity.unit and the value as text with exactly one decimal digit (163.34 is written 163.3, 71 is written 71.0). Other values give type text: the display of valueCodeableConcept.coding[0], or valueString.
- In DuckDB write (x->'$.path') IS NULL with the parentheses. Commas in text become spaces.
text:
```sql
WITH observation_values AS (
    -- Expand components without also emitting the parent observation.
    SELECT
        o.resource AS parent_resource,
        v.value_resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'observation') }} AS o
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(json_array_length(o.resource, '$.component'), 0) > 0
                THEN json_extract(o.resource, '$.component[*]')
            ELSE [o.resource]
        END
    ) AS v(value_resource)
),

extracted AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST(
            json_extract_string(parent_resource, '$.effectiveDateTime')
            AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS observation_datetime,
        json_extract_string(parent_resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_reference,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(parent_resource, '$.encounter.reference'),
            json_extract_string(parent_resource, '$.context.reference')
        ) AS encounter_reference,
        json_extract_string(
            parent_resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code'
        ) AS observation_category,
        json_extract_string(
            value_resource, '$.code.coding[0].code'
        ) AS observation_code,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(value_resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(value_resource, '$.code.text')
        ) AS observation_description,
        CASE
            WHEN (value_resource->'$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL THEN
                printf(
                    '%.1f',
                    round(
                        TRY_CAST(
                            json_extract_string(value_resource, '$.valueQuantity.value')
                            AS DOUBLE
                        ),
                        1
                    )
                )
            ELSE COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(
                    value_resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display'
                ),
                json_extract_string(value_resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text'),
                json_extract_string(value_resource, '$.valueString')
            )
        END AS observation_value,
        json_extract_string(
            value_resource, '$.valueQuantity.unit'
        ) AS observation_units,
        CASE
            WHEN (value_resource->'$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL THEN 'numeric'
            ELSE 'text'
        END AS observation_value_type
    FROM observation_values
)

SELECT
    CAST(observation_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS observation_datetime,
    CAST(observation_datetime AS DATE) AS observation_date,
    CAST(
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(patient_reference, '/_history/[^/]+/?$', ''),
            '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)',
            ''
        ) AS VARCHAR
    ) AS patient_id,
    CAST(
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(encounter_reference, '/_history/[^/]+/?$', ''),
            '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)',
            ''
        ) AS VARCHAR
    ) AS encounter_id,
    CAST(observation_category AS VARCHAR) AS observation_category,
    CAST(observation_code AS VARCHAR) AS observation_code,
    CAST(replace(observation_description, ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS observation_description,
    CAST(replace(observation_value, ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS observation_value,
    CAST(replace(observation_units, ',', ' ') AS VARCHAR) AS observation_units,
    CAST(observation_value_type AS VARCHAR) AS observation_value_type
FROM extracted
```

## Mapping hints
- One row per value: an Observation with component[] gives one row per component (code and value from the component, date, patient, encounter and category from the parent); an Observation without components gives one row.
- date is effectiveDateTime (UTC); patient is subject.reference, the encounter is encounter.reference (R4) or context.reference (STU3), without the urn:uuid: prefix; category is category[0].coding[0].code.
- A valueQuantity gives type numeric, units = valueQuantity.unit and the value as text with exactly one decimal digit (163.34 is written 163.3, 71 is written 71.0). Other values give type text: the display of valueCodeableConcept.coding[0], or valueString.
- In DuckDB write (x->'$.path') IS NULL with the parentheses. Commas in text become spaces.

```sql
with raw_observations as (
    select resource
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'observation') }}
),

observation_values as (
    -- Component observations inherit the parent's context.
    select
        r.resource as parent_resource,
        c.value as value_resource
    from raw_observations as r
    cross join lateral json_each(r.resource, '$.component') as c
    where coalesce(json_array_length(r.resource, '$.component'), 0) > 0

    union all

    select
        resource as parent_resource,
        resource as value_resource
    from raw_observations
    where coalesce(json_array_length(resource, '$.component'), 0) = 0
),

mapped as (
    select
        try_cast(
            json_extract_string(parent_resource, '$.effectiveDateTime')
            as timestamptz
        ) at time zone 'UTC' as observation_datetime,

        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(parent_resource, '$.subject.reference'),
            '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)',
            ''
        ) as patient_id,

        regexp_replace(
            coalesce(
                json_extract_string(parent_resource, '$.encounter.reference'),
                json_extract_string(parent_resource, '$.context.reference')
            ),
            '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)',
            ''
        ) as encounter_id,

        json_extract_string(
            parent_resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code'
        ) as observation_category,

        json_extract_string(
            value_resource, '$.code.coding[0].code'
        ) as observation_code,

        replace(
            coalesce(
                json_extract_string(value_resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
                json_extract_string(value_resource, '$.code.text')
            ),
            ',',
            ' '
        ) as observation_description,

        case
            when (value_resource -> '$.valueQuantity') is not null then
                printf(
                    '%.1f',
                    try_cast(
                        json_extract_string(
                            value_resource, '$.valueQuantity.value'
                        ) as double
                    )
                )
            else replace(
                coalesce(
                    json_extract_string(
                        value_resource,
                        '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display'
                    ),
                    json_extract_string(
                        value_resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text'
                    ),
                    json_extract_string(value_resource, '$.valueString')
                ),
                ',',
                ' '
            )
        end as observation_value,

        replace(
            json_extract_string(value_resource, '$.valueQuantity.unit'),
            ',',
            ' '
        ) as observation_units,

        case
            when (value_resource -> '$.valueQuantity') is not null
                then 'numeric'
            else 'text'
        end as observation_value_type
    from observation_values
)

select
    cast(observation_datetime as timestamp) as observation_datetime,
    cast(observation_datetime as date) as observation_date,
    cast(patient_id as varchar) as patient_id,
    cast(encounter_id as varchar) as encounter_id,
    cast(observation_category as varchar) as observation_category,
    cast(observation_code as varchar) as observation_code,
    cast(observation_description as varchar) as observation_description,
    cast(observation_value as varchar) as observation_value,
    cast(observation_units as varchar) as observation_units,
    cast(observation_value_type as varchar) as observation_value_type
from mapped
```

```sql
with allergies as (
    select
        resource,
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.patient.reference'),
                '^urn:uuid:|^(.*/)?Patient/',
                ''
            ),
            '/_history/.*$',
            ''
        )::varchar as patient_id,
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference'),
                '^urn:uuid:|^(.*/)?Encounter/',
                ''
            ),
            '/_history/.*$',
            ''
        )::varchar as explicit_encounter_id,
        try_cast(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.recordedDate')
            as timestamptz
        ) as recorded_at,
        coalesce(
            try_cast(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetDateTime')
                as timestamptz
            ),
            try_cast(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetPeriod.start')
                as timestamptz
            ),
            try_cast(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.recordedDate')
                as timestamptz
            )
        ) as allergy_started_at
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'allergyintolerance') }}
),

encounters as (
    select
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'),
            id
        )::varchar as encounter_id,
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
                '^urn:uuid:|^(.*/)?Patient/',
                ''
            ),
            '/_history/.*$',
            ''
        )::varchar as patient_id,
        try_cast(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start')
            as timestamptz
        ) as encounter_started_at
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}
)

select
    cast(
        timezone('UTC', a.allergy_started_at) as date
    ) as allergy_start_date,
    -- AllergyIntolerance does not supply an allergy cessation date.
    cast(null as date) as allergy_stop_date,
    a.patient_id,
    coalesce(
        a.explicit_encounter_id,
        matched.encounter_id
    )::varchar as encounter_id,
    json_extract_string(
        a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].code'
    )::varchar as allergy_code,
    case json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].system')
        when 'http://snomed.info/sct' then 'SNOMED-CT'
        when 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm' then 'RxNorm'
        when 'http://loinc.org' then 'LOINC'
        else json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].system')
    end::varchar as allergy_code_system,
    coalesce(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.text')
    )::varchar as allergy_description,
    lower(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.type')
    )::varchar as allergy_type,
    lower(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.category[0]')
    )::varchar as allergy_category,
    json_extract_string(
        a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].code'
    )::varchar as reaction_1_code,
    coalesce(
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'
        ),
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].text'
        )
    )::varchar as reaction_1_description,
    upper(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[0].severity')
    )::varchar as reaction_1_severity,
    json_extract_string(
        a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].code'
    )::varchar as reaction_2_code,
    coalesce(
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'
        ),
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].text'
        )
    )::varchar as reaction_2_description,
    upper(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[1].severity')
    )::varchar as reaction_2_severity
from allergies as a
left join lateral (
    -- Infer a missing encounter only from an exact patient/time match.
    -- Limit the lookup so multiple candidates cannot multiply source rows.
    select e.encounter_id
    from encounters as e
    where a.explicit_encounter_id is null
      and e.patient_id = a.patient_id
      and e.encounter_started_at = a.recorded_at
    order by e.encounter_id
    limit 1
) as matched on true
```

```sql
WITH allergies AS (
    SELECT
        resource,
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.patient.reference'),
                '/_history/.*$', ''
            ),
            '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)', ''
        ) AS patient_id,
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference'),
                '/_history/.*$', ''
            ),
            '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)', ''
        ) AS explicit_encounter_id,
        try_cast(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.recordedDate')
            AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS recorded_at,
        coalesce(
            try_cast(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetDateTime')
                AS TIMESTAMPTZ
            ),
            try_cast(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetPeriod.start')
                AS TIMESTAMPTZ
            ),
            try_cast(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.recordedDate')
                AS TIMESTAMPTZ
            )
        ) AS started_at
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'allergyintolerance') }}
),
encounters AS (
    SELECT
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'),
            id
        )::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
                '/_history/.*$', ''
            ),
            '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)', ''
        ) AS patient_id,
        try_cast(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start')
            AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS started_at,
        try_cast(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end')
            AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS ended_at
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}
)
SELECT
    cast(a.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS DATE) AS allergy_start_date,
    -- AllergyIntolerance has no standard resolution-date field.
    cast(NULL AS DATE) AS allergy_stop_date,
    a.patient_id::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
    coalesce(a.explicit_encounter_id, e.encounter_id)::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
    json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')::VARCHAR
        AS allergy_code,
    cast(
        CASE json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].system')
            WHEN 'http://snomed.info/sct' THEN 'SNOMED-CT'
            WHEN 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm' THEN 'RxNorm'
            ELSE json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].system')
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS allergy_code_system,
    coalesce(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.text')
    )::VARCHAR AS allergy_description,
    lower(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.type'))::VARCHAR AS allergy_type,
    lower(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.category[0]'))::VARCHAR
        AS allergy_category,
    json_extract_string(
        a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].code'
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_1_code,
    coalesce(
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'
        ),
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].text')
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_1_description,
    upper(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[0].severity'))::VARCHAR
        AS reaction_1_severity,
    json_extract_string(
        a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].code'
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_2_code,
    coalesce(
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'
        ),
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].text')
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_2_description,
    upper(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[1].severity'))::VARCHAR
        AS reaction_2_severity
FROM allergies AS a
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    -- Recover the recording encounter only when its period contains the event.
    SELECT enc.encounter_id
    FROM encounters AS enc
    WHERE a.explicit_encounter_id IS NULL
      AND enc.patient_id = a.patient_id
      AND a.recorded_at >= enc.started_at
      AND a.recorded_at <= enc.ended_at
    ORDER BY
        CASE WHEN a.recorded_at = enc.started_at THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
        enc.started_at DESC,
        enc.encounter_id
    LIMIT 1
) AS e ON TRUE
```

## Mapping hints
- start date is the first 10 characters of recordedDate (R4) or assertedDate (STU3); there is no stop date.
- patient is patient.reference without the urn:uuid: prefix. The resource has no encounter reference: use the patient's Encounter whose period.start equals that timestamp.
- code and description are code.coding[0]; system is SNOMED-CT or RxNorm according to the coding system URL; type is type; category is category[0].
- reaction 1 and 2 are reaction[0] and reaction[1]: manifestation[0].coding[0].code and .display, severity in upper case. Commas in text become spaces.
text:
```sql
WITH allergies AS (
    SELECT
        resource,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.recordedDate'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.assertedDate')
        ) AS recorded_at,
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.patient.reference'),
            '^urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) AS patient_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'allergyintolerance') }}
),

encounters AS (
    SELECT
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
            '^urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) AS patient_id,
        try_cast(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS encounter_start,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'),
            id
        ) AS encounter_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}
),

encounter_matches AS (
    -- Resolve timestamp ties deterministically without multiplying allergy rows.
    SELECT
        patient_id,
        encounter_start,
        min(encounter_id) AS encounter_id
    FROM encounters
    GROUP BY patient_id, encounter_start
)

SELECT
    try_cast(substr(a.recorded_at, 1, 10) AS DATE) AS allergy_start_date,
    cast(NULL AS DATE) AS allergy_stop_date,
    a.patient_id AS patient_id,
    e.encounter_id AS encounter_id,
    json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS allergy_code,
    cast(
        CASE json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].system')
            WHEN 'http://snomed.info/sct' THEN 'SNOMED-CT'
            WHEN 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm' THEN 'RxNorm'
            ELSE json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].system')
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS allergy_code_system,
    replace(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
        ',', ' '
    ) AS allergy_description,
    json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.type') AS allergy_type,
    json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.category[0]') AS allergy_category,
    json_extract_string(
        a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].code'
    ) AS reaction_1_code,
    replace(
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'
        ),
        ',', ' '
    ) AS reaction_1_description,
    upper(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[0].severity')
    ) AS reaction_1_severity,
    json_extract_string(
        a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].code'
    ) AS reaction_2_code,
    replace(
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'
        ),
        ',', ' '
    ) AS reaction_2_description,
    upper(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[1].severity')
    ) AS reaction_2_severity
FROM allergies AS a
LEFT JOIN encounter_matches AS e
    ON a.patient_id = e.patient_id
    AND try_cast(a.recorded_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ) = e.encounter_start
```

```sql
WITH allergies AS (
    SELECT
        resource,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                regexp_extract(
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.patient.reference'),
                    '(?:urn:uuid:|Patient/)([^/?#]+)',
                    1
                ),
                ''
            ),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.patient.reference')
        )::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                regexp_extract(
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference'),
                    '(?:urn:uuid:|Encounter/)([^/?#]+)',
                    1
                ),
                ''
            ),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference')
        )::VARCHAR AS explicit_encounter_id,
        TRY_CAST(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.recordedDate')
            AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS recorded_at,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetDateTime'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetPeriod.start'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.recordedDate')
        ) AS start_value
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'allergyintolerance') }}
),

encounters AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'),
            id
        )::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                regexp_extract(
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
                    '(?:urn:uuid:|Patient/)([^/?#]+)',
                    1
                ),
                ''
            ),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference')
        )::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
        TRY_CAST(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start')
            AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS encounter_start,
        TRY_CAST(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end')
            AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS encounter_end
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}
)

SELECT
    CAST(
        TRY_CAST(a.start_value AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
        AS DATE
    ) AS allergy_start_date,
    -- AllergyIntolerance has no standard cessation-date field.
    CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS allergy_stop_date,
    a.patient_id,
    COALESCE(a.explicit_encounter_id, matched.encounter_id)::VARCHAR
        AS encounter_id,
    json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')::VARCHAR
        AS allergy_code,
    CASE json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].system')
        WHEN 'http://snomed.info/sct' THEN 'SNOMED-CT'
        WHEN 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm' THEN 'RxNorm'
        WHEN 'http://loinc.org' THEN 'LOINC'
        ELSE json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].system')
    END::VARCHAR AS allergy_code_system,
    COALESCE(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.text')
    )::VARCHAR AS allergy_description,
    LOWER(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.type'))::VARCHAR
        AS allergy_type,
    LOWER(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.category[0]'))::VARCHAR
        AS allergy_category,
    json_extract_string(
        a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].code'
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_1_code,
    COALESCE(
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'
        ),
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].text'
        )
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_1_description,
    UPPER(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[0].severity')
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_1_severity,
    json_extract_string(
        a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].code'
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_2_code,
    COALESCE(
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'
        ),
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].text'
        )
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_2_description,
    UPPER(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[1].severity')
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_2_severity
FROM allergies AS a
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    -- Recover the recording encounter only when its period contains
    -- the recording instant; choose at most one to preserve source rows.
    SELECT e.encounter_id
    FROM encounters AS e
    WHERE a.explicit_encounter_id IS NULL
      AND e.patient_id = a.patient_id
      AND (
          a.recorded_at = e.encounter_start
          OR (
              a.recorded_at >= e.encounter_start
              AND a.recorded_at <= e.encounter_end
          )
      )
    ORDER BY
        CASE WHEN a.recorded_at = e.encounter_start THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
        e.encounter_start DESC,
        e.encounter_id
    LIMIT 1
) AS matched ON TRUE
```

## Mapping hints
- start date is the first 10 characters of recordedDate (R4) or assertedDate (STU3); there is no stop date.
- patient is patient.reference without the urn:uuid: prefix. The resource has no encounter reference: use the patient's Encounter whose period.start equals that timestamp.
- code and description are code.coding[0]; system is SNOMED-CT or RxNorm according to the coding system URL; type is type; category is category[0].
- reaction 1 and 2 are reaction[0] and reaction[1]: manifestation[0].coding[0].code and .display, severity in upper case. Commas in text become spaces.
text:
```sql
WITH allergies AS (
    SELECT
        resource,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.recordedDate'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.assertedDate')
        ) AS recorded_at,
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.patient.reference'),
            '^urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) AS patient_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'allergyintolerance') }}
),

encounter_records AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'),
            id
        ) AS encounter_id,
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
            '^urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) AS patient_id,
        TRY_CAST(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start')
            AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS encounter_start
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}
),

encounters AS (
    -- Resolve timestamp ties deterministically without multiplying allergy rows.
    SELECT
        patient_id,
        encounter_start,
        MIN(encounter_id) AS encounter_id
    FROM encounter_records
    GROUP BY patient_id, encounter_start
)

SELECT
    CAST(
        timezone('UTC', TRY_CAST(a.recorded_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ))
        AS DATE
    ) AS allergy_start_date,
    CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS allergy_stop_date,
    a.patient_id AS patient_id,
    e.encounter_id AS encounter_id,
    json_extract_string(
        a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].code'
    ) AS allergy_code,
    CAST(
        CASE json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].system')
            WHEN 'http://snomed.info/sct' THEN 'SNOMED-CT'
            WHEN 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm' THEN 'RxNorm'
            ELSE json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].system')
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS allergy_code_system,
    replace(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
        ',',
        ' '
    ) AS allergy_description,
    json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.type') AS allergy_type,
    json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.category[0]') AS allergy_category,
    json_extract_string(
        a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].code'
    ) AS reaction_1_code,
    replace(
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'
        ),
        ',',
        ' '
    ) AS reaction_1_description,
    upper(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[0].severity')
    ) AS reaction_1_severity,
    json_extract_string(
        a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].code'
    ) AS reaction_2_code,
    replace(
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'
        ),
        ',',
        ' '
    ) AS reaction_2_description,
    upper(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[1].severity')
    ) AS reaction_2_severity
FROM allergies AS a
LEFT JOIN encounters AS e
    ON a.patient_id = e.patient_id
    AND TRY_CAST(a.recorded_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ) = e.encounter_start
```

```sql
        p.id AS raw_id,
        p.resource,
        (
            SELECT n.value
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.name') AS n
            WHERE coalesce(json_extract_string(n.value, '$.use'), '') <> 'maiden'
            ORDER BY
                CASE json_extract_string(n.value, '$.use')
                    WHEN 'official' THEN 0
                    WHEN 'usual' THEN 1
                    ELSE 2
                END,
                try_cast(n.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS patient_name,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(n.value, '$.family')
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.name') AS n
            WHERE json_extract_string(n.value, '$.use') = 'maiden'
            ORDER BY try_cast(n.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS maiden_name,
        (
            SELECT a.value
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.address') AS a
            ORDER BY
                CASE json_extract_string(a.value, '$.use')
                    WHEN 'home' THEN 0
                    WHEN 'old' THEN 2
                    ELSE 1
                END,
                try_cast(a.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS patient_address_object
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'patient') }} AS p
),

extracted AS (
    SELECT
        p.*,
        ids.synthea_id,
        ids.ssn,
        ids.drivers_license_number,
        ids.passport_number,
        ext.race_extension,
        ext.ethnicity_extension,
        ext.birthplace_address,
        ext.birth_sex,
        geo.latitude,
        geo.longitude
    FROM resource_parts AS p
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            max(json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value')) FILTER (
                WHERE json_extract_string(i.value, '$.system')
                    = 'https://github.com/synthetichealth/synthea'
            ) AS synthea_id,
            max(json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value')) FILTER (
                WHERE json_extract_string(i.value, '$.system')
                    = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/us-ssn'
            ) AS ssn,
            max(json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value')) FILTER (
                WHERE EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM json_each(i.value, '$.type.coding') AS c
                    WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') = 'DL'
                )
            ) AS drivers_license_number,
            max(json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value')) FILTER (
                WHERE json_extract_string(i.value, '$.system')
                    = 'http://standardhealthrecord.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/passportNumber'
                    OR EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1
                        FROM json_each(i.value, '$.type.coding') AS c
                        WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') = 'PPN'
                    )
            ) AS passport_number
        FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.identifier') AS i
    ) AS ids ON TRUE
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            max(cast(e.value AS VARCHAR)) FILTER (
                WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')
                    = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race'
            ) AS race_extension,
            max(cast(e.value AS VARCHAR)) FILTER (
                WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')
                    = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity'
            ) AS ethnicity_extension,
            max(cast(json_extract(e.value, '$.valueAddress') AS VARCHAR)) FILTER (
                WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')
                    = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace'
            ) AS birthplace_address,
            max(json_extract_string(e.value, '$.valueCode')) FILTER (
                WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')
                    = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-birthsex'
            ) AS birth_sex
        FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.extension') AS e
    ) AS ext ON TRUE
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            max(json_extract_string(coordinate.value, '$.valueDecimal')) FILTER (
                WHERE json_extract_string(coordinate.value, '$.url') = 'latitude'
            ) AS latitude,
            max(json_extract_string(coordinate.value, '$.valueDecimal')) FILTER (
                WHERE json_extract_string(coordinate.value, '$.url') = 'longitude'
            ) AS longitude
        FROM json_each(p.patient_address_object, '$.extension') AS geolocation,
            LATERAL json_each(geolocation.value, '$.extension') AS coordinate
        WHERE json_extract_string(geolocation.value, '$.url')
            = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation'
    ) AS geo ON TRUE
),

normalized AS (
    SELECT
        e.*,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(r.value, '$.valueCoding.code')
            FROM json_each(e.race_extension, '$.extension') AS r
            WHERE json_extract_string(r.value, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
            ORDER BY try_cast(r.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS race_code,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(r.value, '$.valueCoding.code')
            FROM json_each(e.ethnicity_extension, '$.extension') AS r
            WHERE json_extract_string(r.value, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
            ORDER BY try_cast(r.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS ethnicity_code,
        coalesce(
            (
                SELECT json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code')
                FROM json_each(e.resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding') AS c
                ORDER BY
                    CASE
                        WHEN json_extract_string(c.value, '$.system')
                            = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/v3/MaritalStatus' THEN 0
                        ELSE 1
                    END,
                    try_cast(c.key AS INTEGER)
                LIMIT 1
            ),
            json_extract_string(e.resource, '$.maritalStatus.text')
        ) AS marital_code,
        json_extract_string(e.patient_address_object, '$.state') AS address_state,
        json_extract_string(e.birthplace_address, '$.state') AS birthplace_state
    FROM extracted AS e
)

SELECT
    cast(
        coalesce(
            nullif(synthea_id, ''),
            nullif(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), ''),
            raw_id
        ) AS VARCHAR
    ) AS patient_id,
    try_cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.birthDate') AS DATE) AS birth_date,
    cast(
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            try_cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime') AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
        ) AS DATE
    ) AS death_date,
    cast(ssn AS VARCHAR) AS ssn,
    cast(drivers_license_number AS VARCHAR) AS drivers_license_number,
    cast(passport_number AS VARCHAR) AS passport_number,
    cast(json_extract_string(patient_name, '$.prefix[0]') AS VARCHAR) AS patient_prefix,
    cast(json_extract_string(patient_name, '$.given[0]') AS VARCHAR) AS patient_first_name,
    cast(json_extract_string(patient_name, '$.family') AS VARCHAR) AS patient_last_name,
    cast(json_extract_string(patient_name, '$.suffix[0]') AS VARCHAR) AS patient_suffix,
    cast(maiden_name AS VARCHAR) AS maiden_name,
    cast(marital_code AS VARCHAR) AS marital_status,
    cast(
        CASE race_code
            WHEN '1002-5' THEN 'native'
            WHEN '2028-9' THEN 'asian'
            WHEN '2054-5' THEN 'black'
            WHEN '2076-8' THEN 'hawaiian'
            WHEN '2106-3' THEN 'white'
            WHEN '2131-1' THEN 'other'
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS race,
    cast(
        CASE ethnicity_code
            WHEN '2135-2' THEN 'hispanic'
            WHEN '2186-5' THEN 'nonhispanic'
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS ethnicity,
    cast(
        CASE lower(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender'))
            WHEN 'male' THEN 'M'
            WHEN 'female' THEN 'F'
            ELSE
                CASE upper(birth_sex)
                    WHEN 'M' THEN 'M'
                    WHEN 'F' THEN 'F'
                END
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS patient_gender,
    cast(
        nullif(
            concat_ws(
                '  ',
                nullif(json_extract_string(birthplace_address, '$.city'), ''),
                coalesce(
                    (
                        SELECT s.state_name
                        FROM {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} AS s
                        WHERE upper(trim(s.state_abbreviation))
                            = upper(trim(n.birthplace_state))
                        ORDER BY s.state_name
                        LIMIT 1
                    ),
                    nullif(birthplace_state, '')
                ),
                nullif(json_extract_string(birthplace_address, '$.country'), '')
            ),
            ''
        ) AS VARCHAR
    ) AS birthplace,
    cast(
        (
            SELECT string_agg(
                json_extract_string(line.value, '$'),
                ' ' ORDER BY try_cast(line.key AS INTEGER)
            )
            FROM json_each(patient_address_object, '$.line') AS line
        ) AS VARCHAR
    ) AS patient_address,
    cast(json_extract_string(patient_address_object, '$.city') AS VARCHAR) AS patient_city,
    cast(
        coalesce(
            (
                SELECT s.state_name
                FROM {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} AS s
                WHERE upper(trim(s.state_abbreviation)) = upper(trim(n.address_state))
                ORDER BY s.state_name
                LIMIT 1
            ),
            address_state
        ) AS VARCHAR
    ) AS patient_state,
    cast(json_extract_string(patient_address_object, '$.district') AS VARCHAR) AS patient_county,
    cast(json_extract_string(patient_address_object, '$.postalCode') AS VARCHAR) AS patient_zip,
    try_cast(latitude AS FLOAT) AS patient_latitude,
    try_cast(longitude AS FLOAT) AS patient_longitude,
    cast(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_expenses,
    cast(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_coverage
FROM normalized AS n
```

```sql
        p.resource,
        identifiers.synthea_id,

            order by
                case json_extract_string(n.value, '$.use')
                    when 'official' then 0
                    when 'usual' then 1
                    else 2
                end,
                cast(n.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as official_name,
        (
            select json_extract_string(n.value, '$.family')
            from json_each(p.resource, '$.name') as n
            where json_extract_string(n.value, '$.use') = 'maiden'
            order by cast(n.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as maiden_name,
        (
            select a.value
            from json_each(p.resource, '$.address') as a
            order by
                case json_extract_string(a.value, '$.use')
                    when 'home' then 0
                    when 'old' then 2
                    else 1
                end,
                cast(a.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as patient_address_json,
        extensions.race_json,
        extensions.ethnicity_json,
        extensions.birthplace_json
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'patient') }} as p
    left join lateral (
        select
            first(json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value') order by cast(i.key as integer))
                filter (
                    where json_extract_string(i.value, '$.system')
                        = 'https://github.com/synthetichealth/synthea'
                ) as synthea_id,
            first(json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value') order by cast(i.key as integer))
                filter (
                    where json_extract_string(i.value, '$.system')
                        = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/us-ssn'
                    or list_contains(
                        json_extract_string(i.value, '$.type.coding[*].code'), 'SB'
                    )
                ) as ssn,
            first(json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value') order by cast(i.key as integer))
                filter (
                    where list_contains(
                        json_extract_string(i.value, '$.type.coding[*].code'), 'DL'
                    )
                ) as drivers_license_number,
            first(json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value') order by cast(i.key as integer))
                filter (
                    where json_extract_string(i.value, '$.system')
                        = 'http://standardhealthrecord.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/passportNumber'
                    or list_contains(
                        json_extract_string(i.value, '$.type.coding[*].code'), 'PPN'
                    )
                ) as passport_number
        from json_each(p.resource, '$.identifier') as i
    ) as identifiers on true
    left join lateral (
        select
            first(e.value order by cast(e.key as integer))

        from json_each(p.resource, '$.extension') as e

decoded as (

                case
                    when json_extract_string(c.value, '$.system')
                        = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/v3/MaritalStatus' then 0

                cast(c.key as integer)
            limit 1

    from extracted as e
    left join lateral (

                order by cast(g.key as integer), cast(c.key as integer))
                filter (
                    where json_extract_string(c.value, '$.url') = 'latitude'
                ) as latitude,
            first(json_extract_string(c.value, '$.valueDecimal')
                order by cast(g.key as integer), cast(c.key as integer))
                filter (
                    where json_extract_string(c.value, '$.url') = 'longitude'
                ) as longitude
        from json_each(e.patient_address_json, '$.extension') as g
        cross join lateral json_each(g.value, '$.extension') as c

select

        nullif(synthea_id, ''),
        nullif(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), ''),
        raw_id
    ) as varchar) as patient_id,
    try_cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.birthDate') as date) as birth_date,
    cast(
        try_cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime') as timestamptz)
            at time zone 'UTC'
        as date
    ) as death_date,
    cast(ssn as varchar) as ssn,
    cast(drivers_license_number as varchar) as drivers_license_number,
    cast(passport_number as varchar) as passport_number,
    json_extract_string(official_name, '$.prefix[0]') as patient_prefix,
    json_extract_string(official_name, '$.given[0]') as patient_first_name,
    json_extract_string(official_name, '$.family') as patient_last_name,
    json_extract_string(official_name, '$.suffix[0]') as patient_suffix,
    cast(maiden_name as varchar) as maiden_name,
    cast(
        case coalesce(marital_code, json_extract_string(resource, '$.maritalStatus.text'))
            when 'M' then 'M'
            when 'S' then 'S'
            when 'Never Married' then 'S'
            else null
        end as varchar
    ) as marital_status,
    cast(
        case race_code
            when '1002-5' then 'native'
            when '2028-9' then 'asian'
            when '2054-5' then 'black'
            when '2076-8' then 'hawaiian'
            when '2106-3' then 'white'
            when '2131-1' then 'other'
            else null
        end as varchar
    ) as race,
    cast(
        case ethnicity_code
            when '2135-2' then 'hispanic'
            when '2186-5' then 'nonhispanic'
            else null
        end as varchar
    ) as ethnicity,
    cast(
        case json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender')
            when 'male' then 'M'
            when 'female' then 'F'
            else null
        end as varchar
    ) as patient_gender,
    nullif(concat_ws(
        '  ',
        nullif(json_extract_string(birthplace_json, '$.city'), ''),
        nullif(json_extract_string(birthplace_json, '$.state'), ''),
        nullif(json_extract_string(birthplace_json, '$.country'), '')
    ), '') as birthplace,
    (
        select string_agg(json_extract_string(l.value, '$'), ' ' order by cast(l.key as integer))
        from json_each(patient_address_json, '$.line') as l
    ) as patient_address,
    json_extract_string(patient_address_json, '$.city') as patient_city,
    coalesce(
        (
            select s.state_name
            from {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} as s
            where lower(trim(json_extract_string(patient_address_json, '$.state')))
                in (lower(s.state_name), lower(s.state_abbreviation))
            order by s.state_name
            limit 1
        ),
        json_extract_string(patient_address_json, '$.state')
    ) as patient_state,
    json_extract_string(patient_address_json, '$.district') as patient_county,
    json_extract_string(patient_address_json, '$.postalCode') as patient_zip,
    try_cast(latitude as float) as patient_latitude,
    try_cast(longitude as float) as patient_longitude,
    cast(null as float) as healthcare_expenses,
    cast(null as float) as healthcare_coverage
```
