```sql
WITH resources AS (
    SELECT id AS raw_id, resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'patient') }}
),

selected AS (
    SELECT
        p.*,
        (
            SELECT n.value
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.name') AS n
            WHERE json_extract_string(n.value, '$.use') IS DISTINCT FROM 'maiden'
            ORDER BY
                CASE json_extract_string(n.value, '$.use')
                    WHEN 'official' THEN 0
                    WHEN 'usual' THEN 1
                    ELSE 2
                END,
                CAST(n.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS patient_name,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(n.value, '$.family')
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.name') AS n
            WHERE json_extract_string(n.value, '$.use') = 'maiden'
            ORDER BY CAST(n.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS maiden_family,
        (
            SELECT a.value
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.address') AS a
            ORDER BY
                CASE json_extract_string(a.value, '$.use')
                    WHEN 'home' THEN 0
                    ELSE 1
                END,
                CAST(a.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS patient_address_json,
        (
            SELECT e.value
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS race_extension,
        (
            SELECT e.value
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS ethnicity_extension,
        (
            SELECT json_extract(e.value, '$.valueAddress')
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS birthplace_address
    FROM resources AS p
),

extracted AS (
    SELECT
        p.*,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value')
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.identifier') AS i
            WHERE json_extract_string(i.value, '$.system')
                = 'https://github.com/synthetichealth/synthea'
            ORDER BY CAST(i.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS synthea_id,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value')
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.identifier') AS i
            WHERE json_extract_string(i.value, '$.system')
                    = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/us-ssn'
                OR EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM json_each(i.value, '$.type.coding') AS c
                    WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') IN ('SS', 'SB')
                )
            ORDER BY CAST(i.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS ssn_value,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value')
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.identifier') AS i
            WHERE EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM json_each(i.value, '$.type.coding') AS c
                WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') = 'DL'
            )
            ORDER BY CAST(i.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS drivers_value,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value')
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.identifier') AS i
            WHERE json_extract_string(i.value, '$.system')
                    = 'http://standardhealthrecord.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/passportNumber'
                OR EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM json_each(i.value, '$.type.coding') AS c
                    WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') = 'PPN'
                )
            ORDER BY CAST(i.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS passport_value,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(e.value, '$.valueCoding.code')
            FROM json_each(p.race_extension, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS race_code,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(e.value, '$.valueCoding.code')
            FROM json_each(p.ethnicity_extension, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS ethnicity_code,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code')
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding') AS c
            ORDER BY
                CASE
                    WHEN json_extract_string(c.value, '$.system')
                        = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/v3/MaritalStatus' THEN 0
                    ELSE 1
                END,
                CAST(c.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS marital_code,
        (
            SELECT e.value
            FROM json_each(p.patient_address_json, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS geolocation
    FROM selected AS p
)

SELECT
    CAST(
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(synthea_id, ''),
            NULLIF(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), ''),
            raw_id
        ) AS VARCHAR
    ) AS patient_id,
    TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.birthDate') AS DATE) AS birth_date,
    CAST(
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            TRY_CAST(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime')
                AS TIMESTAMPTZ
            )
        ) AS DATE
    ) AS death_date,
    CAST(ssn_value AS VARCHAR) AS ssn,
    CAST(drivers_value AS VARCHAR) AS drivers_license_number,
    CAST(passport_value AS VARCHAR) AS passport_number,
    json_extract_string(patient_name, '$.prefix[0]') AS patient_prefix,
    json_extract_string(patient_name, '$.given[0]') AS patient_first_name,
    json_extract_string(patient_name, '$.family') AS patient_last_name,
    json_extract_string(patient_name, '$.suffix[0]') AS patient_suffix,
    -- A mother's maiden name is not the patient's own maiden surname.
    CAST(maiden_family AS VARCHAR) AS maiden_name,
    CAST(COALESCE(
        marital_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.maritalStatus.text')
    ) AS VARCHAR) AS marital_status,
    CAST(
        CASE race_code
            WHEN '1002-5' THEN 'native'
            WHEN '2028-9' THEN 'asian'
            WHEN '2054-5' THEN 'black'
            WHEN '2076-8' THEN 'hawaiian'
            WHEN '2106-3' THEN 'white'
            WHEN '2131-1' THEN 'other'
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS race,
    CAST(
        CASE ethnicity_code
            WHEN '2135-2' THEN 'hispanic'
            WHEN '2186-5' THEN 'nonhispanic'
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS ethnicity,
    CAST(
        CASE lower(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender'))
            WHEN 'male' THEN 'M'
            WHEN 'female' THEN 'F'
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS patient_gender,
    NULLIF(
        concat_ws(
            '  ',
            NULLIF(json_extract_string(birthplace_address, '$.city'), ''),
            COALESCE(
                (
                    SELECT s.state_name
                    FROM {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} AS s
                    WHERE lower(s.state_abbreviation) = lower(
                        json_extract_string(birthplace_address, '$.state')
                    )
                    ORDER BY s.state_name
                    LIMIT 1
                ),
                NULLIF(json_extract_string(birthplace_address, '$.state'), '')
            ),
            NULLIF(json_extract_string(birthplace_address, '$.country'), '')
        ),
        ''
    ) AS birthplace,
    (
        SELECT string_agg(
            json_extract_string(l.value, '$'),
            ' ' ORDER BY CAST(l.key AS INTEGER)
        )
        FROM json_each(patient_address_json, '$.line') AS l
    ) AS patient_address,
    json_extract_string(patient_address_json, '$.city') AS patient_city,
    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT s.state_name
            FROM {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} AS s
            WHERE lower(s.state_abbreviation) = lower(
                json_extract_string(patient_address_json, '$.state')
            )
            ORDER BY s.state_name
            LIMIT 1
        ),
        json_extract_string(patient_address_json, '$.state')
    ) AS patient_state,
    json_extract_string(patient_address_json, '$.district') AS patient_county,
    json_extract_string(patient_address_json, '$.postalCode') AS patient_zip,
    TRY_CAST(
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(e.value, '$.valueDecimal')
            FROM json_each(geolocation, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url') = 'latitude'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS FLOAT
    ) AS patient_latitude,
    TRY_CAST(
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(e.value, '$.valueDecimal')
            FROM json_each(geolocation, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url') = 'longitude'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS FLOAT
    ) AS patient_longitude,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_expenses,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_coverage
FROM extracted
```

```sql
with extracted as (
    select
        p.id as raw_id,
        p.resource,
        (
            select i.value
            from json_each(p.resource, '$.name') as i
            where json_extract_string(i.value, '$.use') = 'official'
            order by cast(i.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as official_name,
        (
            select i.value
            from json_each(p.resource, '$.name') as i
            where json_extract_string(i.value, '$.use') = 'maiden'
            order by cast(i.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as maiden_name,
        (
            select a.value
            from json_each(p.resource, '$.address') as a
            order by
                case json_extract_string(a.value, '$.use')
                    when 'home' then 0
                    when 'old' then 2
                    else 1
                end,
                cast(a.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as patient_address,
        (
            select e.value
            from json_each(p.resource, '$.extension') as e
            where json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race'
            order by cast(e.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as race_extension,
        (
            select e.value
            from json_each(p.resource, '$.extension') as e
            where json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity'
            order by cast(e.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as ethnicity_extension,
        (
            select json_extract(e.value, '$.valueAddress')
            from json_each(p.resource, '$.extension') as e
            where json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace'
            order by cast(e.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as birth_address
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'patient') }} as p
),
decoded as (
    select
        e.*,
        coalesce(official_name, json_extract(resource, '$.name[0]')) as selected_name,
        (
            select json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value')
            from json_each(e.resource, '$.identifier') as i
            where json_extract_string(i.value, '$.system')
                = 'https://github.com/synthetichealth/synthea'
            order by cast(i.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as synthea_id,
        (
            select json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value')
            from json_each(e.resource, '$.identifier') as i
            where json_extract_string(i.value, '$.system')
                    = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/us-ssn'
                or list_contains(
                    json_extract_string(i.value, '$.type.coding[*].code'), 'SB'
                )
            order by cast(i.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as ssn_value,
        (
            select json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value')
            from json_each(e.resource, '$.identifier') as i
            where list_contains(
                json_extract_string(i.value, '$.type.coding[*].code'), 'DL'
            )
            order by cast(i.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as drivers_value,
        (
            select json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value')
            from json_each(e.resource, '$.identifier') as i
            where list_contains(
                json_extract_string(i.value, '$.type.coding[*].code'), 'PPN'
            )
            order by cast(i.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as passport_value,
        (
            select json_extract_string(x.value, '$.valueCoding.code')
            from json_each(e.race_extension, '$.extension') as x
            where json_extract_string(x.value, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
            order by cast(x.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as race_code,
        (
            select json_extract_string(x.value, '$.valueCoding.code')
            from json_each(e.ethnicity_extension, '$.extension') as x
            where json_extract_string(x.value, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
            order by cast(x.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as ethnicity_code,
        (
            select g.value
            from json_each(e.patient_address, '$.extension') as g
            where json_extract_string(g.value, '$.url')
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation'
            order by cast(g.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as geolocation
    from extracted as e
)
select
    cast(coalesce(
        synthea_id,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'),
        raw_id
    ) as varchar) as patient_id,
    try_cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.birthDate') as date) as birth_date,
    cast(
        try_cast(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime')
            as timestamp with time zone
        ) at time zone 'UTC'
        as date
    ) as death_date,
    cast(ssn_value as varchar) as ssn,
    cast(drivers_value as varchar) as drivers_license_number,
    cast(passport_value as varchar) as passport_number,
    cast(nullif(array_to_string(
        json_extract_string(selected_name, '$.prefix[*]'), ' '
    ), '') as varchar) as patient_prefix,
    cast(json_extract_string(selected_name, '$.given[0]') as varchar)
        as patient_first_name,
    cast(json_extract_string(selected_name, '$.family') as varchar)
        as patient_last_name,
    cast(nullif(array_to_string(
        json_extract_string(selected_name, '$.suffix[*]'), ' '
    ), '') as varchar) as patient_suffix,
    cast(json_extract_string(maiden_name, '$.family') as varchar) as maiden_name,
    cast(
        case coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.maritalStatus.text')
        )
            when 'M' then 'M'
            when 'S' then 'S'
            when 'Never Married' then 'S'
        end
        as varchar
    ) as marital_status,
    cast(
        case race_code
            when '1002-5' then 'native'
            when '2028-9' then 'asian'
            when '2054-5' then 'black'
            when '2076-8' then 'hawaiian'
            when '2106-3' then 'white'
            when '2131-1' then 'other'
        end
        as varchar
    ) as race,
    cast(
        case ethnicity_code
            when '2135-2' then 'hispanic'
            when '2186-5' then 'nonhispanic'
        end
        as varchar
    ) as ethnicity,
    cast(
        case lower(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender'))
            when 'male' then 'M'
            when 'female' then 'F'
        end
        as varchar
    ) as patient_gender,
    cast(nullif(concat_ws(
        '  ',
        nullif(json_extract_string(birth_address, '$.city'), ''),
        coalesce(
            (
                select min(s.state_name)
                from {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} as s
                where lower(s.state_abbreviation)
                    = lower(json_extract_string(birth_address, '$.state'))
            ),
            nullif(json_extract_string(birth_address, '$.state'), '')
        ),
        nullif(json_extract_string(birth_address, '$.country'), '')
    ), '') as varchar) as birthplace,
    cast(nullif(array_to_string(
        json_extract_string(patient_address, '$.line[*]'), ' '
    ), '') as varchar) as patient_address,
    cast(json_extract_string(patient_address, '$.city') as varchar) as patient_city,
    cast(coalesce(
        (
            select min(s.state_name)
            from {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} as s
            where lower(s.state_abbreviation)
                = lower(json_extract_string(patient_address, '$.state'))
        ),
        json_extract_string(patient_address, '$.state')
    ) as varchar) as patient_state,
    cast(json_extract_string(patient_address, '$.district') as varchar)
        as patient_county,
    cast(json_extract_string(patient_address, '$.postalCode') as varchar)
        as patient_zip,
    (
        select try_cast(json_extract_string(g.value, '$.valueDecimal') as float)
        from json_each(d.geolocation, '$.extension') as g
        where json_extract_string(g.value, '$.url') = 'latitude'
        order by cast(g.key as integer)
        limit 1
    ) as patient_latitude,
    (
        select try_cast(json_extract_string(g.value, '$.valueDecimal') as float)
        from json_each(d.geolocation, '$.extension') as g
        where json_extract_string(g.value, '$.url') = 'longitude'
        order by cast(g.key as integer)
        limit 1
    ) as patient_longitude,
    cast(null as float) as healthcare_expenses,
    cast(null as float) as healthcare_coverage
from decoded as d
```

## Mapping hints
- patient_id is the resource id. birth_date is birthDate. death_date is the first 10 characters of deceasedDateTime (the local date).
- ssn, drivers licence and passport are identifier[] entries whose type.coding[0].code is SS, DL and PPN.
- Names come from the name[] entry with use = official (prefix[0], given[0], family, suffix[0]); the maiden name is the family of the entry with use = maiden.
- marital status is maritalStatus.coding[0].code. gender: male becomes M, female becomes F.
- race is the ombCategory display of the us-core-race extension, written as the acquirer writes it: White = white, Black or African American = black, Asian = asian, American Indian or Alaska Native = native, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander = hawaiian, anything else = other. ethnicity: Hispanic or Latino = hispanic, otherwise nonhispanic.
- birthplace is city, state and country of the birthPlace extension joined by two spaces.
- address is address[0].line[0]; city and postalCode as given; the state is an abbreviation and the acquirer stores the full name (stg_map__states); latitude and longitude are in the geolocation extension of address[0].
- The county and the two healthcare amounts are not in the resource: return NULL.

```sql
WITH extracted AS (
    SELECT
        p.resource,
        json_extract_string(p.resource, '$.id') AS patient_id,
        (
            SELECT n.value
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.name') AS n
            WHERE json_extract_string(n.value, '$.use') = 'official'
            ORDER BY try_cast(n.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS official_name,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(n.value, '$.family')
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.name') AS n
            WHERE json_extract_string(n.value, '$.use') = 'maiden'
            ORDER BY try_cast(n.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS maiden_name,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value')
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.identifier') AS i
            WHERE json_extract_string(i.value, '$.type.coding[0].code') IN ('SS', 'SB')
               OR json_extract_string(i.value, '$.system') = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/us-ssn'
            ORDER BY try_cast(i.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS ssn,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value')
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.identifier') AS i
            WHERE json_extract_string(i.value, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'DL'
            ORDER BY try_cast(i.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS drivers_license_number,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value')
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.identifier') AS i
            WHERE json_extract_string(i.value, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'PPN'
            ORDER BY try_cast(i.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS passport_number,
        (
            SELECT e.value
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race'
            ORDER BY try_cast(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS race_extension,
        (
            SELECT e.value
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity'
            ORDER BY try_cast(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS ethnicity_extension,
        (
            SELECT json_extract(e.value, '$.valueAddress')
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace'
            ORDER BY try_cast(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS birth_address,
        json_extract(p.resource, '$.address[0]') AS patient_address_json
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'patient') }} AS p
),
normalized AS (
    SELECT
        e.*,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(c.value, '$.valueCoding.display')
            FROM json_each(e.race_extension, '$.extension') AS c
            WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
            ORDER BY try_cast(c.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS race_display,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(c.value, '$.valueCoding.display')
            FROM json_each(e.ethnicity_extension, '$.extension') AS c
            WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
            ORDER BY try_cast(c.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS ethnicity_display,
        (
            SELECT g.value
            FROM json_each(e.patient_address_json, '$.extension') AS g
            WHERE json_extract_string(g.value, '$.url')
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation'
            ORDER BY try_cast(g.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS geolocation,
        json_extract_string(e.patient_address_json, '$.state') AS source_state
    FROM extracted AS e
)
SELECT
    n.patient_id::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
    try_cast(json_extract_string(n.resource, '$.birthDate') AS DATE) AS birth_date,
    cast(
        try_cast(
            json_extract_string(n.resource, '$.deceasedDateTime') AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS DATE
    ) AS death_date,
    n.ssn::VARCHAR AS ssn,
    n.drivers_license_number::VARCHAR AS drivers_license_number,
    n.passport_number::VARCHAR AS passport_number,
    json_extract_string(n.official_name, '$.prefix[0]') AS patient_prefix,
    json_extract_string(n.official_name, '$.given[0]') AS patient_first_name,
    json_extract_string(n.official_name, '$.family') AS patient_last_name,
    json_extract_string(n.official_name, '$.suffix[0]') AS patient_suffix,
    n.maiden_name::VARCHAR AS maiden_name,
    json_extract_string(n.resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code') AS marital_status,
    CASE n.race_display
        WHEN 'White' THEN 'white'
        WHEN 'Black or African American' THEN 'black'
        WHEN 'Asian' THEN 'asian'
        WHEN 'American Indian or Alaska Native' THEN 'native'
        WHEN 'Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander' THEN 'hawaiian'
        ELSE 'other'
    END::VARCHAR AS race,
    CASE
        WHEN n.ethnicity_display = 'Hispanic or Latino' THEN 'hispanic'
        ELSE 'nonhispanic'
    END::VARCHAR AS ethnicity,
    CASE json_extract_string(n.resource, '$.gender')
        WHEN 'male' THEN 'M'
        WHEN 'female' THEN 'F'
        ELSE NULL
    END::VARCHAR AS patient_gender,
    nullif(
        concat_ws(
            '  ',
            nullif(json_extract_string(n.birth_address, '$.city'), ''),
            nullif(json_extract_string(n.birth_address, '$.state'), ''),
            nullif(json_extract_string(n.birth_address, '$.country'), '')
        ),
        ''
    )::VARCHAR AS birthplace,
    json_extract_string(n.patient_address_json, '$.line[0]') AS patient_address,
    json_extract_string(n.patient_address_json, '$.city') AS patient_city,
    coalesce(
        (
            SELECT s.state_name
            FROM {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} AS s
            WHERE upper(trim(s.state_abbreviation)) = upper(trim(n.source_state))
               OR lower(trim(s.state_name)) = lower(trim(n.source_state))
            ORDER BY s.state_name
            LIMIT 1
        ),
        n.source_state
    )::VARCHAR AS patient_state,
    cast(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_county,
    json_extract_string(n.patient_address_json, '$.postalCode') AS patient_zip,
    try_cast(
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(c.value, '$.valueDecimal')
            FROM json_each(n.geolocation, '$.extension') AS c
            WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.url') = 'latitude'
            ORDER BY try_cast(c.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS FLOAT
    ) AS patient_latitude,
    try_cast(
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(c.value, '$.valueDecimal')
            FROM json_each(n.geolocation, '$.extension') AS c
            WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.url') = 'longitude'
            ORDER BY try_cast(c.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS FLOAT
    ) AS patient_longitude,
    cast(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_expenses,
    cast(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_coverage
FROM normalized AS n
```

## Mapping hints
- patient_id is the resource id. birth_date is birthDate. death_date is the first 10 characters of deceasedDateTime (the local date).
- ssn, drivers licence and passport are identifier[] entries whose type.coding[0].code is SS, DL and PPN.
- Names come from the name[] entry with use = official (prefix[0], given[0], family, suffix[0]); the maiden name is the family of the entry with use = maiden.
- marital status is maritalStatus.coding[0].code. gender: male becomes M, female becomes F.
- race is the ombCategory display of the us-core-race extension, written as the acquirer writes it: White = white, Black or African American = black, Asian = asian, American Indian or Alaska Native = native, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander = hawaiian, anything else = other. ethnicity: Hispanic or Latino = hispanic, otherwise nonhispanic.
- birthplace is city, state and country of the birthPlace extension joined by two spaces.
- address is address[0].line[0]; city and postalCode as given; the state is an abbreviation and the acquirer stores the full name (stg_map__states); latitude and longitude are in the geolocation extension of address[0].
- The county and the two healthcare amounts are not in the resource: return NULL.

```sql
WITH extracted AS (
    SELECT
        p.resource,
        (
            SELECT n.value
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.name') AS n
            WHERE json_extract_string(n.value, '$.use') = 'official'
            ORDER BY TRY_CAST(n.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS official_name,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(n.value, '$.family')
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.name') AS n
            WHERE json_extract_string(n.value, '$.use') = 'maiden'
            ORDER BY TRY_CAST(n.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS maiden_name,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value')
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.identifier') AS i
            WHERE json_extract_string(i.value, '$.type.coding[0].code') IN ('SS', 'SB')
               OR json_extract_string(i.value, '$.system') = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/us-ssn'
            ORDER BY TRY_CAST(i.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS ssn,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value')
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.identifier') AS i
            WHERE json_extract_string(i.value, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'DL'
            ORDER BY TRY_CAST(i.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS drivers_license_number,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value')
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.identifier') AS i
            WHERE json_extract_string(i.value, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'PPN'
            ORDER BY TRY_CAST(i.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS passport_number,
        (
            SELECT e.value
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race'
            ORDER BY TRY_CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS race_extension,
        (
            SELECT e.value
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity'
            ORDER BY TRY_CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS ethnicity_extension,
        (
            SELECT json_extract(e.value, '$.valueAddress')
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace'
            ORDER BY TRY_CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS birth_address,
        json_extract(p.resource, '$.address[0]') AS patient_address_json
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'patient') }} AS p
),
details AS (
    SELECT
        extracted.*,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(e.value, '$.valueCoding.display')
            FROM json_each(race_extension, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
            ORDER BY TRY_CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS race_display,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(e.value, '$.valueCoding.display')
            FROM json_each(ethnicity_extension, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
            ORDER BY TRY_CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS ethnicity_display,
        (
            SELECT e.value
            FROM json_each(patient_address_json, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation'
            ORDER BY TRY_CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS geolocation,
        json_extract_string(patient_address_json, '$.state') AS source_state
    FROM extracted
)
SELECT
    json_extract_string(resource, '$.id') AS patient_id,
    TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.birthDate') AS DATE) AS birth_date,
    CAST(
        TRY_CAST(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime') AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
        AS DATE
    ) AS death_date,
    ssn,
    drivers_license_number,
    passport_number,
    json_extract_string(official_name, '$.prefix[0]') AS patient_prefix,
    json_extract_string(official_name, '$.given[0]') AS patient_first_name,
    json_extract_string(official_name, '$.family') AS patient_last_name,
    json_extract_string(official_name, '$.suffix[0]') AS patient_suffix,
    maiden_name,
    json_extract_string(resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code') AS marital_status,
    CASE race_display
        WHEN 'White' THEN 'white'
        WHEN 'Black or African American' THEN 'black'
        WHEN 'Asian' THEN 'asian'
        WHEN 'American Indian or Alaska Native' THEN 'native'
        WHEN 'Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander' THEN 'hawaiian'
        ELSE 'other'
    END AS race,
    CASE ethnicity_display
        WHEN 'Hispanic or Latino' THEN 'hispanic'
        ELSE 'nonhispanic'
    END AS ethnicity,
    CASE json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender')
        WHEN 'male' THEN 'M'
        WHEN 'female' THEN 'F'
        ELSE NULL
    END AS patient_gender,
    NULLIF(
        concat_ws(
            '  ',
            json_extract_string(birth_address, '$.city'),
            json_extract_string(birth_address, '$.state'),
            json_extract_string(birth_address, '$.country')
        ),
        ''
    ) AS birthplace,
    json_extract_string(patient_address_json, '$.line[0]') AS patient_address,
    json_extract_string(patient_address_json, '$.city') AS patient_city,
    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT CAST(s.state_name AS VARCHAR)
            FROM {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} AS s
            WHERE upper(trim(s.state_abbreviation)) = upper(trim(details.source_state))
               OR lower(trim(s.state_name)) = lower(trim(details.source_state))
            ORDER BY s.state_name
            LIMIT 1
        ),
        source_state
    ) AS patient_state,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_county,
    json_extract_string(patient_address_json, '$.postalCode') AS patient_zip,
    (
        SELECT TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(e.value, '$.valueDecimal') AS FLOAT)
        FROM json_each(geolocation, '$.extension') AS e
        WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url') = 'latitude'
        ORDER BY TRY_CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS patient_latitude,
    (
        SELECT TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(e.value, '$.valueDecimal') AS FLOAT)
        FROM json_each(geolocation, '$.extension') AS e
        WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url') = 'longitude'
        ORDER BY TRY_CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS patient_longitude,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_expenses,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_coverage
FROM details
```

```sql
WITH extracted AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id)::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
        (
            TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
            AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
        ) AS encounter_start_datetime,
        (
            TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end') AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
            AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
        ) AS period_end_datetime,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference') AS organization_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.reference') AS provider_reference,
        TRIM(
            regexp_replace(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.display'),
                '^Dr[.]?\s+',
                '',
                'i'
            )
        ) AS provider_name,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') AS class_code,
        encounter_type.code AS encounter_code,
        COALESCE(
            encounter_type.display,
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].text')
        ) AS encounter_description,
        reason.code AS encounter_reason_code,
        COALESCE(
            reason.display,
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].text')
        ) AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }} AS e
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') AS code,
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.display') AS display
        FROM json_each(e.resource, '$.type') AS t,
             json_each(t.value, '$.coding') AS c
        WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
        ORDER BY TRY_CAST(t.key AS INTEGER), TRY_CAST(c.key AS INTEGER)
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS encounter_type ON TRUE
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') AS code,
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.display') AS display
        FROM json_each(e.resource, '$.reason') AS r,
             json_each(r.value, '$.coding') AS c
        WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
        ORDER BY TRY_CAST(r.key AS INTEGER), TRY_CAST(c.key AS INTEGER)
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS reason ON TRUE
),
normalized AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN patient_reference LIKE 'urn:uuid:%'
                THEN SUBSTR(patient_reference, 10)
            WHEN patient_reference NOT LIKE '%?%'
                THEN NULLIF(
                    regexp_extract(patient_reference, '(?:^|/)Patient/([^/]+)', 1),
                    ''
                )
        END AS patient_id,
        CASE
            WHEN organization_reference LIKE 'urn:uuid:%'
                THEN SUBSTR(organization_reference, 10)
            WHEN organization_reference LIKE '%?identifier=https://github.com/synthetichealth/synthea|%'
                THEN SPLIT_PART(organization_reference, '|', 2)
            WHEN organization_reference NOT LIKE '%?%'
                THEN NULLIF(
                    regexp_extract(organization_reference, '(?:^|/)Organization/([^/]+)', 1),
                    ''
                )
        END AS organization_id,
        CASE
            WHEN provider_reference LIKE 'urn:uuid:%'
                THEN SUBSTR(provider_reference, 10)
            WHEN provider_reference LIKE '%?identifier=https://github.com/synthetichealth/synthea|%'
                THEN SPLIT_PART(provider_reference, '|', 2)
            WHEN provider_reference NOT LIKE '%?%'
                THEN NULLIF(
                    regexp_extract(provider_reference, '(?:^|/)Practitioner/([^/]+)', 1),
                    ''
                )
        END AS referenced_provider_id
    FROM extracted
),
provider_lookup AS (
    -- NPI search references cannot be joined to the provider UUID directly.
    -- Use the displayed name within the organization only when unambiguous.
    SELECT
        "ORGANIZATION" AS organization_id,
        LOWER(TRIM("NAME")) AS provider_name,
        MIN("Id") AS provider_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'providers') }}
    GROUP BY "ORGANIZATION", LOWER(TRIM("NAME"))
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "Id") = 1
),
resolved AS (
    SELECT
        n.*,
        COALESCE(n.referenced_provider_id, p.provider_id) AS provider_id,
        COALESCE(n.period_end_datetime, n.encounter_start_datetime)
            AS encounter_stop_datetime
    FROM normalized AS n
    LEFT JOIN provider_lookup AS p
        ON n.organization_id = p.organization_id
        AND LOWER(n.provider_name) = p.provider_name
)
SELECT
    encounter_id::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
    encounter_start_datetime::TIMESTAMP AS encounter_start_datetime,
    encounter_start_datetime::DATE AS encounter_start_date,
    encounter_stop_datetime::TIMESTAMP AS encounter_stop_datetime,
    -- Preserve the acquirer's staging convention, including its start-date preference.
    COALESCE(
        encounter_start_datetime::DATE,
        encounter_stop_datetime::DATE
    ) AS encounter_stop_date,
    patient_id::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
    organization_id::VARCHAR AS organization_id,
    provider_id::VARCHAR AS provider_id,
    NULL::VARCHAR AS payer_id,
    CASE
        WHEN encounter_code IN ('162673000', '410620009') THEN 'wellness'
        WHEN UPPER(class_code) = 'AMB' THEN 'ambulatory'
        WHEN UPPER(class_code) = 'EMER' THEN 'emergency'
        WHEN UPPER(class_code) = 'IMP' THEN 'inpatient'
        WHEN UPPER(class_code) = 'ACUTE' THEN 'inpatient'
        WHEN UPPER(class_code) = 'NONAC' THEN 'inpatient'
        WHEN UPPER(class_code) = 'OBSENC' THEN 'observation'
        WHEN UPPER(class_code) = 'PRENC' THEN 'pre-admission'
        WHEN UPPER(class_code) = 'SS' THEN 'outpatient'
        WHEN UPPER(class_code) = 'VR' THEN 'virtual'
        WHEN UPPER(class_code) = 'HH' THEN 'home'
        ELSE LOWER(class_code)
    END::VARCHAR AS encounter_class,
    encounter_code::VARCHAR AS encounter_code,
    encounter_description::VARCHAR AS encounter_description,
    NULL::FLOAT AS base_encounter_cost,
    NULL::FLOAT AS total_encounter_cost,
    NULL::FLOAT AS encounter_payer_coverage,
    encounter_reason_code::VARCHAR AS encounter_reason_code,
    encounter_reason_description::VARCHAR AS encounter_reason_description
FROM resolved
```

```sql
WITH provider_lookup AS (
    SELECT
        "ORGANIZATION" AS organization_id,
        lower(trim(regexp_replace("NAME", '^Dr\.?\s+', '', 'i'))) AS provider_name,
        CASE
            WHEN count(DISTINCT "Id") = 1 THEN min("Id")
        END AS provider_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'providers') }}
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),

extracted AS (
    SELECT
        coalesce(json_extract_string(e.resource, '$.id'), e.id) AS encounter_id,
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            try_cast(json_extract_string(e.resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
        ) AS start_datetime,
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            try_cast(json_extract_string(e.resource, '$.period.end') AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
        ) AS end_datetime,
        json_extract_string(e.resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_reference,
        json_extract_string(e.resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference') AS organization_reference,
        json_extract_string(e.resource, '$.participant[0].individual.reference') AS provider_reference,
        lower(trim(regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(e.resource, '$.participant[0].individual.display'),
            '^Dr\.?\s+',
            '',
            'i'
        ))) AS provider_name,
        json_extract_string(e.resource, '$.class.code') AS class_code,
        encounter_type.code AS encounter_code,
        coalesce(
            encounter_type.display,
            json_extract_string(e.resource, '$.type[0].text')
        ) AS encounter_description,
        encounter_reason.code AS encounter_reason_code,
        coalesce(
            encounter_reason.display,
            json_extract_string(e.resource, '$.reason[0].text')
        ) AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }} AS e
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') AS code,
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.display') AS display
        FROM json_each(e.resource, '$.type') AS t,
             json_each(t.value, '$.coding') AS c
        ORDER BY
            CASE
                WHEN json_extract_string(c.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
                    THEN 0
                ELSE 1
            END,
            try_cast(t.key AS INTEGER),
            try_cast(c.key AS INTEGER)
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS encounter_type ON true
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') AS code,
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.display') AS display
        FROM json_each(e.resource, '$.reason') AS r,
             json_each(r.value, '$.coding') AS c
        WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
        ORDER BY try_cast(r.key AS INTEGER), try_cast(c.key AS INTEGER)
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS encounter_reason ON true
),

normalized AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN patient_reference LIKE 'urn:uuid:%'
                THEN substr(patient_reference, 10)
            WHEN contains(patient_reference, '?identifier=')
                THEN nullif(split_part(patient_reference, '|', 2), '')
            ELSE nullif(
                regexp_extract(
                    patient_reference,
                    '(?:^|/)Patient/([^/?#]+)',
                    1
                ),
                ''
            )
        END AS patient_id,
        CASE
            WHEN organization_reference LIKE 'urn:uuid:%'
                THEN substr(organization_reference, 10)
            WHEN contains(organization_reference, '?identifier=')
                THEN nullif(split_part(organization_reference, '|', 2), '')
            ELSE nullif(
                regexp_extract(
                    organization_reference,
                    '(?:^|/)Organization/([^/?#]+)',
                    1
                ),
                ''
            )
        END AS organization_id,
        CASE
            WHEN provider_reference LIKE 'urn:uuid:%'
                THEN substr(provider_reference, 10)
            WHEN contains(
                provider_reference,
                '?identifier=https://github.com/synthetichealth/synthea|'
            )
                THEN nullif(split_part(provider_reference, '|', 2), '')
            WHEN NOT contains(provider_reference, '?identifier=')
                THEN nullif(
                    regexp_extract(
                        provider_reference,
                        '(?:^|/)Practitioner/([^/?#]+)',
                        1
                    ),
                    ''
                )
        END AS direct_provider_id,
        coalesce(end_datetime, start_datetime) AS stop_datetime
    FROM extracted
)

SELECT
    cast(n.encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
    cast(n.start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_start_datetime,
    cast(n.start_datetime AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date,
    cast(n.stop_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_stop_datetime,
    -- Preserve the acquirer's start-date-first stop-date convention.
    coalesce(
        cast(n.start_datetime AS DATE),
        cast(n.stop_datetime AS DATE)
    ) AS encounter_stop_date,
    cast(n.patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
    cast(n.organization_id AS VARCHAR) AS organization_id,
    cast(coalesce(n.direct_provider_id, p.provider_id) AS VARCHAR) AS provider_id,
    cast(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id,
    cast(
        CASE
            WHEN n.class_code = 'AMB' AND n.encounter_code = '162673000'
                THEN 'wellness'
            WHEN n.class_code = 'AMB' AND n.encounter_code = '308335008'
                THEN 'outpatient'
            WHEN n.class_code = 'AMB' THEN 'ambulatory'
            WHEN n.class_code = 'EMER' THEN 'emergency'
            WHEN n.class_code = 'IMP' THEN 'inpatient'
            WHEN n.class_code = 'ACUTE' THEN 'inpatient'
            WHEN n.class_code = 'OBSENC' THEN 'observation'
            WHEN n.class_code = 'SS' THEN 'shortstay'
            WHEN n.class_code = 'HH' THEN 'home'
            WHEN n.class_code = 'VR' THEN 'virtual'
            ELSE lower(n.class_code)
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS encounter_class,
    cast(n.encounter_code AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_code,
    cast(n.encounter_description AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_description,
    cast(NULL AS FLOAT) AS base_encounter_cost,
    cast(NULL AS FLOAT) AS total_encounter_cost,
    cast(NULL AS FLOAT) AS encounter_payer_coverage,
    cast(n.encounter_reason_code AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_reason_code,
    cast(n.encounter_reason_description AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_reason_description
FROM normalized AS n
LEFT JOIN provider_lookup AS p
    ON n.organization_id = p.organization_id
    AND n.provider_name = p.provider_name
```

- The acquirer's text has every comma replaced by a space. Payer and the three cost columns are not in the resource: return NULL.

```sql
WITH extracted AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id)::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
        (
            TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
            AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
        )::TIMESTAMP AS start_datetime,
        (
            TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end') AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
            AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
        )::TIMESTAMP AS end_datetime,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference') AS organization_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.reference') AS provider_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.display') AS provider_display,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') AS class_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code') AS encounter_code,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].text')
        ) AS encounter_description,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].code') AS encounter_reason_code,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].text')
        ) AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }}
),
normalized AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN patient_reference LIKE '%?identifier=%'
                THEN NULLIF(regexp_extract(patient_reference, '\|([^|]+)$', 1), '')
            WHEN starts_with(patient_reference, 'urn:uuid:')
                THEN substr(patient_reference, 10)
            ELSE NULLIF(
                regexp_extract(patient_reference, '([^/]+)(/_history/[^/]+)?$', 1),
                ''
            )
        END::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
        CASE
            WHEN organization_reference LIKE '%?identifier=%'
                THEN NULLIF(regexp_extract(organization_reference, '\|([^|]+)$', 1), '')
            WHEN starts_with(organization_reference, 'urn:uuid:')
                THEN substr(organization_reference, 10)
            ELSE NULLIF(
                regexp_extract(organization_reference, '([^/]+)(/_history/[^/]+)?$', 1),
                ''
            )
        END::VARCHAR AS organization_id,
        lower(trim(regexp_replace(
            provider_display,
            '^(Dr[.]?|Doctor)[[:space:]]+',
            '',
            'i'
        ))) AS provider_name
    FROM extracted
),
provider_lookup AS (
    -- Only resolve a display name when it identifies exactly one provider
    -- within the encounter's organization.
    SELECT
        "ORGANIZATION" AS organization_id,
        lower(trim("NAME")) AS provider_name,
        min("Id")::VARCHAR AS provider_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'providers') }}
    GROUP BY "ORGANIZATION", lower(trim("NAME"))
    HAVING count(DISTINCT "Id") = 1
),
resolved AS (
    SELECT
        e.*,
        CASE
            WHEN e.provider_reference LIKE '%?identifier=%'
                THEN p.provider_id
            WHEN starts_with(e.provider_reference, 'urn:uuid:')
                THEN substr(e.provider_reference, 10)
            ELSE NULLIF(
                regexp_extract(
                    e.provider_reference,
                    '([^/]+)(/_history/[^/]+)?$',
                    1
                ),
                ''
            )
        END::VARCHAR AS provider_id
    FROM normalized AS e
    LEFT JOIN provider_lookup AS p
        ON e.organization_id = p.organization_id
       AND e.provider_name = p.provider_name
)
SELECT
    encounter_id::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
    start_datetime::TIMESTAMP AS encounter_start_datetime,
    start_datetime::DATE AS encounter_start_date,
    COALESCE(end_datetime, start_datetime)::TIMESTAMP AS encounter_stop_datetime,
    -- Preserve the acquirer's start-date-first convention for this column.
    COALESCE(start_datetime::DATE, end_datetime::DATE) AS encounter_stop_date,
    patient_id::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
    organization_id::VARCHAR AS organization_id,
    provider_id::VARCHAR AS provider_id,
    NULL::VARCHAR AS payer_id,
    CASE
        WHEN upper(class_code) = 'AMB'
             AND encounter_code IN ('162673000', '410620009', '185349003')
            THEN 'wellness'
        WHEN upper(class_code) = 'AMB' AND encounter_code = '308335008'
            THEN 'outpatient'
        WHEN upper(class_code) = 'AMB' THEN 'ambulatory'
        WHEN upper(class_code) = 'EMER' THEN 'emergency'
        WHEN upper(class_code) IN ('IMP', 'ACUTE', 'NONAC') THEN 'inpatient'
        WHEN upper(class_code) = 'OBSENC' THEN 'observation'
        WHEN upper(class_code) = 'SS' THEN 'shortstay'
        WHEN upper(class_code) = 'HH' THEN 'home'
        WHEN upper(class_code) = 'VR' THEN 'virtual'
        ELSE lower(class_code)
    END::VARCHAR AS encounter_class,
    encounter_code::VARCHAR AS encounter_code,
    encounter_description::VARCHAR AS encounter_description,
    NULL::FLOAT AS base_encounter_cost,
    NULL::FLOAT AS total_encounter_cost,
    NULL::FLOAT AS encounter_payer_coverage,
    encounter_reason_code::VARCHAR AS encounter_reason_code,
    encounter_reason_description::VARCHAR AS encounter_reason_description
FROM resolved
```

## Mapping hints
- encounter_id is the resource id; the patient is subject.reference without the urn:uuid: prefix; start and stop are period.start and period.end (they carry a UTC offset; the contract wants UTC).
- organization is the identifier after the | in serviceProvider.reference. The provider is not given by id: participant[0].individual.display is 'Dr. ' plus the provider's NAME in the shared providers table (match on name and organization).
- encounter class: class.code EMER = emergency, IMP = inpatient; for AMB look at type[0].coding[0].code: 702927004 = urgentcare, 162673000 / 410620009 / 308646001 = wellness, otherwise ambulatory.
- code and description are type[0].coding[0].code and .display; the reason is reasonCode[0].coding[0] in R4 and reason[0].coding[0] in STU3.
- The acquirer's text has every comma replaced by a space. Payer and the three cost columns are not in the resource: return NULL.
text:
```sql
WITH provider_lookup AS (
    SELECT
        "ORGANIZATION" AS organization_id,
        "NAME" AS provider_name,
        MIN("Id") AS provider_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'providers') }}
    GROUP BY "ORGANIZATION", "NAME"
),

extracted AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id) AS encounter_id,
        TRY_CAST(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS encounter_start_datetime,
        TRY_CAST(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end') AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS source_stop_datetime,
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
            '^urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) AS patient_id,
        NULLIF(
            split_part(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference'),
                '|',
                2
            ),
            ''
        ) AS organization_id,
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.display'),
            '^Dr\. ',
            ''
        ) AS provider_name,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') AS class_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code') AS encounter_code,
        replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display'),
            ',',
            ' '
        ) AS encounter_description,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].code')
            AS encounter_reason_code,
        replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].display'),
            ',',
            ' '
        ) AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }}
),

normalized AS (
    SELECT
        e.*,
        COALESCE(source_stop_datetime, encounter_start_datetime)
            AS encounter_stop_datetime,
        CASE
            WHEN class_code = 'EMER' THEN 'emergency'
            WHEN class_code = 'IMP' THEN 'inpatient'
            WHEN class_code = 'AMB' THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN encounter_code = '702927004' THEN 'urgentcare'
                    WHEN encounter_code IN (
                        '162673000', '410620009', '308646001'
                    ) THEN 'wellness'
                    ELSE 'ambulatory'
                END
            ELSE lower(class_code)
        END AS encounter_class
    FROM extracted AS e
)

SELECT
    CAST(e.encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
    CAST(e.encounter_start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_start_datetime,
    CAST(e.encounter_start_datetime AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date,
    CAST(e.encounter_stop_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_stop_datetime,
    -- Preserve the acquirer's start-date-first stop-date convention.
    COALESCE(
        CAST(e.encounter_start_datetime AS DATE),
        CAST(e.encounter_stop_datetime AS DATE)
    ) AS encounter_stop_date,
    CAST(e.patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
    CAST(e.organization_id AS VARCHAR) AS organization_id,
    CAST(p.provider_id AS VARCHAR) AS provider_id,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id,
    CAST(e.encounter_class AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_class,
    CAST(e.encounter_code AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_code,
    CAST(e.encounter_description AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_description,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS base_encounter_cost,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS total_encounter_cost,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS encounter_payer_coverage,
    CAST(e.encounter_reason_code AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_reason_code,
    CAST(e.encounter_reason_description AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_reason_description
FROM normalized AS e
LEFT JOIN provider_lookup AS p
    ON e.organization_id = p.organization_id
    AND e.provider_name = p.provider_name
```

```sql
WITH extracted AS (
    SELECT
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetDateTime') AS onset_datetime,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.abatementDateTime') AS abatement_datetime,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference') AS encounter_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text') AS condition_text,
        json_extract(resource, '$.code.coding') AS codings
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'condition') }}
),
selected_coding AS (
    SELECT
        e.*,
        c.condition_code,
        c.condition_display
    FROM extracted AS e
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            json_extract_string(j.value, '$.code') AS condition_code,
            json_extract_string(j.value, '$.display') AS condition_display
        FROM json_each(e.codings) AS j
        WHERE json_extract_string(j.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
        ORDER BY CAST(j.key AS INTEGER)
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS c ON TRUE
)
SELECT
    CAST(
        TRY_CAST(onset_datetime AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
        AS DATE
    ) AS condition_start_date,
    CAST(
        TRY_CAST(abatement_datetime AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
        AS DATE
    ) AS condition_stop_date,
    CAST(
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                NULLIF(patient_reference, ''),
                '^urn:uuid:',
                ''

            '^(?:.*/)?Patient/([^/]+)(?:/_history/[^/]+)?$',
            '\1'

    CAST(
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                NULLIF(encounter_reference, ''),
                '^urn:uuid:',
                ''

            '^(?:.*/)?Encounter/([^/]+)(?:/_history/[^/]+)?$',
            '\1'
        ) AS VARCHAR

    CAST(condition_code AS VARCHAR) AS condition_code,
    CAST(
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(condition_display, ''),
            NULLIF(condition_text, '')
        ) AS VARCHAR
    ) AS condition_description
FROM selected_coding
```

```sql
WITH extracted AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id)::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
        CAST(
            TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
            AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP
        ) AS start_datetime,
        CAST(
            TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end') AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
            AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP
        ) AS end_datetime,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference') AS organization_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.reference') AS provider_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.display') AS provider_display,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') AS class_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code') AS encounter_code,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].text')
        ) AS encounter_description,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].code') AS encounter_reason_code,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].text')
        ) AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }}
),

normalized AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN patient_reference LIKE 'urn:uuid:%'
                THEN substr(patient_reference, 10)
            ELSE NULLIF(
                regexp_extract(
                    patient_reference,
                    '(?:^|/)Patient/([^/?#]+)',
                    1
                ),
                ''
            )
        END AS patient_id,
        CASE
            WHEN organization_reference LIKE '%?identifier=%|%'
                THEN NULLIF(regexp_extract(organization_reference, '\|([^&#]+)', 1), '')
            WHEN organization_reference LIKE 'urn:uuid:%'
                THEN substr(organization_reference, 10)
            ELSE NULLIF(
                regexp_extract(
                    organization_reference,
                    '(?:^|/)Organization/([^/?#]+)',
                    1
                ),
                ''
            )
        END AS organization_id,
        CASE
            WHEN provider_reference LIKE 'urn:uuid:%'
                THEN substr(provider_reference, 10)
            ELSE NULLIF(
                regexp_extract(
                    provider_reference,
                    '(?:^|/)Practitioner/([^/?#]+)',
                    1
                ),
                ''
            )
        END AS direct_provider_id,
        lower(
            trim(regexp_replace(provider_display, '^Dr\.?\s+', '', 'i'))
        ) AS provider_name
    FROM extracted
),

-- NPI conditional references cannot be used as Synthea provider IDs.
-- Resolve them through the supplied provider name and organization instead;
-- leave ambiguous matches unknown rather than multiplying encounter rows.
provider_lookup AS (
    SELECT
        "ORGANIZATION"::VARCHAR AS organization_id,
        lower(trim("NAME")) AS provider_name,
        CASE
            WHEN count(DISTINCT "Id") = 1 THEN min("Id")
            ELSE NULL
        END::VARCHAR AS provider_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'providers') }}
    GROUP BY "ORGANIZATION", lower(trim("NAME"))
)

SELECT
    e.encounter_id::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
    e.start_datetime::TIMESTAMP AS encounter_start_datetime,
    CAST(e.start_datetime AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date,
    COALESCE(e.end_datetime, e.start_datetime)::TIMESTAMP AS encounter_stop_datetime,
    -- Match the existing staging model's start-date-first convention.
    COALESCE(
        CAST(e.start_datetime AS DATE),
        CAST(e.end_datetime AS DATE)
    ) AS encounter_stop_date,
    e.patient_id::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
    e.organization_id::VARCHAR AS organization_id,
    COALESCE(e.direct_provider_id, p.provider_id)::VARCHAR AS provider_id,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id,
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN upper(e.class_code) = 'AMB'
                AND e.encounter_code IN ('162673000', '410620009', '185349003')
                THEN 'wellness'
            WHEN upper(e.class_code) = 'AMB'
                AND e.encounter_code = '702927004'
                THEN 'urgentcare'
            WHEN upper(e.class_code) = 'AMB'
                AND e.encounter_code = '308335008'
                THEN 'outpatient'
            WHEN upper(e.class_code) = 'AMB' THEN 'ambulatory'
            WHEN upper(e.class_code) = 'EMER' THEN 'emergency'
            WHEN upper(e.class_code) IN ('IMP', 'ACUTE', 'NONAC') THEN 'inpatient'
            WHEN upper(e.class_code) = 'OBSENC' THEN 'observation'
            WHEN upper(e.class_code) = 'VR' THEN 'virtual'
            WHEN upper(e.class_code) = 'HH' THEN 'home'
            ELSE lower(e.class_code)
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS encounter_class,
    e.encounter_code::VARCHAR AS encounter_code,
    e.encounter_description::VARCHAR AS encounter_description,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS base_encounter_cost,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS total_encounter_cost,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS encounter_payer_coverage,
    e.encounter_reason_code::VARCHAR AS encounter_reason_code,
    e.encounter_reason_description::VARCHAR AS encounter_reason_description
FROM normalized AS e
LEFT JOIN provider_lookup AS p
    ON e.organization_id = p.organization_id
    AND e.provider_name = p.provider_name
```

```sql
WITH extracted AS (
    SELECT
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetDateTime') AS onset_datetime,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.abatementDateTime') AS abatement_datetime,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference') AS encounter_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text') AS code_text,
        (
            SELECT coding.value
            FROM json_each(resource, '$.code.coding') AS coding
            WHERE json_extract_string(coding.value, '$.system')
                = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
            ORDER BY CAST(coding.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS snomed_coding
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'condition') }}
)

SELECT
    CAST(
        TRY_CAST(onset_datetime AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
        AS DATE
    ) AS condition_start_date,
    CAST(
        TRY_CAST(abatement_datetime AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
        AS DATE
    ) AS condition_stop_date,
    CAST(
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(patient_reference, '/_history/.*$', ''),
            '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)',
            ''
        ) AS VARCHAR
    ) AS patient_id,
    CAST(
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(encounter_reference, '/_history/.*$', ''),
            '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)',
            ''
        ) AS VARCHAR
    ) AS encounter_id,
    CAST(
        json_extract_string(snomed_coding, '$.code')
        AS VARCHAR
    ) AS condition_code,
    CAST(
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(snomed_coding, '$.display'),
            code_text
        ) AS VARCHAR
    ) AS condition_description
FROM extracted
```

```sql
WITH conditions AS (
    SELECT
        coalesce(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id) AS condition_id,
        (
            SELECT coding.value
            FROM json_each(resource, '$.code.coding') AS coding
            WHERE json_extract_string(coding.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
            ORDER BY cast(coding.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS snomed_coding,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text') AS description
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'condition') }}
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (
        PARTITION BY coalesce(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id)
        ORDER BY cast(resource AS VARCHAR)
    ) = 1
),

procedures AS (
    SELECT
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            try_cast(
                coalesce(
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.start'),
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedDateTime')
                ) AS TIMESTAMPTZ
            )
        ) AS start_datetime,
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            try_cast(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.end')
                AS TIMESTAMPTZ
            )
        ) AS stop_datetime,
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
                '^urn:uuid:', ''
            ),
            '^.*/Patient/|^Patient/|/_history/.*$', '', 'g'
        ) AS patient_id,
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference'),
                '^urn:uuid:', ''
            ),
            '^.*/Encounter/|^Encounter/|/_history/.*$', '', 'g'
        ) AS encounter_id,
        (
            SELECT coding.value
            FROM json_each(resource, '$.code.coding') AS coding
            WHERE json_extract_string(coding.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
            ORDER BY cast(coding.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS snomed_coding,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text') AS description,
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].reference'),
                '^urn:uuid:', ''
            ),
            '^.*/Condition/|^Condition/|/_history/.*$', '', 'g'
        ) AS reason_condition_id,
        json_extract_string(
            resource, '$.reasonReference[0].display'
        ) AS reason_reference_description,
        (
            SELECT coding.value
            FROM json_each(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding') AS coding
            WHERE json_extract_string(coding.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
            ORDER BY cast(coding.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS reason_snomed_coding,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].text') AS reason_text
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'procedure') }}
)

SELECT
    p.start_datetime::TIMESTAMP AS procedure_start_datetime,
    p.start_datetime::DATE AS procedure_start_date,
    p.stop_datetime::TIMESTAMP AS procedure_stop_datetime,
    p.stop_datetime::DATE AS procedure_stop_date,
    p.patient_id::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
    p.encounter_id::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
    json_extract_string(p.snomed_coding, '$.code')::VARCHAR AS procedure_code,
    coalesce(
        json_extract_string(p.snomed_coding, '$.display'),
        p.description
    )::VARCHAR AS procedure_description,
    cast(NULL AS FLOAT) AS procedure_base_cost,
    coalesce(
        json_extract_string(p.reason_snomed_coding, '$.code'),
        json_extract_string(c.snomed_coding, '$.code')
    )::VARCHAR AS procedure_reason_code,
    coalesce(
        json_extract_string(p.reason_snomed_coding, '$.display'),
        p.reason_text,
        json_extract_string(c.snomed_coding, '$.display'),
        c.description,
        p.reason_reference_description
    )::VARCHAR AS procedure_reason_description
FROM procedures AS p
LEFT JOIN conditions AS c
    ON p.reason_condition_id = c.condition_id
```

```sql
with conditions as (
    select
        coalesce(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id) as condition_id,
        (
            select coding.value
            from json_each(resource, '$.code.coding') as coding
            where json_extract_string(coding.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
            order by cast(coding.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as snomed_coding,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text') as condition_text
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'condition') }}
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by coalesce(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id)
        order by cast(resource as varchar)
    ) = 1
),

procedures as (
    select
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            try_cast(
                coalesce(
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.start'),
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedDateTime')
                ) as timestamptz
            )
        ) as procedure_start_datetime,
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            try_cast(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.end')
                as timestamptz
            )
        ) as procedure_stop_datetime,
        nullif(
            regexp_extract(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
                '^(?:urn:uuid:|(?:.*/)?Patient/)([^/?#]+)',
                1
            ),
            ''
        ) as patient_id,
        nullif(
            regexp_extract(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference'),
                '^(?:urn:uuid:|(?:.*/)?Encounter/)([^/?#]+)',
                1
            ),
            ''
        ) as encounter_id,
        (
            select coding.value
            from json_each(resource, '$.code.coding') as coding
            where json_extract_string(coding.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
            order by cast(coding.key as integer)
            limit 1
        ) as snomed_coding,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text') as procedure_text,
        nullif(
            regexp_extract(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].reference'),
                '^(?:urn:uuid:|(?:.*/)?Condition/)([^/?#]+)',
                1
            ),
            ''
        ) as reason_condition_id,
        json_extract_string(
            resource, '$.reasonReference[0].display'
        ) as reason_reference_description
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'procedure') }}
)

select
    p.procedure_start_datetime::timestamp as procedure_start_datetime,
    p.procedure_start_datetime::date as procedure_start_date,
    p.procedure_stop_datetime::timestamp as procedure_stop_datetime,
    p.procedure_stop_datetime::date as procedure_stop_date,
    p.patient_id::varchar as patient_id,
    p.encounter_id::varchar as encounter_id,
    json_extract_string(p.snomed_coding, '$.code')::varchar as procedure_code,
    coalesce(
        json_extract_string(p.snomed_coding, '$.display'),
        p.procedure_text
    )::varchar as procedure_description,
    cast(null as float) as procedure_base_cost,
    json_extract_string(c.snomed_coding, '$.code')::varchar as procedure_reason_code,
    coalesce(
        json_extract_string(c.snomed_coding, '$.display'),
        c.condition_text,
        p.reason_reference_description
    )::varchar as procedure_reason_description
from procedures as p
left join conditions as c
    on p.reason_condition_id = c.condition_id
```

```sql
WITH procedures AS (

            try_cast(
                coalesce(
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.start'),

            )
        ) AS procedure_start_datetime,
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            try_cast(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.end')
                AS TIMESTAMPTZ
            )
        ) AS procedure_stop_datetime,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference') AS encounter_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS procedure_code,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
        ) AS procedure_description,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].reference') AS reason_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].display') AS reason_display,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].code') AS direct_reason_code,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].text')
        ) AS direct_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'procedure') }}
),

normalized AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        nullif(
            regexp_extract(
                regexp_replace(patient_reference, '^urn:uuid:|/_history/.*$', '', 'g'),
                '[^/]+$'
            ),
            ''
        ) AS patient_id,
        nullif(
            regexp_extract(
                regexp_replace(encounter_reference, '^urn:uuid:|/_history/.*$', '', 'g'),
                '[^/]+$'
            ),
            ''
        ) AS encounter_id,
        nullif(
            regexp_extract(
                regexp_replace(reason_reference, '^urn:uuid:|/_history/.*$', '', 'g'),
                '[^/]+$'
            ),
            ''
        ) AS reason_condition_id
    FROM procedures
),

conditions AS (
    SELECT
        coalesce(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id) AS condition_id,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS reason_code,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
        ) AS reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'condition') }}
)

SELECT
    p.procedure_start_datetime::TIMESTAMP AS procedure_start_datetime,
    p.procedure_start_datetime::DATE AS procedure_start_date,
    p.procedure_stop_datetime::TIMESTAMP AS procedure_stop_datetime,
    p.procedure_stop_datetime::DATE AS procedure_stop_date,
    p.patient_id::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
    p.encounter_id::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
    p.procedure_code::VARCHAR AS procedure_code,
    p.procedure_description::VARCHAR AS procedure_description,
    cast(NULL AS FLOAT) AS procedure_base_cost,
    coalesce(p.direct_reason_code, c.reason_code)::VARCHAR AS procedure_reason_code,
    coalesce(
        p.direct_reason_description,
        c.reason_description,
        p.reason_display
    )::VARCHAR AS procedure_reason_description
FROM normalized AS p
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        reason_code,
        reason_description
    FROM conditions AS c
    WHERE c.condition_id = p.reason_condition_id
    ORDER BY reason_code NULLS LAST, reason_description NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
) AS c ON TRUE
```
