```sql
WITH extracted AS (
    SELECT
        try_cast(
            coalesce(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.start'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedDateTime')
            ) AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS procedure_start_datetime,
        try_cast(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.end')
            AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS procedure_stop_datetime,
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
                '/_history/.*$', ''
            ),
            '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)', ''
        ) AS patient_id,
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference'),
                '/_history/.*$', ''
            ),
            '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)', ''
        ) AS encounter_id,
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'procedure') }}
),
mapped AS (
    SELECT
        p.procedure_start_datetime,
        p.procedure_stop_datetime,
        p.patient_id,
        p.encounter_id,
        json_extract_string(pc.value, '$.code') AS procedure_code,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(pc.value, '$.display'),
            json_extract_string(p.resource, '$.code.text')
        ) AS procedure_description,
        json_extract_string(rc.value, '$.code') AS procedure_reason_code,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(rc.value, '$.display'),
            json_extract_string(c.resource, '$.code.text'),
            json_extract_string(p.resource, '$.reasonReference[0].display')
        ) AS procedure_reason_description
    FROM extracted AS p
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT coding.value
        FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.code.coding') AS coding
        ORDER BY
            CASE
                WHEN json_extract_string(coding.value, '$.system')
                    = 'http://snomed.info/sct' THEN 0
                ELSE 1
            END,
            cast(coding.key AS INTEGER)
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS pc ON true
    -- Use the first reason reference to keep one row per procedure.
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT cond.resource
        FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'condition') }} AS cond
        WHERE coalesce(json_extract_string(cond.resource, '$.id'), cond.id)
            = regexp_replace(
                regexp_replace(
                    json_extract_string(
                        p.resource, '$.reasonReference[0].reference'
                    ),
                    '/_history/.*$', ''
                ),
                '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)', ''
            )
        ORDER BY cond.id, cast(cond.resource AS VARCHAR)
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS c ON true
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT coding.value
        FROM json_each(c.resource, '$.code.coding') AS coding
        WHERE json_extract_string(coding.value, '$.system')
            = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
        ORDER BY cast(coding.key AS INTEGER)
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS rc ON true
)
SELECT
    cast(procedure_start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_start_datetime,
    cast(procedure_start_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_start_date,
    cast(procedure_stop_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_stop_datetime,
    cast(procedure_stop_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_stop_date,
    cast(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
    cast(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
    cast(procedure_code AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_code,
    cast(procedure_description AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_description,
    cast(NULL AS FLOAT) AS procedure_base_cost,
    cast(procedure_reason_code AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_code,
    cast(procedure_reason_description AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_description
FROM mapped
```

- code and description are code.coding[0]; commas in text become spaces. The reason is the code of the Condition that reasonReference[0].reference points to. The cost is not in the resource: NULL.
text:
```sql
WITH procedures AS (
    SELECT
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            try_cast(
                coalesce(
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.start'),
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedDateTime')
                ) AS TIMESTAMPTZ
            )
        ) AS procedure_start_datetime,
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            try_cast(
                coalesce(
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.end'),
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedDateTime')
                ) AS TIMESTAMPTZ
            )
        ) AS procedure_stop_datetime,
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
            '^urn:uuid:|^(.*/)?Patient/',
            ''
        ) AS patient_id,
        regexp_replace(
            coalesce(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference')
            ),
            '^urn:uuid:|^(.*/)?Encounter/',
            ''
        ) AS encounter_id,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS procedure_code,
        replace(
            coalesce(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
            ),
            ',',
            ' '
        ) AS procedure_description,
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].reference'),
            '^urn:uuid:|^(.*/)?Condition/',
            ''
        ) AS reason_condition_id,
        json_extract_string(
            resource, '$.reasonReference[0].display'
        ) AS reason_reference_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'procedure') }}
),
conditions AS (
    SELECT
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'),
            id
        ) AS condition_id,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS reason_code,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
        ) AS reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'condition') }}
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (
        PARTITION BY coalesce(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id)
        ORDER BY id, cast(resource AS VARCHAR)
    ) = 1
)
SELECT
    p.procedure_start_datetime,
    cast(p.procedure_start_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_start_date,
    p.procedure_stop_datetime,
    cast(p.procedure_stop_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_stop_date,
    p.patient_id,
    p.encounter_id,
    p.procedure_code,
    p.procedure_description,
    cast(NULL AS FLOAT) AS procedure_base_cost,
    c.reason_code AS procedure_reason_code,
    replace(
        coalesce(c.reason_description, p.reason_reference_description),
        ',',
        ' '
    ) AS procedure_reason_description
FROM procedures AS p
LEFT JOIN conditions AS c
    ON p.reason_condition_id = c.condition_id
```

```sql
WITH extracted AS (
    SELECT
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            TRY_CAST(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.effectiveDateTime')
                AS TIMESTAMPTZ
            )
        ) AS observation_datetime,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference') AS encounter_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code')
            AS observation_category,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')
            AS observation_code,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
        ) AS observation_description,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.value') AS quantity_value,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.unit'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.code')
        ) AS quantity_units,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].code')
        ) AS coded_value,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueString') AS string_value
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'observation') }}
)

SELECT
    CAST(observation_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS observation_datetime,
    CAST(observation_datetime AS DATE) AS observation_date,
    CAST(
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                regexp_replace(patient_reference, '[?#].*$', ''),
                '/_history/[^/]+/?$',
                ''
            ),
            '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)',
            ''
        ) AS VARCHAR
    ) AS patient_id,
    CAST(
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                regexp_replace(encounter_reference, '[?#].*$', ''),
                '/_history/[^/]+/?$',
                ''
            ),
            '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)',
            ''
        ) AS VARCHAR
    ) AS encounter_id,
    CAST(observation_category AS VARCHAR) AS observation_category,
    CAST(observation_code AS VARCHAR) AS observation_code,
    CAST(observation_description AS VARCHAR) AS observation_description,
    CAST(
        COALESCE(quantity_value, coded_value, string_value)
        AS VARCHAR
    ) AS observation_value,
    CAST(
        CASE WHEN quantity_value IS NOT NULL THEN quantity_units END
        AS VARCHAR
    ) AS observation_units,
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN quantity_value IS NOT NULL THEN 'numeric'
            WHEN coded_value IS NOT NULL OR string_value IS NOT NULL THEN 'text'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS observation_value_type
FROM extracted
```

## Mapping hints
- start and stop are performedPeriod.start and .end (or performedDateTime for both); they carry a UTC offset and the contract wants UTC.
- patient is subject.reference, the encounter is encounter.reference (R4) or context.reference (STU3), without the urn:uuid: prefix.
- code and description are code.coding[0]; commas in text become spaces. The reason is the code of the Condition that reasonReference[0].reference points to. The cost is not in the resource: NULL.
text:

```sql
WITH conditions AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id) AS condition_id,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS reason_code,
        REPLACE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
            ',',
            ' '
        ) AS reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'condition') }}
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY COALESCE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id)
        ORDER BY CAST(resource AS VARCHAR)
    ) = 1
),

procedures AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.start'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedDateTime')
            ) AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS procedure_start_datetime,
        TRY_CAST(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.end'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedDateTime')
            ) AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS procedure_stop_datetime,
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
            '^urn:uuid:|^.*/',
            ''
        ) AS patient_id,
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference')
            ),
            '^urn:uuid:|^.*/',
            ''
        ) AS encounter_id,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS procedure_code,
        REPLACE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
            ',',
            ' '
        ) AS procedure_description,
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].reference'),
            '^urn:uuid:|^.*/',
            ''
        ) AS reason_condition_id,
        REPLACE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].display'),
            ',',
            ' '
        ) AS reason_reference_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'procedure') }}
)

SELECT
    p.procedure_start_datetime,
    CAST(p.procedure_start_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_start_date,
    p.procedure_stop_datetime,
    CAST(p.procedure_stop_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_stop_date,
    p.patient_id,
    p.encounter_id,
    p.procedure_code,
    p.procedure_description,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS procedure_base_cost,
    c.reason_code AS procedure_reason_code,
    COALESCE(
        c.reason_description,
        p.reason_reference_description
    ) AS procedure_reason_description
FROM procedures AS p
LEFT JOIN conditions AS c
    ON p.reason_condition_id = c.condition_id
```

```sql
WITH extracted AS (
    SELECT
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            try_cast(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.effectiveDateTime')
                AS TIMESTAMPTZ
            )
        ) AS observation_datetime,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference') AS encounter_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code')
            AS observation_category,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')
            AS observation_code,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
        ) AS observation_description,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.value') AS quantity_value,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.unit'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.code')
        ) AS quantity_units,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueString'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].code')
        ) AS text_value
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'observation') }}
),
normalized AS (
    SELECT
        observation_datetime,
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                patient_reference,
                '/_history/[^/]+/?$',
                ''
            ),
            '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)',
            ''
        ) AS patient_id,
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                encounter_reference,
                '/_history/[^/]+/?$',
                ''
            ),
            '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)',
            ''
        ) AS encounter_id,
        observation_category,
        observation_code,
        observation_description,
        coalesce(quantity_value, text_value) AS observation_value,
        CASE
            WHEN quantity_value IS NOT NULL THEN quantity_units
            ELSE NULL
        END AS observation_units,
        CASE
            WHEN quantity_value IS NOT NULL THEN 'numeric'
            WHEN text_value IS NOT NULL THEN 'text'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS observation_value_type
    FROM extracted
)
SELECT
    cast(observation_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS observation_datetime,
    cast(observation_datetime AS DATE) AS observation_date,
    cast(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
    cast(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
    cast(observation_category AS VARCHAR) AS observation_category,
    cast(observation_code AS VARCHAR) AS observation_code,
    cast(observation_description AS VARCHAR) AS observation_description,
    cast(observation_value AS VARCHAR) AS observation_value,
    cast(observation_units AS VARCHAR) AS observation_units,
    cast(observation_value_type AS VARCHAR) AS observation_value_type
FROM normalized
```

```sql
with extracted as (
    select
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            try_cast(
                coalesce(
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.effectiveDateTime'),
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.effectivePeriod.start'),
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.issued')
                ) as timestamptz
            )
        ) as observation_datetime,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') as patient_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference') as encounter_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code')
            as observation_category,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')
            as observation_code,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
        ) as observation_description,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.value'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueInteger'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueDecimal')
        ) as numeric_value,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].code'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueString'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueBoolean'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueDateTime'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueTime')
        ) as text_value,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.unit'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.code')
        ) as observation_units
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'observation') }}
),
normalized as (
    select
        observation_datetime,
        case
            when starts_with(patient_reference, 'urn:uuid:')
                then substr(patient_reference, 10)
            else regexp_replace(
                patient_reference,
                '^.*Patient/([^/?#]+).*$',
                '\1'
            )
        end as patient_id,
        case
            when starts_with(encounter_reference, 'urn:uuid:')
                then substr(encounter_reference, 10)
            else regexp_replace(
                encounter_reference,
                '^.*Encounter/([^/?#]+).*$',
                '\1'
            )
        end as encounter_id,
        observation_category,
        observation_code,
        observation_description,
        -- Keep panel resources as single rows; do not expand their components.
        coalesce(numeric_value, text_value) as observation_value,
        observation_units,
        case
            when numeric_value is not null then 'numeric'
            when text_value is not null then 'text'
            else null
        end as observation_value_type
    from extracted
)

from normalized
```

## Mapping hints
- One row per value: an Observation with component[] gives one row per component (code and value from the component, date, patient, encounter and category from the parent); an Observation without components gives one row.
- date is effectiveDateTime (UTC); patient is subject.reference, the encounter is encounter.reference (R4) or context.reference (STU3), without the urn:uuid: prefix; category is category[0].coding[0].code.
- A valueQuantity gives type numeric, units = valueQuantity.unit and the value as text with exactly one decimal digit (163.34 is written 163.3, 71 is written 71.0). Other values give type text: the display of valueCodeableConcept.coding[0], or valueString.
- In DuckDB write (x->'$.path') IS NULL with the parentheses. Commas in text become spaces.

```sql
with source_observations as (
    select resource
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'observation') }}
),

expanded as (
    select
        o.resource as parent_resource,
        coalesce(c.value, o.resource) as value_resource
    from source_observations o
    left join lateral json_each(o.resource, '$.component') c on true
),

extracted as (
    select
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            try_cast(
                json_extract_string(parent_resource, '$.effectiveDateTime')
                as timestamptz
            )
        ) as observation_datetime,
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(parent_resource, '$.subject.reference'),
            '^(urn:uuid:|(.*/)?Patient/)',
            ''
        ) as patient_id,
        regexp_replace(
            coalesce(
                json_extract_string(parent_resource, '$.encounter.reference'),
                json_extract_string(parent_resource, '$.context.reference')
            ),
            '^(urn:uuid:|(.*/)?Encounter/)',
            ''
        ) as encounter_id,
        json_extract_string(
            parent_resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code'
        ) as observation_category,
        json_extract_string(
            value_resource, '$.code.coding[0].code'
        ) as observation_code,
        replace(
            coalesce(
                json_extract_string(value_resource, '$.code.text'),
                json_extract_string(value_resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
            ),
            ',',
            ' '
        ) as observation_description,
        case
            when (value_resource->'$.valueQuantity') is not null
                then printf(
                    '%.1f',
                    try_cast(
                        json_extract_string(value_resource, '$.valueQuantity.value')
                        as double
                    )
                )
            else replace(
                coalesce(
                    json_extract_string(
                        value_resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display'
                    ),
                    json_extract_string(value_resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text'),
                    json_extract_string(value_resource, '$.valueString')
                ),
                ',',
                ' '
            )
        end as observation_value,
        json_extract_string(
            value_resource, '$.valueQuantity.unit'
        ) as observation_units,
        case
            when (value_resource->'$.valueQuantity') is not null then 'numeric'
            else 'text'
        end as observation_value_type
    from expanded
)

select
    cast(observation_datetime as timestamp) as observation_datetime,
    cast(observation_datetime as date) as observation_date,
    cast(patient_id as varchar) as patient_id,
    cast(encounter_id as varchar) as encounter_id,
    cast(observation_category as varchar) as observation_category,
    cast(observation_code as varchar) as observation_code,
    cast(observation_description as varchar) as observation_description,
    cast(observation_value as varchar) as observation_value,
    cast(observation_units as varchar) as observation_units,
    cast(observation_value_type as varchar) as observation_value_type
from extracted
```

```sql
WITH cte_observations_lower AS (
```

```sql
WITH extracted AS (
    SELECT
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            TRY_CAST(
                COALESCE(
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.effectiveDateTime'),
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.effectivePeriod.start'),
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.issued')
                ) AS TIMESTAMPTZ
            )
        ) AS observation_datetime,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference') AS encounter_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code')
            AS observation_category,
        (
            SELECT coding.value
            FROM json_each(json_extract(resource, '$.code.coding')) AS coding
            ORDER BY
                CASE
                    WHEN json_extract_string(coding.value, '$.system')
                        IN ('http://loinc.org', 'https://loinc.org')
                    THEN 0
                    ELSE 1
                END,
                TRY_CAST(coding.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS observation_coding,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text') AS code_text,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.value') AS quantity_value,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.unit'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueQuantity.code')
        ) AS quantity_units,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].code')
        ) AS concept_value,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueString') AS string_value,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueBoolean') AS boolean_value,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.valueInteger') AS integer_value
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'observation') }}
)

SELECT
    observation_datetime::TIMESTAMP AS observation_datetime,
    observation_datetime::DATE AS observation_date,
    NULLIF(
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(patient_reference, '/_history/[^/]+/?$', ''),
            '^.*[:/]',
            ''
        ),
        ''
    )::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
    NULLIF(
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(encounter_reference, '/_history/[^/]+/?$', ''),
            '^.*[:/]',
            ''
        ),
        ''
    )::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
    observation_category::VARCHAR AS observation_category,
    json_extract_string(observation_coding, '$.code')::VARCHAR
        AS observation_code,
    COALESCE(
        code_text,
        json_extract_string(observation_coding, '$.display')
    )::VARCHAR AS observation_description,
    COALESCE(
        quantity_value,
        integer_value,
        concept_value,
        string_value,
        boolean_value
    )::VARCHAR AS observation_value,
    CASE
        WHEN quantity_value IS NOT NULL THEN quantity_units
        ELSE NULL
    END::VARCHAR AS observation_units,
    CASE
        WHEN quantity_value IS NOT NULL OR integer_value IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'numeric'
        WHEN concept_value IS NOT NULL
            OR string_value IS NOT NULL
            OR boolean_value IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'text'
        ELSE NULL
    END::VARCHAR AS observation_value_type
FROM extracted
```

  valueQuantity.unit  (87% of resources)  e.g. "{score}"
  valueQuantity.value  (87% of resources)  e.g. 1


## Mapping hints
- One row per value: an Observation with component[] gives one row per component (code and value from the component, date, patient, encounter and category from the parent); an Observation without components gives one row.
- date is effectiveDateTime (UTC); patient is subject.reference, the encounter is encounter.reference (R4) or context.reference (STU3), without the urn:uuid: prefix; category is category[0].coding[0].code.
- A valueQuantity gives type numeric, units = valueQuantity.unit and the value as text with exactly one decimal digit (163.34 is written 163.3, 71 is written 71.0). Other values give type text: the display of valueCodeableConcept.coding[0], or valueString.
- In DuckDB write (x->'$.path') IS NULL with the parentheses. Commas in text become spaces.
text:
```sql
WITH expanded AS (
    SELECT
        o.resource AS parent_resource,
        COALESCE(c.value, o.resource) AS value_resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'observation') }} AS o
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL json_each(o.resource, '$.component') AS c
        ON TRUE
),
mapped AS (
    SELECT
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            TRY_CAST(
                json_extract_string(parent_resource, '$.effectiveDateTime')
                AS TIMESTAMPTZ
            )
        ) AS observation_datetime,
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(parent_resource, '$.subject.reference'),
            '^urn:uuid:|^(.*/)?Patient/',
            ''
        ) AS patient_id,
        regexp_replace(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(parent_resource, '$.context.reference'),
                json_extract_string(parent_resource, '$.encounter.reference')
            ),
            '^urn:uuid:|^(.*/)?Encounter/',
            ''
        ) AS encounter_id,
        json_extract_string(
            parent_resource,
            '$.category[0].coding[0].code'
        ) AS observation_category,
        json_extract_string(
            value_resource,
            '$.code.coding[0].code'
        ) AS observation_code,
        replace(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(value_resource, '$.code.text'),
                json_extract_string(value_resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
            ),
            ',',
            ' '
        ) AS observation_description,
        CASE
            WHEN (value_resource->'$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL
                THEN printf(
                    '%.1f',
                    TRY_CAST(
                        json_extract_string(value_resource, '$.valueQuantity.value')
                        AS DOUBLE
                    )
                )
            ELSE replace(
                COALESCE(
                    json_extract_string(
                        value_resource,
                        '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display'
                    ),
                    json_extract_string(value_resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text'),
                    json_extract_string(value_resource, '$.valueString')
                ),
                ',',
                ' '
            )
        END AS observation_value,
        replace(
            json_extract_string(value_resource, '$.valueQuantity.unit'),
            ',',
            ' '
        ) AS observation_units,
        CASE
            WHEN (value_resource->'$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL THEN 'numeric'
            ELSE 'text'
        END AS observation_value_type
    FROM expanded
)
SELECT
    observation_datetime::TIMESTAMP AS observation_datetime,
    observation_datetime::DATE AS observation_date,
    patient_id::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
    encounter_id::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
    observation_category::VARCHAR AS observation_category,
    observation_code::VARCHAR AS observation_code,
    observation_description::VARCHAR AS observation_description,
    observation_value::VARCHAR AS observation_value,
    observation_units::VARCHAR AS observation_units,
    observation_value_type::VARCHAR AS observation_value_type
FROM mapped
```

```sql
WITH allergy_values AS (
    SELECT
        resource,
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.patient.reference'),
                '^(urn:uuid:|.*/Patient/|Patient/)',
                ''
            ),
            '/_history/.*$',
            ''
        )::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
        coalesce(
            try_cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetDateTime') AS TIMESTAMPTZ),
            try_cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetPeriod.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ),
            try_cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.assertedDate') AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
        ) AS allergy_start_at,
        try_cast(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.assertedDate') AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS asserted_at,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS allergy_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].system') AS code_system,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
        ) AS allergy_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'allergyintolerance') }}
),
encounters AS (
    SELECT
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'),
            id
        )::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
                '^(urn:uuid:|.*/Patient/|Patient/)',
                ''
            ),
            '/_history/.*$',
            ''
        )::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
        try_cast(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS encounter_start_at,
        try_cast(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end') AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS encounter_end_at
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }}
)
SELECT
    cast(a.allergy_start_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS DATE) AS allergy_start_date,
    cast(NULL AS DATE) AS allergy_stop_date,
    a.patient_id::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
    matched.encounter_id::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
    a.allergy_code::VARCHAR AS allergy_code,
    cast(
        CASE a.code_system
            WHEN 'http://snomed.info/sct' THEN 'SNOMED-CT'
            WHEN 'https://snomed.info/sct' THEN 'SNOMED-CT'
            WHEN 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm' THEN 'RxNorm'
            WHEN 'http://loinc.org' THEN 'LOINC'
            ELSE a.code_system
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS allergy_code_system,
    a.allergy_description::VARCHAR AS allergy_description,
    lower(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.type'))::VARCHAR AS allergy_type,
    cast(
        CASE lower(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.category[0]'))
            WHEN 'environmental' THEN 'environment'
            ELSE lower(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.category[0]'))
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS allergy_category,
    json_extract_string(
        a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].code'
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_1_code,
    coalesce(
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'
        ),
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].text')
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_1_description,
    upper(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[0].severity')
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_1_severity,
    json_extract_string(
        a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].code'
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_2_code,
    coalesce(
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'
        ),
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].text')
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_2_description,
    upper(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[1].severity')
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_2_severity
FROM allergy_values AS a
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    -- Recover the documenting encounter without multiplying allergy rows.
    SELECT e.encounter_id
    FROM encounters AS e
    WHERE e.patient_id = a.patient_id
      AND a.asserted_at >= e.encounter_start_at
      AND a.asserted_at <= coalesce(e.encounter_end_at, e.encounter_start_at)
    ORDER BY
        e.encounter_start_at DESC,
        e.encounter_end_at ASC NULLS LAST,
        e.encounter_id
    LIMIT 1
) AS matched ON true
```

```sql
WITH allergy_resources AS (
    SELECT
        resource,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.patient.reference') AS patient_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference') AS encounter_reference,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetDateTime'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetPeriod.start'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.assertedDate')
        ) AS start_value,
        TRY_CAST(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.assertedDate') AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS asserted_at
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'allergyintolerance') }}
),

allergies AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                regexp_extract(
                    patient_reference,
                    '(?:urn:uuid:|Patient/)([^/?#]+)',
                    1
                ),
                ''
            ),
            NULLIF(patient_reference, '')
        )::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                regexp_extract(
                    encounter_reference,
                    '(?:urn:uuid:|Encounter/)([^/?#]+)',
                    1
                ),
                ''
            ),
            NULLIF(encounter_reference, '')
        )::VARCHAR AS explicit_encounter_id
    FROM allergy_resources
),

encounter_resources AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'),
            id
        )::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_reference,
        TRY_CAST(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS encounter_start,
        TRY_CAST(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end') AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS encounter_end
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }}
),

encounters AS (
    SELECT
        encounter_id,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                regexp_extract(
                    patient_reference,
                    '(?:urn:uuid:|Patient/)([^/?#]+)',
                    1
                ),
                ''
            ),
            NULLIF(patient_reference, '')
        )::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
        encounter_start,
        encounter_end
    FROM encounter_resources
)

SELECT
    CAST(
        TRY_CAST(a.start_value AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
        AS DATE
    ) AS allergy_start_date,
    CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS allergy_stop_date,
    a.patient_id::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
    COALESCE(a.explicit_encounter_id, matched.encounter_id)::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
    json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')::VARCHAR AS allergy_code,
    CAST(
        CASE json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].system')
            WHEN 'http://snomed.info/sct' THEN 'SNOMED-CT'
            WHEN 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm' THEN 'RxNorm'
            ELSE json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].system')
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS allergy_code_system,
    COALESCE(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.text')
    )::VARCHAR AS allergy_description,
    LOWER(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.type'))::VARCHAR AS allergy_type,
    LOWER(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.category[0]'))::VARCHAR AS allergy_category,
    json_extract_string(
        a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].code'
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_1_code,
    COALESCE(
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'
        ),
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].text')
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_1_description,
    UPPER(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[0].severity')
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_1_severity,
    json_extract_string(
        a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].code'
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_2_code,
    COALESCE(
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'
        ),
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].text')
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_2_description,
    UPPER(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[1].severity')
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_2_severity
FROM allergies AS a
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    -- STU3 allergies may omit encounter references. Match the assertion
    -- instant to an encounter for the same patient without multiplying rows.
    SELECT e.encounter_id
    FROM encounters AS e
    WHERE a.explicit_encounter_id IS NULL
      AND e.patient_id = a.patient_id
      AND a.asserted_at >= e.encounter_start
      AND a.asserted_at <= e.encounter_end
    ORDER BY
        CASE WHEN a.asserted_at = e.encounter_start THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
        e.encounter_start DESC,
        e.encounter_end,
        e.encounter_id
    LIMIT 1
) AS matched ON TRUE
```

```sql
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference') AS encounter_reference
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'allergyintolerance') }}
),
normalized_allergies AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                regexp_extract(
                    patient_reference,
                    '(?:urn:uuid:|(?:^|/)Patient/)([^/?#]+)',
                    1
                ),
                ''
            ),
            NULLIF(patient_reference, '')
        )::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                regexp_extract(
                    encounter_reference,
                    '(?:urn:uuid:|(?:^|/)Encounter/)([^/?#]+)',
                    1
                ),
                ''
            ),
            NULLIF(encounter_reference, '')
        )::VARCHAR AS explicit_encounter_id
    FROM allergies
),
encounters AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'),
            id
        )::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                regexp_extract(
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
                    '(?:urn:uuid:|(?:^|/)Patient/)([^/?#]+)',
                    1
                ),
                ''
            ),
            NULLIF(json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'), '')
        )::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
        TRY_CAST(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start')
            AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS encounter_start,
        TRY_CAST(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end')
            AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS encounter_end
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }}
)
SELECT
    CAST(
        timezone('UTC', TRY_CAST(a.start_value AS TIMESTAMPTZ))
        AS DATE
    ) AS allergy_start_date,
    -- STU3 clinicalStatus does not supply an allergy resolution date.
    CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS allergy_stop_date,
    a.patient_id::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
    COALESCE(a.explicit_encounter_id, matched.encounter_id)::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
    json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')::VARCHAR AS allergy_code,
    CAST(
        CASE json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].system')
            WHEN 'http://snomed.info/sct' THEN 'SNOMED-CT'
            WHEN 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm' THEN 'RxNorm'
            WHEN 'http://loinc.org' THEN 'LOINC'
            ELSE json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].system')
        END
        AS VARCHAR
    ) AS allergy_code_system,
    COALESCE(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.text')
    )::VARCHAR AS allergy_description,
    lower(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.type'))::VARCHAR AS allergy_type,
    lower(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.category[0]'))::VARCHAR AS allergy_category,
    json_extract_string(
        a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].code'
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_1_code,
    COALESCE(
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'
        ),
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].text')
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_1_description,
    upper(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[0].severity'))::VARCHAR
        AS reaction_1_severity,
    json_extract_string(
        a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].code'
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_2_code,
    COALESCE(
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'
        ),
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].text')
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_2_description,
    upper(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[1].severity'))::VARCHAR
        AS reaction_2_severity
FROM normalized_allergies AS a
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    -- Recover the asserting encounter only when its period contains assertion.
    -- Limit the match to preserve one row per allergy resource.
    SELECT e.encounter_id
    FROM encounters AS e
    WHERE a.explicit_encounter_id IS NULL
      AND e.patient_id = a.patient_id
      AND a.asserted_at >= e.encounter_start
      AND (
          a.asserted_at <= e.encounter_end
          OR a.asserted_at = e.encounter_start
      )
    ORDER BY
        CASE WHEN a.asserted_at = e.encounter_start THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
        e.encounter_start DESC,
        e.encounter_id
    LIMIT 1
) AS matched ON TRUE
```

```sql
WITH allergy_values AS (
    SELECT
        resource,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.patient.reference') AS patient_reference,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference')
        ) AS encounter_reference,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetDateTime'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetPeriod.start'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.assertedDate')
        ) AS start_value,
        try_cast(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.assertedDate') AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS asserted_at,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].system') AS code_system
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'allergyintolerance') }}
),

allergies AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        cast(
            regexp_replace(
                regexp_replace(
                    regexp_replace(patient_reference, '/_history/[^/]+$', ''),
                    '^urn:uuid:',
                    ''
                ),
                '^.*/',
                ''
            ) AS VARCHAR
        ) AS patient_id,
        cast(
            regexp_replace(
                regexp_replace(
                    regexp_replace(encounter_reference, '/_history/[^/]+$', ''),
                    '^urn:uuid:',
                    ''
                ),
                '^.*/',
                ''
            ) AS VARCHAR
        ) AS explicit_encounter_id
    FROM allergy_values
),

encounters AS (
    SELECT
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'),
            id
        )::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                regexp_replace(
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
                    '/_history/[^/]+$',
                    ''
                ),
                '^urn:uuid:',
                ''
            ),
            '^.*/',
            ''
        ) AS patient_id,
        try_cast(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS start_at,
        try_cast(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end') AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS end_at
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }}
)

SELECT
    cast(
        timezone('UTC', try_cast(a.start_value AS TIMESTAMPTZ))
        AS DATE
    ) AS allergy_start_date,

    -- STU3 clinicalStatus does not supply an allergy resolution date.
    cast(NULL AS DATE) AS allergy_stop_date,

    a.patient_id::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
    coalesce(a.explicit_encounter_id, matched.encounter_id)::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
    json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')::VARCHAR AS allergy_code,

    cast(
        CASE a.code_system
            WHEN 'http://snomed.info/sct' THEN 'SNOMED-CT'
            WHEN 'https://snomed.info/sct' THEN 'SNOMED-CT'
            WHEN 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm' THEN 'RxNorm'
            ELSE a.code_system
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS allergy_code_system,

    coalesce(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.text')
    )::VARCHAR AS allergy_description,

    lower(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.type'))::VARCHAR AS allergy_type,
    lower(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.category[0]'))::VARCHAR AS allergy_category,

    json_extract_string(
        a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].code'
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_1_code,

    coalesce(
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'
        ),
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].text'
        )
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_1_description,

    upper(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[0].severity')
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_1_severity,

    json_extract_string(
        a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].code'
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_2_code,

    coalesce(
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'
        ),
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].text'
        )
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_2_description,

    upper(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[1].severity')
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_2_severity

FROM allergies AS a
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    -- When context is absent, use the encounter containing the assertion.
    -- Limit deterministically so overlapping encounters cannot multiply rows.
    SELECT e.encounter_id
    FROM encounters AS e
    WHERE a.explicit_encounter_id IS NULL
      AND e.patient_id = a.patient_id
      AND a.asserted_at >= e.start_at
      AND a.asserted_at <= coalesce(e.end_at, e.start_at)
    ORDER BY
        CASE WHEN a.asserted_at = e.start_at THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
        e.start_at DESC,
        e.encounter_id
    LIMIT 1
) AS matched ON TRUE
```

## Mapping hints
- start date is the first 10 characters of recordedDate (R4) or assertedDate (STU3); there is no stop date.
- patient is patient.reference without the urn:uuid: prefix. The resource has no encounter reference: use the patient's Encounter whose period.start equals that timestamp.
- code and description are code.coding[0]; system is SNOMED-CT or RxNorm according to the coding system URL; type is type; category is category[0].
- reaction 1 and 2 are reaction[0] and reaction[1]: manifestation[0].coding[0].code and .display, severity in upper case. Commas in text become spaces.
text:
```sql
WITH allergies AS (
    SELECT
        resource,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.assertedDate') AS asserted_date,
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.patient.reference'),
            '^urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) AS patient_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'allergyintolerance') }}
),
encounter_details AS (
    SELECT
        coalesce(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id) AS encounter_id,
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
            '^urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) AS patient_id,
        try_cast(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS encounter_start
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }}
),
encounter_matches AS (
    -- Ensure ambiguous encounter matches cannot multiply allergy rows.
    SELECT
        patient_id,
        encounter_start,
        min(encounter_id) AS encounter_id
    FROM encounter_details
    GROUP BY patient_id, encounter_start
)
SELECT
    cast(
        try_cast(a.asserted_date AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
        AS DATE
    ) AS allergy_start_date,
    cast(NULL AS DATE) AS allergy_stop_date,
    a.patient_id AS patient_id,
    e.encounter_id AS encounter_id,
    json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS allergy_code,
    CASE json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].system')
        WHEN 'http://snomed.info/sct' THEN 'SNOMED-CT'
        WHEN 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm' THEN 'RxNorm'
        ELSE json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].system')
    END AS allergy_code_system,
    replace(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
        ',',
        ' '
    ) AS allergy_description,
    json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.type') AS allergy_type,
    json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.category[0]') AS allergy_category,
    json_extract_string(
        a.resource,
        '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].code'
    ) AS reaction_1_code,
    replace(
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource,
            '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'
        ),
        ',',
        ' '
    ) AS reaction_1_description,
    upper(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[0].severity')
    ) AS reaction_1_severity,
    json_extract_string(
        a.resource,
        '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].code'
    ) AS reaction_2_code,
    replace(
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource,
            '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'
        ),
        ',',
        ' '
    ) AS reaction_2_description,
    upper(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[1].severity')
    ) AS reaction_2_severity
FROM allergies AS a
LEFT JOIN encounter_matches AS e
    ON a.patient_id = e.patient_id
    AND try_cast(a.asserted_date AS TIMESTAMPTZ) = e.encounter_start
```

## Mapping hints
- start date is the first 10 characters of recordedDate (R4) or assertedDate (STU3); there is no stop date.
- patient is patient.reference without the urn:uuid: prefix. The resource has no encounter reference: use the patient's Encounter whose period.start equals that timestamp.
- code and description are code.coding[0]; system is SNOMED-CT or RxNorm according to the coding system URL; type is type; category is category[0].
- reaction 1 and 2 are reaction[0] and reaction[1]: manifestation[0].coding[0].code and .display, severity in upper case. Commas in text become spaces.
text:
```sql
WITH allergies AS (
    SELECT
        resource,
        TRY_CAST(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.assertedDate') AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS asserted_at,
        REPLACE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.patient.reference'),
            'urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) AS patient_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'allergyintolerance') }}
),
encounters AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id) AS encounter_id,
        REPLACE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
            'urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) AS patient_id,
        TRY_CAST(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS encounter_start
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }}
)
SELECT
    CAST(timezone('UTC', a.asserted_at) AS DATE) AS allergy_start_date,
    CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS allergy_stop_date,
    CAST(a.patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
    CAST(e.encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
    json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS allergy_code,
    CASE json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].system')
        WHEN 'http://snomed.info/sct' THEN 'SNOMED-CT'
        WHEN 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm' THEN 'RxNorm'
        ELSE json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].system')
    END AS allergy_code_system,
    REPLACE(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
        ',',
        ' '
    ) AS allergy_description,
    json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.type') AS allergy_type,
    json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.category[0]') AS allergy_category,
    json_extract_string(
        a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].code'
    ) AS reaction_1_code,
    REPLACE(
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'
        ),
        ',',
        ' '
    ) AS reaction_1_description,
    UPPER(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[0].severity')
    ) AS reaction_1_severity,
    json_extract_string(
        a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].code'
    ) AS reaction_2_code,
    REPLACE(
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'
        ),
        ',',
        ' '
    ) AS reaction_2_description,
    UPPER(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[1].severity')
    ) AS reaction_2_severity
FROM allergies AS a
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT enc.encounter_id
    FROM encounters AS enc
    WHERE enc.patient_id = a.patient_id
      AND enc.encounter_start = a.asserted_at
    ORDER BY enc.encounter_id
    LIMIT 1
) AS e ON TRUE
```

```sql
WITH members AS (
    SELECT
        NULLIF(TRIM("Member id"), '') AS patient_id,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Date of birth"), '') AS DATE) AS birth_date,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Date of death"), '') AS DATE) AS death_date,
        NULLIF(
            REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM("Name"), '\s+', ' ', 'g'),
            ''
        ) AS patient_name,
        NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM("Race code")), '') AS race,
        NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM("Ethnicity")), '') AS ethnicity,
        NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM("Gender code")), '') AS gender_code,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Home_State"), '') AS home_state,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Home_County"), '') AS home_county,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Home_Zip code"), '') AS home_zip
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'members') }}
)

SELECT
    m.patient_id::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
    m.birth_date::DATE AS birth_date,
    m.death_date::DATE AS death_date,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS ssn,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS drivers_license_number,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS passport_number,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_prefix,
    NULLIF(SPLIT_PART(m.patient_name, ' ', 1), '')::VARCHAR AS patient_first_name,
    NULLIF(
        REGEXP_EXTRACT(m.patient_name, '\s+(\S+)$', 1),
        ''
    )::VARCHAR AS patient_last_name,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_suffix,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS maiden_name,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS marital_status,
    m.race::VARCHAR AS race,
    m.ethnicity::VARCHAR AS ethnicity,
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN m.gender_code IN ('M', 'MALE') THEN 'M'
            WHEN m.gender_code IN ('F', 'FEMALE') THEN 'F'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS patient_gender,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS birthplace,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_address,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_city,
    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT MIN(s.state_name)
            FROM {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} AS s
            WHERE LOWER(TRIM(s.state_name)) = LOWER(m.home_state)
               OR LOWER(TRIM(s.state_abbreviation)) = LOWER(m.home_state)
        ),
        m.home_state
    )::VARCHAR AS patient_state,
    m.home_county::VARCHAR AS patient_county,
    m.home_zip::VARCHAR AS patient_zip,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS patient_latitude,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS patient_longitude,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_expenses,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_coverage
FROM members AS m
```

## Mapping hints
- Diagnoses are claim lines with "Diagnosis code" filled; the patient is "Patient account number". The same diagnosis appears on many lines (later visits and drugs name it as their reason): return one row per patient, code, "Service (from) date" and "Service to date".
- The start date is "Service (from) date"; the stop date is "Service to date", where 1969-12-31 means no stop date. There is no encounter id: NULL.
text:
```sql
WITH diagnoses AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Service (from) date"), '') AS DATE) AS condition_start_date,
        NULLIF(
            CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Service to date"), '') AS DATE),
            DATE '1969-12-31'
        ) AS condition_stop_date,
        CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Patient account number"), '') AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
        CAST(TRIM("Diagnosis code") AS VARCHAR) AS condition_code,
        CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis description"), '') AS VARCHAR) AS condition_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
    WHERE NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis code"), '') IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT
    condition_start_date,
    condition_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
    condition_code,
    MIN(condition_description) AS condition_description
FROM diagnoses
GROUP BY
    condition_start_date,
    condition_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    condition_code
```

## Mapping hints
- Diagnoses are claim lines with "Diagnosis code" filled; the patient is "Patient account number". The same diagnosis appears on many lines (later visits and drugs name it as their reason): return one row per patient, code, "Service (from) date" and "Service to date".
- The start date is "Service (from) date"; the stop date is "Service to date", where 1969-12-31 means no stop date. There is no encounter id: NULL.
text:
```sql
WITH diagnoses AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Service (from) date"), '') AS DATE)
            AS condition_start_date,
        NULLIF(
            TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Service to date"), '') AS DATE),
            DATE '1969-12-31'
        ) AS condition_stop_date,
        CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Patient account number"), '') AS VARCHAR)
            AS patient_id,
        CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis code"), '') AS VARCHAR)
            AS condition_code,
        CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis description"), '') AS VARCHAR)
            AS condition_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
    WHERE NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis code"), '') IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT
    condition_start_date,
    condition_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
    condition_code,
    MIN(condition_description) AS condition_description
FROM diagnoses
GROUP BY
    condition_start_date,
    condition_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    condition_code
```

```sql
WITH procedure_lines AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(
            TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Procedure date"), '') AS DATE),
            TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Service (from) date"), '') AS DATE)
        ) AS start_date,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Service to date"), '') AS DATE) AS stop_date,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Patient account number"), '') AS patient_id,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Medical record number"), '') AS encounter_id,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Procedure code"), '') AS procedure_code,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Procedure description"), '') AS procedure_description,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Line submitted amount"), '') AS FLOAT) AS procedure_base_cost,
        CASE
            WHEN UPPER(TRIM("Diagnosis code type")) IN ('SNOMED', 'SNOMED-CT', 'SNOMED CT')
                THEN NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis code"), '')
        END AS procedure_reason_code,
        CASE
            WHEN UPPER(TRIM("Diagnosis code type")) IN ('SNOMED', 'SNOMED-CT', 'SNOMED CT')
                THEN NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis description"), '')
        END AS procedure_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
    WHERE NULLIF(TRIM("Procedure code"), '') IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT
    CAST(start_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_start_datetime,
    start_date AS procedure_start_date,
    CAST(stop_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_stop_datetime,
    stop_date AS procedure_stop_date,
    CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
    CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
    CAST(procedure_code AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_code,
    CAST(procedure_description AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_description,
    CAST(procedure_base_cost AS FLOAT) AS procedure_base_cost,
    CAST(procedure_reason_code AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_code,
    CAST(procedure_reason_description AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_description
FROM procedure_lines
```

```sql
    dbt_utils.get_filtered_columns_in_relation( source('synthea', 'procedures') ) 
%}


WITH cte_procedures_lower AS (

    SELECT
        {{ lowercase_columns(column_names) }}
    FROM {{ source('synthea','procedures') }}
)

, cte_procedures_rename AS (

    SELECT
        {{ timestamptz_to_naive(adapter.quote("start")) }} AS procedure_start_datetime
        , {{ timestamptz_to_naive(adapter.quote("stop")) }} AS procedure_stop_datetime
        , patient AS patient_id
        , encounter AS encounter_id
        , code AS procedure_code
        , description AS procedure_description
        , base_cost AS procedure_base_cost
        , reasoncode AS procedure_reason_code
        , reasondescription AS procedure_reason_description
    FROM cte_procedures_lower

)

, cte_procedures_date_columns AS (

    SELECT
        procedure_start_datetime
        , {{ dbt.cast("procedure_start_datetime", api.Column.translate_type("date")) }} AS procedure_start_date
        , procedure_stop_datetime
        , {{ dbt.cast("procedure_stop_datetime", api.Column.translate_type("date")) }} AS procedure_stop_date
        , patient_id
        , encounter_id
        , procedure_code
        , procedure_description
        , procedure_base_cost
        , procedure_reason_code
        , procedure_reason_description
    FROM cte_procedures_rename

)

SELECT *
FROM cte_procedures_date_columns
```

text:
```sql
WITH procedure_lines AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(
            TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Procedure date"), '') AS DATE),
            TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Service (from) date"), '') AS DATE)
        ) AS start_date,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Service to date"), '') AS DATE) AS stop_date,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Patient account number"), '') AS patient_id,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Medical record number"), '') AS encounter_id,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Procedure code"), '') AS procedure_code,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Procedure description"), '') AS procedure_description,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Line submitted amount"), '') AS FLOAT)
            AS procedure_base_cost,
        CASE
            WHEN UPPER(TRIM("Diagnosis code type")) IN ('SNOMED', 'SNOMED-CT', 'SNOMED CT')
                THEN NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis code"), '')
        END AS procedure_reason_code,
        CASE
            WHEN UPPER(TRIM("Diagnosis code type")) IN ('SNOMED', 'SNOMED-CT', 'SNOMED CT')
                AND NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis code"), '') IS NOT NULL
                THEN NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis description"), '')
        END AS procedure_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
    WHERE NULLIF(TRIM("Procedure code"), '') IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT
    -- Date-only source values are represented as midnight UTC.
    CAST(start_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_start_datetime,
    CAST(start_date AS DATE) AS procedure_start_date,
    CAST(stop_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_stop_datetime,
    CAST(stop_date AS DATE) AS procedure_stop_date,
    CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
    CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
    CAST(procedure_code AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_code,
    CAST(procedure_description AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_description,
    CAST(procedure_base_cost AS FLOAT) AS procedure_base_cost,
    CAST(procedure_reason_code AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_code,
    CAST(procedure_reason_description AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_description
FROM procedure_lines
```

```sql
WITH normalized AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(
            TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Procedure date"), '') AS DATE),
            TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Service (from) date"), '') AS DATE)
        ) AS procedure_start_date,
        TRY_CAST(
            NULLIF(TRIM("Service to date"), '') AS DATE
        ) AS procedure_stop_date,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Patient account number"), '') AS patient_id,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Medical record number"), '') AS encounter_id,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Procedure code"), '') AS procedure_code,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Procedure description"), '') AS procedure_description,
        TRY_CAST(
            NULLIF(TRIM("Line submitted amount"), '') AS FLOAT
        ) AS procedure_base_cost,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis code"), '') AS procedure_reason_code,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis description"), '') AS procedure_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
)

SELECT
    -- Date-only values are represented as midnight UTC, without a time zone.
    CAST(procedure_start_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_start_datetime,
    procedure_start_date,
    CAST(procedure_stop_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_stop_datetime,
    procedure_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    encounter_id,
    procedure_code,
    procedure_description,
    procedure_base_cost,
    procedure_reason_code,
    procedure_reason_description
FROM normalized
```

## Mapping hints
- Procedures are claim lines with "Procedure code" filled; the patient is "Patient account number"; code and description are "Procedure code" and "Procedure description".
- The export has a date but no time: use "Procedure date" for both start and stop. There is no encounter id, cost or reason: NULL.
text:
```sql
WITH procedures AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Procedure date"), '') AS DATE) AS procedure_date,
        CAST("Patient account number" AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
        CAST("Procedure code" AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_code,
        CAST("Procedure description" AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
    WHERE NULLIF(TRIM("Procedure code"), '') IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    CAST(procedure_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_start_datetime,
    procedure_date AS procedure_start_date,
    CAST(procedure_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_stop_datetime,
    procedure_date AS procedure_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
    procedure_code,
    procedure_description,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS procedure_base_cost,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_code,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_reason_description
FROM procedures
```

```sql
WITH medications AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Service (from) date"), '') AS DATE) AS start_date,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Service to date"), '') AS DATE) AS stop_date,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Patient account number"), '') AS patient_id,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Claim payer identifier"), '') AS payer_id,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Medical record number"), '') AS encounter_id,
        NULLIF(TRIM("National drug code"), '') AS medication_code,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Drug cost"), '') AS FLOAT) AS medication_base_cost,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Line primary payer paid amount"), '') AS FLOAT)
            AS medication_payer_coverage,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Quantity dispensed"), '') AS FLOAT) AS dispenses,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Line submitted amount"), '') AS FLOAT)
            AS medication_total_cost,
        CASE
            WHEN UPPER(TRIM("Diagnosis code type")) IN ('SNOMED', 'SNOMED-CT', 'SNOMED CT')
                THEN NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis code"), '')
        END AS medication_reason_code,
        CASE
            WHEN UPPER(TRIM("Diagnosis code type")) IN ('SNOMED', 'SNOMED-CT', 'SNOMED CT')
                THEN NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis description"), '')
        END AS medication_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
    WHERE NULLIF(TRIM("National drug code"), '') IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT
    -- Date-only service values are represented at midnight UTC.
    CAST(start_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_start_datetime,
    start_date AS medication_start_date,
    CAST(stop_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_stop_datetime,
    stop_date AS medication_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    payer_id,
    encounter_id,
    medication_code,
    -- No drug description or terminology crosswalk is supplied.
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS medication_description,
    medication_base_cost,
    medication_payer_coverage,
    dispenses,
    medication_total_cost,
    medication_reason_code,
    medication_reason_description
FROM medications
```

```sql
WITH medication_lines AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Service (from) date"), '') AS DATE) AS start_date,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Service to date"), '') AS DATE) AS stop_date,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Patient account number"), '') AS patient_id,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Claim payer identifier"), '') AS payer_id,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Medical record number"), '') AS encounter_id,
        NULLIF(TRIM("National drug code"), '') AS medication_code,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Drug cost"), '') AS FLOAT) AS medication_base_cost,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Line primary payer paid amount"), '') AS FLOAT)
            AS medication_payer_coverage,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Quantity dispensed"), '') AS FLOAT) AS dispenses,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Line submitted amount"), '') AS FLOAT)
            AS medication_total_cost,
        CASE
            WHEN UPPER(TRIM("Diagnosis code type")) IN ('SNOMED', 'SNOMED-CT', 'SNOMED CT')
                THEN NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis code"), '')
        END AS medication_reason_code,
        CASE
            WHEN UPPER(TRIM("Diagnosis code type")) IN ('SNOMED', 'SNOMED-CT', 'SNOMED CT')
                THEN NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis description"), '')
        END AS medication_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
    WHERE NULLIF(TRIM("National drug code"), '') IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT
    -- Date-only service values are represented at midnight UTC.
    CAST(start_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_start_datetime,
    CAST(start_date AS DATE) AS medication_start_date,
    CAST(stop_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_stop_datetime,
    CAST(stop_date AS DATE) AS medication_stop_date,
    CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
    CAST(payer_id AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id,
    CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
    CAST(medication_code AS VARCHAR) AS medication_code,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS medication_description,
    CAST(medication_base_cost AS FLOAT) AS medication_base_cost,
    CAST(medication_payer_coverage AS FLOAT) AS medication_payer_coverage,
    CAST(dispenses AS FLOAT) AS dispenses,
    CAST(medication_total_cost AS FLOAT) AS medication_total_cost,
    CAST(medication_reason_code AS VARCHAR) AS medication_reason_code,
    CAST(medication_reason_description AS VARCHAR) AS medication_reason_description
FROM medication_lines
```

```sql
WITH medications AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Service (from) date"), '') AS DATE) AS start_date,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Service to date"), '') AS DATE) AS stop_date,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Patient account number"), '') AS patient_id,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Claim payer identifier"), '') AS payer_id,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Medical record number"), '') AS encounter_id,
        NULLIF(TRIM("National drug code"), '') AS medication_code,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Drug cost"), '') AS FLOAT) AS medication_base_cost,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Line primary payer paid amount"), '') AS FLOAT)
            AS medication_payer_coverage,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Quantity dispensed"), '') AS FLOAT) AS dispenses,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Line submitted amount"), '') AS FLOAT)
            AS medication_total_cost,
        CASE
            WHEN UPPER(TRIM("Diagnosis code type")) IN ('SNOMED', 'SNOMED-CT', 'SNOMED CT')
                THEN NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis code"), '')
        END AS medication_reason_code,
        CASE
            WHEN UPPER(TRIM("Diagnosis code type")) IN ('SNOMED', 'SNOMED-CT', 'SNOMED CT')
                THEN NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis description"), '')
        END AS medication_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
    WHERE NULLIF(TRIM("National drug code"), '') IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT
    -- Source service dates have no time component; represent them at UTC midnight.
    CAST(start_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_start_datetime,
    start_date AS medication_start_date,
    CAST(stop_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_stop_datetime,
    stop_date AS medication_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    payer_id,
    encounter_id,
    medication_code,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS medication_description,
    medication_base_cost,
    medication_payer_coverage,
    dispenses,
    medication_total_cost,
    medication_reason_code,
    medication_reason_description
FROM medications
```

```sql
WITH medication_lines AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Service (from) date"), '') AS DATE) AS start_date,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Service to date"), '') AS DATE) AS stop_date,
        LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM("Patient account number"), '')) AS patient_id,
        LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM("Claim payer identifier"), '')) AS payer_id,
        LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM("Medical record number"), '')) AS encounter_id,
        NULLIF(TRIM("National drug code"), '') AS medication_code,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Drug cost"), '') AS FLOAT) AS medication_base_cost,
        TRY_CAST(
            NULLIF(TRIM("Line primary payer paid amount"), '') AS FLOAT
        ) AS medication_payer_coverage,
        TRY_CAST(
            NULLIF(TRIM("Line submitted amount"), '') AS FLOAT
        ) AS medication_total_cost,
        CASE
            WHEN UPPER(TRIM("Diagnosis code type")) IN (
                'SNOMED', 'SNOMED-CT', 'SNOMED CT'
            )
            THEN NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis code"), '')
        END AS medication_reason_code,
        CASE
            WHEN UPPER(TRIM("Diagnosis code type")) IN (
                'SNOMED', 'SNOMED-CT', 'SNOMED CT'
            )
            THEN NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis description"), '')
        END AS medication_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
    WHERE NULLIF(TRIM("National drug code"), '') IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    -- Date-only service values are represented at midnight UTC.
    CAST(start_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_start_datetime,
    CAST(start_date AS DATE) AS medication_start_date,
    CAST(stop_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_stop_datetime,
    CAST(stop_date AS DATE) AS medication_stop_date,
    CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
    CAST(payer_id AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id,
    CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
    -- Preserve the supplied code; no drug terminology crosswalk is available.
    CAST(medication_code AS VARCHAR) AS medication_code,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS medication_description,
    CAST(medication_base_cost AS FLOAT) AS medication_base_cost,
    CAST(medication_payer_coverage AS FLOAT) AS medication_payer_coverage,
    -- Each medication claim line represents one dispensing, not a unit quantity.
    CAST(1 AS FLOAT) AS dispenses,
    CAST(medication_total_cost AS FLOAT) AS medication_total_cost,
    CAST(medication_reason_code AS VARCHAR) AS medication_reason_code,
    CAST(medication_reason_description AS VARCHAR) AS medication_reason_description
FROM medication_lines
```
