## Mapping hints
- Drugs are claim lines with "National drug code" filled (the column holds the RxNorm code the acquirer uses); the patient is "Patient account number".
- start is "Service (from) date" and stop is "Service to date", where 1969-12-31 means no stop. The export has dates without times.
- The reason is "Diagnosis code" and "Diagnosis description" of the same line. The payer identifier of the export is not one of the acquirer's payer ids and there is no encounter id: NULL for both.
text:
```sql
WITH medication_lines AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Service (from) date"), '') AS DATE) AS start_date,
        CASE
            WHEN TRIM("Service to date") = '1969-12-31' THEN NULL
            ELSE TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Service to date"), '') AS DATE)
        END AS stop_date,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Patient account number"), '') AS patient_id,
        NULLIF(TRIM("National drug code"), '') AS medication_code,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Drug cost"), '') AS FLOAT) AS medication_base_cost,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Line primary payer paid amount"), '') AS FLOAT)
            AS medication_payer_coverage,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Quantity dispensed"), '') AS FLOAT) AS dispenses,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Line submitted amount"), '') AS FLOAT)
            AS medication_total_cost,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis code"), '') AS medication_reason_code,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis description"), '') AS medication_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
    WHERE NULLIF(TRIM("National drug code"), '') IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    -- Date-only source values are represented as midnight UTC.
    CAST(start_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_start_datetime,
    start_date AS medication_start_date,
    CAST(stop_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_stop_datetime,
    stop_date AS medication_stop_date,
    CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
    CAST(medication_code AS VARCHAR) AS medication_code,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS medication_description,
    medication_base_cost,
    medication_payer_coverage,
    dispenses,
    medication_total_cost,
    CAST(medication_reason_code AS VARCHAR) AS medication_reason_code,
    CAST(medication_reason_description AS VARCHAR) AS medication_reason_description
FROM medication_lines
```

## Mapping hints
- Drugs are claim lines with "National drug code" filled (the column holds the RxNorm code the acquirer uses); the patient is "Patient account number".
- start is "Service (from) date" and stop is "Service to date", where 1969-12-31 means no stop. The export has dates without times.
- The reason is "Diagnosis code" and "Diagnosis description" of the same line. The payer identifier of the export is not one of the acquirer's payer ids and there is no encounter id: NULL for both.
text:
```sql
WITH medication_lines AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Service (from) date"), '') AS DATE) AS start_date,
        NULLIF(
            TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Service to date"), '') AS DATE),
            DATE '1969-12-31'
        ) AS stop_date,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Patient account number"), '') AS patient_id,
        NULLIF(TRIM("National drug code"), '') AS medication_code,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Drug cost"), '') AS FLOAT) AS medication_base_cost,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Line primary payer paid amount"), '') AS FLOAT)
            AS medication_payer_coverage,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Quantity dispensed"), '') AS FLOAT) AS dispenses,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Line submitted amount"), '') AS FLOAT)
            AS medication_total_cost,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis code"), '') AS medication_reason_code,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis description"), '') AS medication_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
    WHERE NULLIF(TRIM("National drug code"), '') IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT
    CAST(start_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_start_datetime,
    start_date AS medication_start_date,
    CAST(stop_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_stop_datetime,
    stop_date AS medication_stop_date,
    CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
    CAST(medication_code AS VARCHAR) AS medication_code,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS medication_description,
    medication_base_cost,
    medication_payer_coverage,
    dispenses,
    medication_total_cost,
    CAST(medication_reason_code AS VARCHAR) AS medication_reason_code,
    CAST(medication_reason_description AS VARCHAR) AS medication_reason_description
FROM medication_lines
```

```sql
        CAST(rec_uuid AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
        begin_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS encounter_start_datetime,

        CAST(why_cd AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_reason_code,
        CAST(why_label AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_d1', 'visit_log') }}
)

    encounter_id,
    encounter_start_datetime,
    CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date,

        CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE),

    organization_id,
    provider_id,
    payer_id,

    encounter_code,
    encounter_description,
    base_encounter_cost,
    total_encounter_cost,
    encounter_payer_coverage,
    encounter_reason_code,
    encounter_reason_description
FROM encounters
```

```sql
WITH parsed AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        trim(split_part(full_name, ',', 1)) AS last_name,
        trim(substr(full_name, strpos(full_name, ',') + 1)) AS first_name,
        trim(split_part(city_state_zip, ',', 1)) AS city,
        nullif(
            trim(
                regexp_replace(
                    trim(substr(city_state_zip, strpos(city_state_zip, ',') + 1)),
                    '\s+[0-9]{5}(-[0-9]{4})?$',
                    ''
                )
            ),
            ''
        ) AS state,
        nullif(
            regexp_extract(
                city_state_zip,
                '\s([0-9]{5}(-[0-9]{4})?)$',
                1
            ),
            ''
        ) AS zip
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'patients') }}
)

SELECT
    CAST(id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
    CAST(strptime(nullif(trim(birthdate), ''), '%d-%b-%Y') AS DATE) AS birth_date,
    CAST(strptime(nullif(trim(deathdate), ''), '%d-%b-%Y') AS DATE) AS death_date,
    CAST(nullif(trim(ssn), '') AS VARCHAR) AS ssn,
    CAST(nullif(trim(drivers), '') AS VARCHAR) AS drivers_license_number,
    CAST(nullif(trim(passport), '') AS VARCHAR) AS passport_number,
    CAST(nullif(trim(prefix), '') AS VARCHAR) AS patient_prefix,
    CAST(nullif(first_name, '') AS VARCHAR) AS patient_first_name,
    CAST(nullif(last_name, '') AS VARCHAR) AS patient_last_name,
    CAST(nullif(trim(suffix), '') AS VARCHAR) AS patient_suffix,
    CAST(nullif(trim(maiden), '') AS VARCHAR) AS maiden_name,
    CAST(nullif(trim(marital), '') AS VARCHAR) AS marital_status,
    CAST(nullif(trim(race), '') AS VARCHAR) AS race,
    CAST(nullif(trim(ethnicity), '') AS VARCHAR) AS ethnicity,
    CAST(nullif(trim(gender), '') AS VARCHAR) AS patient_gender,
    CAST(nullif(trim(birthplace), '') AS VARCHAR) AS birthplace,
    CAST(nullif(trim(address), '') AS VARCHAR) AS patient_address,
    CAST(nullif(city, '') AS VARCHAR) AS patient_city,
    CAST(
        coalesce(
            (
                SELECT min(m.state_name)
                FROM {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} AS m
                WHERE upper(trim(m.state_abbreviation)) = upper(parsed.state)
                   OR upper(trim(m.state_name)) = upper(parsed.state)
            ),
            state
        ) AS VARCHAR
    ) AS patient_state,
    CAST(nullif(trim(county), '') AS VARCHAR) AS patient_county,
    CAST(zip AS VARCHAR) AS patient_zip,
    CAST(lat AS FLOAT) AS patient_latitude,
    CAST(lon AS FLOAT) AS patient_longitude,
    CAST(healthcare_expenses AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_expenses,
    CAST(healthcare_coverage AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_coverage
FROM parsed
```

```sql
WITH parsed_encounters AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
        strptime(
            trim(start_date) || ' ' || trim(start_time),
            '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S'
        ) AS encounter_start_datetime,
        strptime(
            nullif(trim(stop_date), '') || ' ' || nullif(trim(stop_time), ''),
            '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S'
        ) AS source_stop_datetime,
        CAST(patient AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
        CAST(organization AS VARCHAR) AS organization_id,
        CAST(provider AS VARCHAR) AS provider_id,
        CAST(payer AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id,
        CAST(lower(trim(encounterclass)) AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_class,
        CAST(nullif(trim(split_part(code_display, '|', 1)), '') AS VARCHAR)
            AS encounter_code,
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN strpos(code_display, '|') > 0
                THEN nullif(trim(substr(code_display, strpos(code_display, '|') + 1)), '')
            END AS VARCHAR
        ) AS encounter_description,
        CAST(nullif(trim(split_part(reason, '|', 1)), '') AS VARCHAR)
            AS encounter_reason_code,
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN strpos(reason, '|') > 0
                THEN nullif(trim(substr(reason, strpos(reason, '|') + 1)), '')
            END AS VARCHAR
        ) AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'encounters') }}
),
normalized_encounters AS (

            AS encounter_stop_datetime
    FROM parsed_encounters
)
SELECT

    e.patient_id,
    e.organization_id,
    e.provider_id,
    e.payer_id,
```

```sql
WITH parsed_encounters AS (
    SELECT
        id AS encounter_id,
        strptime(
            trim(start_date) || ' ' || trim(start_time),
            '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S'
        ) AS encounter_start_datetime,
        strptime(
            nullif(trim(stop_date), '') || ' ' || nullif(trim(stop_time), ''),
            '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S'
        ) AS source_stop_datetime,
        patient AS patient_id,
        organization AS organization_id,
        provider AS provider_id,
        payer AS payer_id,
        encounterclass AS encounter_class,
        nullif(trim(split_part(code_display, '|', 1)), '') AS encounter_code,
        CASE
            WHEN strpos(code_display, '|') > 0
            THEN nullif(trim(substr(code_display, strpos(code_display, '|') + 1)), '')
        END AS encounter_description,
        nullif(trim(split_part(reason, '|', 1)), '') AS encounter_reason_code,
        CASE
            WHEN strpos(reason, '|') > 0
            THEN nullif(trim(substr(reason, strpos(reason, '|') + 1)), '')
        END AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'encounters') }}
),
normalized_encounters AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        coalesce(source_stop_datetime, encounter_start_datetime)
            AS encounter_stop_datetime
    FROM parsed_encounters
)
SELECT
    CAST(e.encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
    CAST(e.encounter_start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_start_datetime,
    CAST(e.encounter_start_datetime AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date,
    CAST(e.encounter_stop_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_stop_datetime,
    -- Match the acquirer's start-date-first convention for the stop date.
    coalesce(
        CAST(e.encounter_start_datetime AS DATE),
        CAST(e.encounter_stop_datetime AS DATE)
    ) AS encounter_stop_date,
    CAST(e.patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
    CAST(e.organization_id AS VARCHAR) AS organization_id,
    CAST(e.provider_id AS VARCHAR) AS provider_id,
    CAST(e.payer_id AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id,
    CAST(e.encounter_class AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_class,
    CAST(e.encounter_code AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_code,
    CAST(e.encounter_description AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_description,
    CAST(c.base_encounter_cost AS FLOAT) AS base_encounter_cost,
    CAST(c.total_claim_cost AS FLOAT) AS total_encounter_cost,
    CAST(c.payer_coverage AS FLOAT) AS encounter_payer_coverage,
    CAST(e.encounter_reason_code AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_reason_code,
    CAST(e.encounter_reason_description AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_reason_description
FROM normalized_encounters AS e
LEFT JOIN {{ source('raw_d2', 'encounter_charges') }} AS c
    ON e.encounter_id = c.encounter_id
```

```sql
WITH parsed_encounters AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(TRIM(id) AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
        TRY_STRPTIME(
            NULLIF(TRIM(start_date), '') || ' ' || NULLIF(TRIM(start_time), ''),
            '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S'
        ) AS encounter_start_datetime,
        TRY_STRPTIME(
            NULLIF(TRIM(stop_date), '') || ' ' || NULLIF(TRIM(stop_time), ''),
            '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S'
        ) AS source_stop_datetime,
        CAST(TRIM(patient) AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
        CAST(TRIM(organization) AS VARCHAR) AS organization_id,
        CAST(TRIM(provider) AS VARCHAR) AS provider_id,
        CAST(TRIM(payer) AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id,
        CAST(LOWER(TRIM(encounterclass)) AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_class,
        NULLIF(TRIM(SPLIT_PART(code_display, '|', 1)), '') AS encounter_code,
        CASE
            WHEN STRPOS(code_display, '|') > 0
                THEN NULLIF(
                    TRIM(SUBSTR(code_display, STRPOS(code_display, '|') + 1)),
                    ''
                )
        END AS encounter_description,
        NULLIF(TRIM(SPLIT_PART(reason, '|', 1)), '') AS encounter_reason_code,
        CASE
            WHEN STRPOS(reason, '|') > 0
                THEN NULLIF(
                    TRIM(SUBSTR(reason, STRPOS(reason, '|') + 1)),
                    ''
                )
        END AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'encounters') }}
),
normalized_encounters AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        COALESCE(
            source_stop_datetime,
            encounter_start_datetime
        ) AS encounter_stop_datetime
    FROM parsed_encounters
)
SELECT
    e.encounter_id,
    CAST(e.encounter_start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_start_datetime,
    CAST(e.encounter_start_datetime AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date,
    CAST(e.encounter_stop_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_stop_datetime,
    -- Preserve the acquirer's start-date-first stop-date convention.
    COALESCE(
        CAST(e.encounter_start_datetime AS DATE),
        CAST(e.encounter_stop_datetime AS DATE)
    ) AS encounter_stop_date,
    e.patient_id,
    e.organization_id,
    e.provider_id,
    e.payer_id,
    e.encounter_class,
    e.encounter_code,
    e.encounter_description,
    CAST(c.base_encounter_cost AS FLOAT) AS base_encounter_cost,
    CAST(c.total_claim_cost AS FLOAT) AS total_encounter_cost,
    CAST(c.payer_coverage AS FLOAT) AS encounter_payer_coverage,
    e.encounter_reason_code,
    e.encounter_reason_description
FROM normalized_encounters AS e
LEFT JOIN {{ source('raw_d2', 'encounter_charges') }} AS c
    ON e.encounter_id = TRIM(c.encounter_id)
```

## Mapping hints
- Timestamps are split into <column>_date (MM/DD/YYYY) and <column>_time (HH:MM:SS), both in UTC.
- Date columns are text written DD-Mon-YYYY (03-Sep-1942).
- code_display is the code, ' | ', then the description: split at the first ' | '.
- reason is the reason code, ' | ', then the reason description (NULL when there is no reason).
- All other columns keep the acquirer's source column names in lower case.
text:
```sql
WITH parsed AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(
            strptime(
                trim(start_date) || ' ' || trim(start_time),
                '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S'
            ) AS TIMESTAMP
        ) AS procedure_start_datetime,
        CAST(
            strptime(
                trim(stop_date) || ' ' || trim(stop_time),
                '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S'
            ) AS TIMESTAMP
        ) AS procedure_stop_datetime,
        CAST(patient AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
        CAST(encounter AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
        CAST(trim(split_part(code_display, ' | ', 1)) AS VARCHAR)
            AS procedure_code,
        CAST(
            substr(code_display, nullif(strpos(code_display, ' | '), 0) + 3)
            AS VARCHAR
        ) AS procedure_description,
        CAST(base_cost AS FLOAT) AS procedure_base_cost,
        CAST(
            trim(split_part(nullif(trim(reason), ''), ' | ', 1))
            AS VARCHAR
        ) AS procedure_reason_code,
        CAST(
            substr(reason, nullif(strpos(reason, ' | '), 0) + 3)
            AS VARCHAR
        ) AS procedure_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'procedures') }}
)

SELECT
    procedure_start_datetime,
    CAST(procedure_start_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_start_date,
    procedure_stop_datetime,
    CAST(procedure_stop_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    encounter_id,
    procedure_code,
    procedure_description,
    procedure_base_cost,
    procedure_reason_code,
    procedure_reason_description
FROM parsed
```

```sql
WITH parsed AS (
    SELECT
        try_strptime(
            nullif(trim(start_date), '') || ' ' || nullif(trim(start_time), ''),

        try_strptime(
            nullif(trim(stop_date), '') || ' ' || nullif(trim(stop_time), ''),
            '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S'
        ) AS medication_stop_datetime,
        lower(nullif(trim(patient), '')) AS patient_id,
        lower(nullif(trim(payer), '')) AS payer_id,
        lower(nullif(trim(encounter), '')) AS encounter_id,
        nullif(trim(split_part(code_display, '|', 1)), '') AS medication_code,
        CASE
            WHEN strpos(code_display, '|') > 0
            THEN nullif(trim(substr(code_display, strpos(code_display, '|') + 1)), '')
        END AS medication_description,
        CAST(base_cost AS FLOAT) AS medication_base_cost,
        CAST(payer_coverage AS FLOAT) AS medication_payer_coverage,
        CAST(dispenses AS FLOAT) AS dispenses,
        CAST(totalcost AS FLOAT) AS medication_total_cost,
        nullif(trim(split_part(reason, '|', 1)), '') AS medication_reason_code,
        CASE
            WHEN strpos(reason, '|') > 0
            THEN nullif(trim(substr(reason, strpos(reason, '|') + 1)), '')
        END AS medication_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'medications') }}
)

    medication_start_datetime,
    CAST(medication_start_datetime AS DATE) AS medication_start_date,
    medication_stop_datetime,
    CAST(medication_stop_datetime AS DATE) AS medication_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    payer_id,
    encounter_id,
    medication_code,
    medication_description,
    medication_base_cost,
    medication_payer_coverage,
    dispenses,
    medication_total_cost,
    medication_reason_code,
    medication_reason_description
FROM parsed
```

## Mapping hints
- Timestamps are split into <column>_date (MM/DD/YYYY) and <column>_time (HH:MM:SS), both in UTC.
- Date columns are text written DD-Mon-YYYY (03-Sep-1942).
- code_display is the code, ' | ', then the description: split at the first ' | '.
- reason is the reason code, ' | ', then the reason description (NULL when there is no reason).
- All other columns keep the acquirer's source column names in lower case.

```sql
WITH prepared AS (
    SELECT
        strptime(
            trim(start_date) || ' ' || trim(start_time),
            ['%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S', '%d-%b-%Y %H:%M:%S']
        ) AS procedure_start_datetime,
        strptime(
            trim(stop_date) || ' ' || trim(stop_time),
            ['%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S', '%d-%b-%Y %H:%M:%S']
        ) AS procedure_stop_datetime,
        CAST(patient AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
        CAST(encounter AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
        code_display,
        CAST(base_cost AS FLOAT) AS procedure_base_cost,
        nullif(trim(reason), '') AS reason
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'procedures') }}
),

delimiter_positions AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        strpos(code_display, ' | ') AS code_delimiter_position,
        strpos(reason, ' | ') AS reason_delimiter_position
    FROM prepared
)

SELECT
    CAST(procedure_start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_start_datetime,
    CAST(procedure_start_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_start_date,
    CAST(procedure_stop_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_stop_datetime,
    CAST(procedure_stop_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    encounter_id,
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN code_delimiter_position > 0
                THEN substr(code_display, 1, code_delimiter_position - 1)
            ELSE code_display
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS procedure_code,
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN code_delimiter_position > 0
                THEN substr(code_display, code_delimiter_position + 3)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS procedure_description,
    procedure_base_cost,
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN reason_delimiter_position > 0
                THEN substr(reason, 1, reason_delimiter_position - 1)
            ELSE reason
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS procedure_reason_code,
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN reason_delimiter_position > 0
                THEN substr(reason, reason_delimiter_position + 3)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS procedure_reason_description
FROM delimiter_positions
```

```sql
    where list_name in ('marital', 'marital_status', 'race', 'ethnicity', 'gender')

select
```

```sql
WITH encounter_class_map AS (
    SELECT
        local_code,
        standard_value
    FROM {{ source('raw_d3', 'code_map') }}
    WHERE list_name = 'encounter_class'
),
normalized AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(e."Id" AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
        CAST(e."START" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_start_datetime,
        COALESCE(
            CAST(e."STOP" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP),
            CAST(e."START" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP)
        ) AS encounter_stop_datetime,
        CAST(e."PATIENT" AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
        CAST(e."ORGANIZATION" AS VARCHAR) AS organization_id,
        CAST(e."PROVIDER" AS VARCHAR) AS provider_id,
        CAST(e."PAYER" AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id,
        CAST(m.standard_value AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_class,
        CAST(regexp_replace(e."CODE", '^SCT:', '') AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_code,
        CAST(e."DESCRIPTION" AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_description,
        CAST(e."BASE_ENCOUNTER_COST" AS FLOAT) AS base_encounter_cost,
        CAST(e."TOTAL_CLAIM_COST" AS FLOAT) AS total_encounter_cost,
        CAST(e."PAYER_COVERAGE" AS FLOAT) AS encounter_payer_coverage,
        CAST(
            regexp_replace(NULLIF(e."REASONCODE", ''), '^SCT:', '')
            AS VARCHAR
        ) AS encounter_reason_code,
        CAST(NULLIF(e."REASONDESCRIPTION", '') AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_d3', 'encounters') }} AS e
    LEFT JOIN encounter_class_map AS m
        ON e."ENCOUNTERCLASS" = m.local_code
)
SELECT
    encounter_id,
    encounter_start_datetime,
    CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date,
    encounter_stop_datetime,
    COALESCE(
        CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE),
        CAST(encounter_stop_datetime AS DATE)
    ) AS encounter_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    organization_id,
    provider_id,
    payer_id,
    encounter_class,
    encounter_code,
    encounter_description,
    base_encounter_cost,
    total_encounter_cost,
    encounter_payer_coverage,
    encounter_reason_code,
    encounter_reason_description
FROM normalized
```

- CODE carries the prefix 'SCT:': strip it.
- REASONCODE carries the prefix 'SCT:': strip it.
- ENCOUNTERCLASS holds local codes: translate with raw_d3.code_map where list_name = 'encounter_class' (local_code to standard_value).
- Column names and all other values are as in the acquirer's source table.

```sql
WITH encounters AS (
    SELECT
        e."Id"::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
        (e."START" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::TIMESTAMP AS encounter_start_datetime,
        COALESCE(
            e."STOP" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC',
            e."START" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
        )::TIMESTAMP AS encounter_stop_datetime,
        e."PATIENT"::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
        e."ORGANIZATION"::VARCHAR AS organization_id,
        e."PROVIDER"::VARCHAR AS provider_id,
        e."PAYER"::VARCHAR AS payer_id,
        m.standard_value::VARCHAR AS encounter_class,
        regexp_replace(e."CODE", '^SCT:', '')::VARCHAR AS encounter_code,
        e."DESCRIPTION"::VARCHAR AS encounter_description,
        e."BASE_ENCOUNTER_COST"::FLOAT AS base_encounter_cost,
        e."TOTAL_CLAIM_COST"::FLOAT AS total_encounter_cost,
        e."PAYER_COVERAGE"::FLOAT AS encounter_payer_coverage,
        regexp_replace(e."REASONCODE", '^SCT:', '')::VARCHAR AS encounter_reason_code,
        e."REASONDESCRIPTION"::VARCHAR AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_d3', 'encounters') }} AS e
    LEFT JOIN {{ source('raw_d3', 'code_map') }} AS m
        ON m.list_name = 'encounter_class'
        AND e."ENCOUNTERCLASS" = m.local_code
)

SELECT
    encounter_id,
    encounter_start_datetime,
    encounter_start_datetime::DATE AS encounter_start_date,
    encounter_stop_datetime,
    COALESCE(
        encounter_start_datetime::DATE,
        encounter_stop_datetime::DATE
    ) AS encounter_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    organization_id,
    provider_id,
    payer_id,
    encounter_class,
    encounter_code,
    encounter_description,
    base_encounter_cost,
    total_encounter_cost,
    encounter_payer_coverage,
    encounter_reason_code,
    encounter_reason_description
FROM encounters
```

```sql
WITH encounters AS (
    SELECT
        e."Id"::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
        (e."START" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::TIMESTAMP AS encounter_start_datetime,
        COALESCE(
            e."STOP" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC',
            e."START" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
        )::TIMESTAMP AS encounter_stop_datetime,
        e."PATIENT"::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
        e."ORGANIZATION"::VARCHAR AS organization_id,
        e."PROVIDER"::VARCHAR AS provider_id,
        e."PAYER"::VARCHAR AS payer_id,
        m.standard_value::VARCHAR AS encounter_class,
        regexp_replace(e."CODE", '^SCT:', '')::VARCHAR AS encounter_code,
        e."DESCRIPTION"::VARCHAR AS encounter_description,
        e."BASE_ENCOUNTER_COST"::FLOAT AS base_encounter_cost,
        e."TOTAL_CLAIM_COST"::FLOAT AS total_encounter_cost,
        e."PAYER_COVERAGE"::FLOAT AS encounter_payer_coverage,
        regexp_replace(e."REASONCODE", '^SCT:', '')::VARCHAR AS encounter_reason_code,
        e."REASONDESCRIPTION"::VARCHAR AS encounter_reason_description

    provider_id,
    payer_id,
    encounter_class,
    encounter_code,
    encounter_description,
    base_encounter_cost,
    total_encounter_cost,
    encounter_payer_coverage,
    encounter_reason_code,
    encounter_reason_description
FROM encounters
```

```sql
WITH encounter_class_map AS (
    SELECT
        local_code,
        MAX(standard_value) AS standard_value
    FROM {{ source('raw_d3', 'code_map') }}
    WHERE list_name = 'encounter_class'
    GROUP BY local_code
),
normalized AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(e."Id" AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
        e."START" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS encounter_start_datetime,
        COALESCE(
            e."STOP" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC',
            e."START" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
        ) AS encounter_stop_datetime,
        CAST(e."PATIENT" AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
        CAST(e."ORGANIZATION" AS VARCHAR) AS organization_id,
        CAST(e."PROVIDER" AS VARCHAR) AS provider_id,
        CAST(e."PAYER" AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id,
        CAST(COALESCE(m.standard_value, e."ENCOUNTERCLASS") AS VARCHAR)
            AS encounter_class,
        REGEXP_REPLACE(NULLIF(TRIM(e."CODE"), ''), '^SCT:', '')
            AS encounter_code,
        CAST(e."DESCRIPTION" AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_description,
        CAST(e."BASE_ENCOUNTER_COST" AS FLOAT) AS base_encounter_cost,
        CAST(e."TOTAL_CLAIM_COST" AS FLOAT) AS total_encounter_cost,
        CAST(e."PAYER_COVERAGE" AS FLOAT) AS encounter_payer_coverage,
        REGEXP_REPLACE(NULLIF(TRIM(e."REASONCODE"), ''), '^SCT:', '')
            AS encounter_reason_code,
        CAST(NULLIF(e."REASONDESCRIPTION", '') AS VARCHAR)
            AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_d3', 'encounters') }} AS e
    LEFT JOIN encounter_class_map AS m
        ON e."ENCOUNTERCLASS" = m.local_code
)
SELECT
    encounter_id,
    encounter_start_datetime,
    CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date,
    encounter_stop_datetime,
    -- Match the acquirer's start-date-first convention for the stop date.
    COALESCE(
        CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE),
        CAST(encounter_stop_datetime AS DATE)
    ) AS encounter_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    organization_id,
    provider_id,
    payer_id,
    encounter_class,
    encounter_code,
    encounter_description,
    base_encounter_cost,
    total_encounter_cost,
    encounter_payer_coverage,
    encounter_reason_code,
    encounter_reason_description
FROM normalized
```

## Mapping hints
- CODE carries the prefix 'LN:': strip it.
- Numeric values with units g, m and mg/L were converted from the acquirer's kg (x 1000), cm (x 0.01) and mg/dL (x 10): convert the value back and restore the unit. Values are text with at least one decimal digit (70.0, not 70).
- Column names and all other values are as in the acquirer's source table.
text:
```sql
WITH normalized AS (
    SELECT
        CAST("DATE" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS observation_datetime,
        CAST("PATIENT" AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
        CAST("ENCOUNTER" AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
        CAST("CATEGORY" AS VARCHAR) AS observation_category,
        CAST(regexp_replace("CODE", '^LN:', '') AS VARCHAR) AS observation_code,
        CAST("DESCRIPTION" AS VARCHAR) AS observation_description,
        CASE
            WHEN "TYPE" = 'numeric' AND "UNITS" = 'g'
                THEN CAST(CAST("VALUE" AS DOUBLE) / 1000.0 AS VARCHAR)
            WHEN "TYPE" = 'numeric' AND "UNITS" = 'm'
                THEN CAST(CAST("VALUE" AS DOUBLE) * 100.0 AS VARCHAR)
            WHEN "TYPE" = 'numeric' AND "UNITS" = 'mg/L'
                THEN CAST(CAST("VALUE" AS DOUBLE) / 10.0 AS VARCHAR)
            ELSE CAST("VALUE" AS VARCHAR)
        END AS observation_value,
        CASE
            WHEN "TYPE" = 'numeric' AND "UNITS" = 'g' THEN 'kg'
            WHEN "TYPE" = 'numeric' AND "UNITS" = 'm' THEN 'cm'
            WHEN "TYPE" = 'numeric' AND "UNITS" = 'mg/L' THEN 'mg/dL'
            ELSE CAST("UNITS" AS VARCHAR)
        END AS observation_units,
        CAST("TYPE" AS VARCHAR) AS observation_value_type
    FROM {{ source('raw_d3', 'observations') }}
)
SELECT
    observation_datetime,
    CAST(observation_datetime AS DATE) AS observation_date,
    patient_id,
    encounter_id,
    observation_category,
    observation_code,
    observation_description,
    observation_value,
    observation_units,
    observation_value_type
FROM normalized
```

- Numeric values with units g, m and mg/L were converted from the acquirer's kg (x 1000), cm (x 0.01) and mg/dL (x 10): convert the value back and restore the unit. Values are text with at least one decimal digit (70.0, not 70).
- Column names and all other values are as in the acquirer's source table.

```sql
WITH observations AS (
    SELECT
        CAST("DATE" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS observation_datetime,
        CAST("PATIENT" AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
        CAST("ENCOUNTER" AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
        CAST("CATEGORY" AS VARCHAR) AS observation_category,
        CAST(regexp_replace("CODE", '^LN:', '') AS VARCHAR) AS observation_code,
        CAST("DESCRIPTION" AS VARCHAR) AS observation_description,
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN "TYPE" = 'numeric' AND "UNITS" = 'g'
                    THEN CAST(CAST("VALUE" AS DOUBLE) / 1000.0 AS VARCHAR)
                WHEN "TYPE" = 'numeric' AND "UNITS" = 'm'
                    THEN CAST(CAST("VALUE" AS DOUBLE) * 100.0 AS VARCHAR)
                WHEN "TYPE" = 'numeric' AND "UNITS" = 'mg/L'
                    THEN CAST(CAST("VALUE" AS DOUBLE) / 10.0 AS VARCHAR)
                ELSE "VALUE"
            END AS VARCHAR
        ) AS observation_value,
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN "TYPE" = 'numeric' AND "UNITS" = 'g' THEN 'kg'
                WHEN "TYPE" = 'numeric' AND "UNITS" = 'm' THEN 'cm'
                WHEN "TYPE" = 'numeric' AND "UNITS" = 'mg/L' THEN 'mg/dL'
                ELSE "UNITS"
            END AS VARCHAR
        ) AS observation_units,
        CAST("TYPE" AS VARCHAR) AS observation_value_type
    FROM {{ source('raw_d3', 'observations') }}
)

SELECT
    observation_datetime,
    CAST(observation_datetime AS DATE) AS observation_date,
    patient_id,
    encounter_id,
    observation_category,
    observation_code,
    observation_description,
    observation_value,
    observation_units,
    observation_value_type
FROM observations
```

```sql
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Line submitted amount"), '') AS FLOAT)

        CASE
            WHEN UPPER(TRIM("Diagnosis code type")) IN ('SNOMED', 'SNOMED-CT', 'SNOMED CT')
                THEN NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis code"), '')
        END AS procedure_reason_code,
        CASE
            WHEN UPPER(TRIM("Diagnosis code type")) IN ('SNOMED', 'SNOMED-CT', 'SNOMED CT')
```
